items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) Fortune Change the World (2024) CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) Maven is looking for a high-energy, passionate, and detail-oriented Senior Associate to join our Client Success Team. As part of Maven’s Client Resources Team, you will play a critical role in supporting Maven’s rapidly growing SMB segment, a high-volume book of business with a high level of responsibility and visibility across the organization. You will partner with employers who come to Maven through our Channel partnerships or Direct, serving as the face of Maven for their ongoing needs by delivering thoughtful, speedy responses to inbound client requests, supporting engagement goals, performing utilization reviews, discussing communications strategies, and building relationships that turn satisfied clients into long-term advocates. You will also serve as the voice of the client internally, bringing insights that shape our product and program marketing. As a Senior Client Success Associate at Maven, you will: Serve as a member of the account team which manages our high-volume book of Small and Medium size Businesses (SMB) Partner with your peers to deliver quick follow up to inbound questions, providing comprehensive, thoughtful, and speedy insights to our clients Be the face of Maven for all client-related needs for ongoing relationship management and serve as the voice of the client internally by bringing insights to enhance product development and program marketing efforts Help maintain happy and healthy business relationships with clients and channel partners; capture and own client issues to ensure customer success and loyalty Maintain high level of client engagement, satisfaction and loyalty, as measured by high client satisfaction scores Manage client issues and escalations, collaborate with partner teams such as member support, operations, analytics, product, and sales as required Collaborate with channel contacts to build a strategic support model, leveraging Maven and channel partner expertise to forge a stronger client experience Collaborate with health plan client executives and Maven internal sales team, to manage broader strategic client relationships and unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio Own communications to meet mutually agreed upon goals, including but not limited to external client meetings and other project plans; be prompt, responsive, and professional in all client-facing communications and interactions Convert clients into Maven advocates, leveraging their successes for references, case studies, blogs, etc. We’re looking for you to bring: 2+ years experience in account management or client services role in digital health, healthcare, benefits or SaaS companies Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks; strong track record of high client satisfaction ratings and proven renewal success Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills; ability to communicate clearly and influence internal and external stakeholders Strong interpersonal skills; must be able to develop and grow relationships with clients Experience in working with the full lifecycle of customer success post sales (driving adoption, trainings/webinars, upsells, and account management) Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks Attention to detail and high degree of accuracy in task management and follow-up Ability to identify systematic issues based on your experience working directly with clients and bring to appropriate cross-functional teams to identify and solve with process improvements Helpful experiences and skills (if you don’t have them, you can learn them with us!): Experience using tools including Salesforce, Looker (or other data visualization tools); attention to detail and CRM data entry hygiene Experience with channel partners is preferred Background in a healthcare-related field Background in communications or digital marketing The base salary range for this role is $85,000 - 95,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset. New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA. For those based in NewYork, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA or Seattle, WA we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction. Remote Mavens in a commutable distance (~90 minutes driving or on public transit) to our hub cities with more than 20 employees (currently Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco) are expected to attend local Maven hosted Work Together Days . This role requires active work authorization in the US. At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams. Benefits That Work For You Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits: Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics. Whole-self care through wellness partnerships Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+) Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-senior-associate-client-success

Make a direct impact on voter engagement and democratic participation Apply your professional expertise to a meaningful national mission Collaborate with talented volunteers across technology, operations, communications, and civic engagement Expand your leadership experience and professional network Gain exposure to nonprofit leadership and governance * Fraud and phishing warning * Please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply. Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you!! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wevote-financial-controller-1

The successful candidate will bring proven expertise in affiliate marketing within iGaming globally, a strong network of partners, and the commercial acumen to drive measurable acquisition and retention results. This role is ideal for a hands-on, entrepreneurial professional eager to make a direct impact in a startup environment. Location: Fully Remote Responsibilities: As Director of Affiliates , your broad responsibilities will include but are not limited to: Own the affiliate budget and investment strategy. Develop and execute the affiliate acquisition and growth strategy for a new market launch, focusing on quality traffic and long-term ROI. Build, manage, and nurture strong relationships with key affiliates and media partners. Negotiate competitive commercial agreements and commission structures to maximise profitability. items.description: About Ethos Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten. About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Graphic Designer who can move comfortably between the physical and digital worlds. You’ll design direct mail and performance creative for paid digital channels, working closely with our growth, acquisition, and brand teams to create work that looks great and drives measurable results. This role suits someone who can own projects from brief to delivery, make sound design decisions without heavy oversight, and still work well with a team. You understand that a mail piece has to survive the mailbox and a social ad has to survive the scroll. Duties and Responsibilities: Prepare print-ready files with correct bleeds, margins, color modes, and specs for each format Work within USPS requirements, including postal indicia, address block placement, and mail piece sizing Coordinate with print vendors and lettershops on proofs, production timelines, and quality control Build templates and variable-data layouts for personalization at scale Design A/B tests for mail (formats, offers, headlines, layouts) and iterate based on response data Design static creative for paid social, display, and other digital channels Produce multiple sizes and variations of each concept for testing across platforms Apply platform best practices (safe zones, text limits, file specs) for Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, and others Turn performance insights into new creative directions in partnership with the growth team Contribute to landing page and email visuals as needed to keep campaigns consistent Own projects end to end, from brief through final delivery, with minimal direction Partner with copywriters, marketing managers, and analytics teams, and share your perspective on creative direction Maintain brand consistency while keeping creative direct, clear, and conversion-focused Manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-moving, test-and-learn environment Organize and maintain creative assets, templates, and version libraries Qualifications and Skills: 5+ years of graphic design experience, ideally in direct response, performance marketing, or an agency setting Strong working knowledge of print production for direct mail, including file prep, color management (CMYK vs. RGB), paper stocks, finishing, and proofing Working knowledge of digital creative for paid media, including format specs, platform requirements, and what makes ads perform Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma A portfolio showing both print and digital work Strong typography, layout, and hierarchy skills, especially for copy-heavy, offer-driven pieces Proven ability to work independently, manage your own priorities, and deliver without close supervision Proven ability to collaborate across teams, give and receive feedback, and communicate clearly Excellent attention to detail and the ability to catch errors before they go to print Nice to have Familiarity with USPS regulations and postal optimization Motion design skills (After Effects, Premiere, or similar) Experience working with creative analytics or performance dashboards Background in a regulated industry (insurance, financial services, healthcare), including working with compliance review Experience mentoring or reviewing the work of junior designers or freelancers #LI-Hybrid #LI-KP1 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records. To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice. Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com. We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: El Salvador URL: http://thrivedigital.com Performance Manager (Demand Gen) Job Details Role: Performance Manager (Demand Gen) Department: Performance Job Location: Remote (El Salvador) Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours) Compensation: $47,000 - $61,000 USD + Benefits Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply! About Thrive Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar. Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon. Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together. The Opportunity This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat. The Role Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service. Your focus will of responsibilities will be: Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise. Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators. Client : Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management. Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts. People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources. Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care. Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals. Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed. We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role: In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships. In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others. In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. Qualifications You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok). You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles. You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs. You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization. You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives. You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels. --- Equal Opportunity Employer Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process. Competitive Total Compensation Package At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more! The Use of Artificial Intelligence Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent. Hiring Eligibility by Location While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship. Beware of Hiring Scams Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse). Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/thrive-digital-performance-manager-demand-gen-performance-marketing-el-salvador

items.description: this is your role At TradeTracker .com, we are dedicated to delivering innovative software solutions that meet the needs of our clients and drive business growth. We are seeking an experienced Product Development Manager with a strong foundation in Advertising Technology (3+ years) and demonstrated leadership in SaaS product development . Your cover letter must highlight relevant adtech, SaaS, and gamification experience, demonstrating why these make you an exceptional fit for this role. Applications missing this information cannot be processed. Key Responsibilities As a Product Development Manager, you will be at the forefront of our product innovation. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that our products are designed and developed to meet the highest standards of quality and performance. You will lead efforts to understand market demands, identify opportunities for improvement, and work with various teams to deliver solutions that enhance our product offerings. You will report directly to the Head of Product, ensuring alignment with overall company goals and strategy. Product Design and Documentation: Actively create and maintain clear, detailed documentation for new products and features, including functional descriptions, flowcharts, and mockups. You will translate complex product ideas into easy-to-understand visuals and written materials, providing a blueprint that guides development and enhances cross-functional understanding. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, data engineers, and product managers, to deliver high-impact products. Your role will involve coordinating efforts across these teams to ensure that product development is seamless and efficient, fostering a collaborative environment. Product-Market Fit: Continuously assess and address client needs to ensure that our products maintain their relevance and effectiveness in the market. This involves staying updated on market trends, gathering client feedback, and making data-driven decisions to refine and improve our products. You will also need to understand SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports to create user-friendly and insightful products. your profile To excel in this role, you need a blend of experience, technical knowledge, and analytical skills. These qualifications will enable you to understand the market, make informed decisions, and drive the development of successful products. Experience: Proven experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role within the advertising or software development fields. You should have a track record of successfully managing and launching products that meet market needs and drive business growth. SaaS Expertise: Good understanding of SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports. This expertise is essential for developing user-friendly products that provide valuable insights and drive user engagement. AdTech Knowledge: A deep understanding of the online advertising technology landscape, including customer needs and market dynamics. Experience and knowledge in AdTech and online advertising are crucial. Knowledge and experience with affiliate marketing are a plus. Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze market data, interpret insights, and make informed decisions. This involves using data to prioritize product features, measure performance, and guide the product development process. You should also be comfortable with SaaS analytics and reporting tools to extract meaningful insights. Rapid Prototyping: Knowledge and experience with rapid prototyping techniques to quickly iterate and refine product concepts. This is crucial for fast-paced development cycles and ensuring that ideas are effectively translated into functional designs. We are looking for someone who not only meets the skill requirements but also brings additional qualities that will help drive our success. Your proficiency with tools, experience in scope management, and ability to lead and inspire are critical for this role. Product Management Tools: Proficient in using product management tools and methodologies such as Atlassian Product Discovery. These tools help streamline the product development process, ensure all team members are aligned, and facilitate efficient project management. Scope Management: Experience in transferring scope from Product Management to Product Owners for product development. This skill ensures that product development is focused and efficient, with clear responsibilities and timelines, leading to successful project execution. Wireframing & Prototyping: Familiarity with high-level wireframing and prototyping techniques. This allows you to create initial design concepts that can be tested and refined before full-scale development, ensuring that the final product meets user needs and expectations. Productivity & Quality: We expect high productivity and a work mentality based on productivity-focused work. Your performance should consistently result in high-quality products that are superior to those offered by our competitors. Visionary Thinker: A forward-thinking leader with the ability to inspire people and drive teams toward achieving strategic goals. Your vision and leadership will be crucial in guiding the product development process and achieving business objectives. If you are passionate about AdTech and have the expertise to lead product development in a dynamic environment, we would love to hear from you. Join us at TradeTracker .com and be part of a team that is shaping the future of performance marketing. why us? At TradeTracker .com, we're a leading global affiliate marketing platform that empowers advertisers and publishers to succeed in the digital marketing landscape. Our cutting-edge technology and commitment to excellence make us the preferred choice for businesses worldwide. Being at the forefront of technology and monetization models, we encourage creativity and a winner’s mindset. Be a part of a leading company in the fast-evolving affiliate marketing landscape. Work in a dynamic, innovative environment where your ideas can truly make a difference. Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to excellence and continuous improvement. Enjoy a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and a flexible working arrangement. Embrace the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values creativity, innovation, and results. Join our dynamic team at TradeTracker .com and be part of a fast-paced, innovative environment where your skills will be put to the test. If you're passionate about creating products the market want but may not even be aware about, we want to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote Canada At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical individual to join our Growth Analytics International team. This team plays a crucial role in conducting research, monitoring performance, and running experiments to develop exceptional products for both consumers and merchants while driving long-term growth for the business. As Affirm continues expanding into new international markets, this role will be instrumental in establishing the operational analytics framework for new launches, beginning with Australia and expanding into future international markets. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, a collaborative mindset, an eagerness to learn, and the patience to tackle complex challenges. Our team takes an end-to-end business analytics perspective, partnering across the organization to develop recommendations and solutions that enable the business to successfully execute its growth and profitability strategies. This role requires someone who can combine analytical rigor with business acumen to influence decisions and drive measurable outcomes. What you’ll do Establish and evolve the operational analytics framework for new international markets, ensuring scalable measurement, reporting, and decision-making capabilities as we expand globally. Operate with a business owner mindset by proactively identifying opportunities through analysis and product sense to enhance user experience, growth, and profitability. Own business problems from end to end by translating analytical insights into recommendations and optimization strategies that support business growth, profitability, and operational excellence. Take ownership of the end-to-end analytics process: define success metrics, generate insights and hypotheses, track performance, and create intuitive dashboards and reports that can be easily shared across the organization. Develop scalable analytics solutions and data models. Tackle ambiguous problems by identifying the core hypotheses and designing actionable experiments to validate product-market fit and economic viability. Translate analytical findings into clear and compelling narratives and business cases for leadership to inform decision-making. Spearhead weekly cross-functional metric reviews, collaborating with partners to conduct deep dives into significant metric shifts and suggest actionable steps. Partner effectively across Product, Risk, Finance, Commercial, and Operations to align strategies and execute against business objectives. Foster strong cross-functional relationships and establish yourself as a trusted advisor to team members. Mentor and guide junior analysts to deliver high-impact work that drives business results. What we look for: Passion to redefine the lending and financial industry for the better. Strong understanding of the consumer lending and credit industry, including lending economics, portfolio performance, and credit metrics. Experience supporting international lending markets, particularly Europe and/or APAC, is highly desirable. Demonstrated ability to balance growth objectives with profitability and develop data-driven growth strategies. Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitatively rigorous subject area such as statistics, mathematics, finance, or economics. 5+ years of proven success in a cross-functional analytical role. Practical and theoretical knowledge of A/B testing. Experience with SQL and performing statistical analysis using Python. Experience simultaneously balancing multiple workstreams and prioritizing an analytics roadmap. Demonstrated curiosity and a growth mindset, with hands-on experience using AI-powered tools such as Cursor, Claude, or similar assistants to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, enhance problem-solving, and advocate for AI adoption across analytical workflows. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences. Comfortable partnering across multiple cross-functional teams, particularly Product, Risk, Commercial, Finance, and Operations. Ability to think creatively and critically while thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic, and often ambiguous work environment. Willingness to go out of your way to help teammates, with humility and a team-first mindset. Previous experience mentoring and guiding junior analysts. Compensation & Benefits Base Pay Grade - M Equity Grade - 5 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company). CAN base pay range per year: $145,000 - $205,000 #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/affirm-analytics-lead-full-stack-1

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - India Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. Location Note We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. The Opportunity We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to support our Marketing Data Science team and accelerate new member growth through predictive modeling and advanced analytics. You'll build prospect targeting and conversion prediction models that help Oportun identify promising prospective members, improve acquisition conversion rates, and reduce customer acquisition cost (CAC). You'll own models end to end—from feature development and validation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement—in partnership with Marketing, Growth, Product, and Engineering. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You'll develop and deploy machine learning models for prospect targeting and conversion prediction to increase new member acquisition. You'll analyze internal prospect and application funnel data, marketing campaign and engagement data, third-party consumer and alternative data, and credit bureau data to build predictive features and identify growth opportunities. You'll apply statistical and machine learning methods, including logistic regression, gradient boosting, and related techniques, to improve targeting accuracy and conversion rates. You'll own reusable pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, scoring, deployment, and ongoing model monitoring. You'll partner with Marketing, Growth, Product, and Engineering to translate model outputs into actionable acquisition strategies and reliable production workflows. You'll measure model effectiveness and business impact through new member acquisition, targeting accuracy, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, and production reliability. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You're a curious, rigorous data scientist who turns complex data into reliable models and practical business decisions. You enjoy ambiguous growth problems, take ownership of outcomes, and balance predictive performance with measurable acquisition impact. You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 4+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, predictive modeling, or a related field. Strong Python and SQL skills and hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets. Experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, such as logistic regression and gradient boosting, to business problems. Experience developing, validating, deploying, and monitoring production machine learning models. Experience building reusable data preparation, feature engineering, and model scoring pipelines. Ability to assess model performance, data quality, and business outcomes and communicate clear recommendations. Strong cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, and project ownership skills. Nice to Have Experience in marketing analytics, customer acquisition, prospect targeting, or conversion propensity modeling. Experience with internal prospect and application funnel data, marketing engagement data, third-party consumer or alternative data, or credit bureau data. Experience with AWS, SageMaker, EMR, Spark SQL, Hive, or similar cloud and large-scale data technologies. Experience in consumer lending, fintech, credit risk, or fraud risk. Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline. Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve modeling, coding, documentation, or research workflows. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: India Benefits: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance. Provident Fund; Life & Accident Insurance. Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances. Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-data-scientist-r14369

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, United States Senior Solutions Consultant Remote - US ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITY The mission of the Senior Solutions Consultant is to configure and demonstrate the value of Legion’s next-generation workforce management technology to prospective customers. The Solutions Consultant will pair their functional expertise, presentation skills, and keen interest in diagnosing an organization's labor management challenges to showcase Legion’s cutting-edge products in a tailored manner. We seek a Senior Solutions Consultant with expertise in pre-sales discovery meetings, demo environment setup and maintenance, and superior presentation skills to partner with our Enterprise Sales team to demonstrate the business value of Legion’s workforce management platform. RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES Become an expert for all Legion products Support the Enterprise Sales team with opportunities across discovery, demonstrations, Proof of Concept engagements, RFP responses, and business justification in a presales capacity Define and present how Legion’s platform addresses the critical business and operational issues that a prospect faces; form a deep understanding of a prospect’s business as well as their technical environment Identify potential risks/gaps and eliminate obstacles through creative and adaptive approaches As needed, travel to various field events such as meetings, conferences, etc. Participation in competitive landscape and differentiation discussions REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS 5+ years of Workforce Management WFM software pre-sales experience Experience presenting and demonstrating software to large (10,000+ employee) global organizations Excellent communication, presentation, and customer-facing skills. Ability to communicate at all levels in the customer organization. Superior organizational, project management, and multitasking skills A desire to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment Experience in labor operations and/or Retail, Food & Beverage, or Hospitality industries a plus PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence Personal passion and fervor for industry-leading next generation technology Ability to operate in an environment with limited resources A great communicator who can distill powerful messages which resonate with customers Track record of building positive relationships with peers Continuous and thoughtful listener, able to learn from others and leverage input Strong personal work ethic focused on high priority issues; action and results oriented Unquestionable integrity, credibility, and character; demonstrated high moral and ethical behavior COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Salary Range: $130,000 - $160,000 + Bonus + Stock At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. Benefits include, but are not limited to: $0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment 401k plan Unlimited Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Parental Leave Equity Monthly Wellness Reimbursement Monthly Lunch on Legion ABOUT LEGION Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.Our award-winning AI-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric and has proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones. For more information, visit https://legion.co EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. items.description: Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere. Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet. It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started. Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list. In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company. Role Overview As a Database Administrator at Nium, you will own the reliability, performance, security, and migration of the database platforms that power our card issuance business. Today our data runs on-premises across MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and MongoDB. You will lead and execute the migration of these databases to the cloud, working closely with the DevOps team and engineering teams to ensure a safe, well-planned transition with minimal impact on customers. In this hands-on role, you will design, operate, and optimise database environments, automate routine operational tasks, and build the monitoring and tooling needed to keep our data platforms healthy. You will also provide the database information and evidence that our internal and external audits require, making sure our data practices are controlled, traceable, and compliant. You will advocate for database best practices, promote automation over manual intervention, and share knowledge across teams. Based in Malta, you will play a critical role in building a modern, reliable, and auditable data platform for payment technology. Key Responsibilities Database Migration to the Cloud Plan and execute the migration of on-premises MySQL, MS SQL Server, and MongoDB databases to the cloud, including assessment, sizing, cutover planning, and rollback strategies. Define migration runbooks and validation criteria to confirm data integrity, performance, and availability before and after each cutover. Corporate with other team member to decide for the appropriate cloud database services and configurations. Database Administration & Operations Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade MySQL, MS SQL Server, and MongoDB environments across on-premises and cloud platforms. Manage backups, restores, high availability, replication, and disaster recovery, and regularly test recovery procedures. Monitor and tune database performance, capacity, and query efficiency. Manage database access, roles, and permissions in line with the principle of least privilege. Automation & Tooling Automate database administration tasks, such as provisioning, patching, backups, health checks, and housekeeping, using scripting in Bash, Python, and other relevant languages. Build, maintain, and govern operational workflows and jobs in Rundeck, enabling safe, repeatable, and self-service database operations. Keep database automation under version control and align it with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices. Monitoring & Observability Manage Percona Monitoring and Management (PMM) across database environments to provide visibility into performance, availability, and capacity. Define alerting thresholds and dashboards, and act on signals before they become customer-impacting incidents. Audit & Compliance Provide accurate database information, evidence, and reports to support internal and external audits. Maintain up-to-date documentation of database inventory, configurations, access controls, backup and retention policies, and change history. Ensure databases meet relevant security, privacy, and regulatory requirements, including encryption, access logging, and retention controls. Incident Response & Support Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve database incidents, providing timely support to customers and internal departments. Lead root cause analysis and post-incident reviews, and implement preventive improvements. Knowledge Sharing Contribute to team development through training sessions, technical talks, documentation, and informal mentoring. Required Skills & Experience Hands-on experience administering MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and MongoDB in production environments. Experience migrating on-premises databases to cloud platforms, ideally AWS. Strong scripting skills in Bash and Python, with experience automating database operations. Working knowledge of Rundeck or similar job orchestration tools. Experience with Percona Monitoring and Management (PMM) or comparable database monitoring solutions. Solid understanding of backup and recovery, high availability, replication, and disaster recovery. Familiarity with database security and audit requirements, such as access control, encryption, and evidence collection. Experience with Linux operating systems. Familiarity with Terraform, Docker, or Kubernetes is a plus. What we offer at Nium We Value Performance: Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work. We Care for Our Employees: The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24 ⁄ 7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office). We Upskill Ourselves: We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend. We Celebrate Together: We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more! We Thrive with Diversity: Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone. Beware of recruitment scams: Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites. Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments . Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.description: Obsidian Security is a global leader in cyber security protecting the SaaS and non-human identity layer modern enterprises run on — from Salesforce and Snowflake to the AI agents now deployed inside them. The Obsidian Security platform gives unified visibility into every human and machine identity, app, and integration across their SaaS estate, detects identity-based and supply chain attacks in real time, and enforces least-privilege access before it's exploited. Trusted by major Fortune 500 companies T-Mobile, Workday, Snowflake, and S&P Global, Obsidian ranked No. 95 on the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™, growing nearly 1000% from 2021–2024 — helping CISOs turn an unmonitored attack surface into one they can govern with confidence. Obsidian has also been recognized by Forbes as America's Best Startup Employers in 2026. In August 2026, Obsidian raised $85 million in Series D financing led by Crescent Cove Advisors, with participation from existing investors including Greylock Partners, Menlo Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, IVP, Wing Ventures, and GV — pushing Obsidian's valuation to $1.1 billion, crossing into unicorn status. Obsidian is using the funding to deepen its R&D in agentic AI security and extend its platform as the standard for governing what AI agents can access and do inside third-party applications. With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and fresh capital from its Series D behind it, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness. About the Team We’re building a new Service Operations function within Customer Success to modernize how we structure, access, and act on customer data. This is a foundational role: you’ll be the primary consumer of the data built and owned by Business Systems, transforming it into automated reporting and AI-assisted tools that enable customer health tracking, streamline QBRs and EBRs, and provide executives with clear visibility into customer outcomes. About the Role Own the reporting and automation layer for Customer Success — translate stakeholder needs for account health, QBR/EBR decks, and executive dashboards into field-level requirements, then build the reporting and automation on top of the Customer Success data mart. Default to AI-first workflows — shape the roadmap for both deterministic (data plumbing) and non-deterministic (AI/LLM-driven) automation that surfaces customer insights, health checks, and recurring reports, replacing manual, ad hoc work wherever possible. Automate recurring Customer Success workflows beyond reporting , including renewal/adoption tracking, repetitive support tasks like ticket triage and diagnostics, and cross-platform automation that connects support tools (e.g., Zendesk) with systems like Salesforce, Slack, and the data warehouse to cut down manual handoffs. Help define a secure, auditable data access model for Customer Success workflows, in partnership with Business Systems and Security (who own implementation). Maintain data quality and documentation for Customer Success data sources, flagging gaps, inconsistencies, or governance issues as you find them. Partner across Business Systems, Product/Engineering, and Customer Success (TAM and Support) to shape how data flows into the reports and tools people use every day. About You An AI-first approach to problem-solving — you default to evaluating where agentic or LLM-driven workflows can replace manual, ad hoc reporting rather than reaching for another one-off script or dashboard. Hands-on experience with Databricks (or a comparable modern data platform), including querying, data modeling on governed marts, and metric/semantic views. Familiarity with Python or another scripting language for data transformation and automation. Strong communication skills — able to translate ambiguous business reporting needs into concrete data requirements. Experience with Salesforce data and/or customer success platforms (e.g., Totango, Zendesk, Gainsight) is a plus. Understanding of data access governance and security best practices, particularly around customer-tenant data. Comfortable operating with ambiguity, partnering directly with engineering/business systems teams that own the broader data warehouse. Experience designing or implementing automation for technical support workflows and cross-platform integrations (e.g., ticket triage, diagnostics, connecting support tools to Salesforce, Slack, or data platforms using an established integration platform) is a plus. Experience with cybersecurity, SaaS security, or a technical B2B SaaS environment is a plus, but not required. Employee Benefits Our competitive benefits packages are designed to support our employees' well-being, both at work and at home. Our US based employees enjoy: Competitive compensation with equity and 401k Comprehensive healthcare with dental and vision coverage Flexible paid time off and paid holiday time off 12 weeks of new parent or family leave Personal and professional development resources For more details on our US benefits, or for information on our international benefits, please see here . Pay Transparancy Please note that the base pay range is a guideline and for candidates who receive an offer, the base pay will vary based on factors such as work location, as well as the knowledge, skills and experience of the candidate. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible for equity awards and may be eligible for sales commission or incentive compensation based on the role or function within the company. At Obsidian, we are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and hire for talent, passion, and compassion. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to submit satisfactory proof of identity and legal authorization. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact accommodations@obsidiansecurity.com Information collected and processed as part of any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Obsidian’s Applicant Privacy Policy . Base Salary Range $120,000—$130,000 USD Employee Benefits: Our competitive benefits packages are designed to support our employees' well-being, both at work and at home. Our US based employees enjoy: Competitive compensation with equity and 401k Comprehensive healthcare with dental and vision coverage Flexible paid time off and paid holiday time off 12 weeks of new parent or family leave Personal and professional development resources For more details on our US benefits, or for information on our international benefits, please see here .

From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact: We are seeking a dynamic Data Import & Reporting Analyst to join our customer success team. This role bridges the gap between data services and business intelligence. Your mission is two-fold: first, you will orchestrate smooth data migrations, helping new clients transition their historical data (reservations, guest profiles, inventory) from legacy systems to Cloudbeds. Second, you will act as a reporting strategist, coaching clients on how to leverage Cloudbeds’ reporting features to extract meaningful insights, track KPIs, and drive data-backed business decisions from day one. Our Data Services Team: We are a collaborative, remote-first team energised by solving complex data puzzles and transforming technical transitions into seamless, empowering experiences for hoteliers worldwide. We thrive on cross-functional teamwork, blending analytical precision with a passion for client education so that no property is left in the dark. If you love deep-diving into spreadsheets just as much as celebrating a client’s "aha!" moment when their data reporting clicks, these are your people. Working Shift: Monday - Friday 10PM - 7AM GMT+8 What You Bring to the Team: Lead Data Migrations: Act as the primary technical advisor guiding new clients through the smooth transition of historical data (reservations, guest profiles, inventory) into Cloudbeds. Execute Data Manipulation: Extract, clean, map, and validate client data from CSV/Excel formats to ensure flawless system uploads. Drive Technical Troubleshooting: Proactively identify and resolve formatting discrepancies or system mismatches before clients go live. Empower Clients Through Coaching: Train properties on how to build, customize, and automate operational and financial reports within the Cloudbeds platform. Ensure Data Integrity: Guide clients through post-migration audits to validate accuracy across financial histories and occupancy metrics. Advise on Best Practices: Consult with property managers on key performance indicators (KPIs) to help optimize their daily operations from day one. What Sets You Up for Success: Hospitality Tech Background: Direct experience working with Hotel Property Management Systems (e.g., Cloudbeds, Opera, Mews, Protel, or similar software). Client-Facing Expertise: A proven track record in onboarding, implementation, or Tier 2/3 technical support with a natural ability to teach and guide users. Advanced Spreadsheet Proficiency: Power-user skills in Excel and Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, and data cleaning). Analytical Mindset: Strong understanding of basic data management principles, data mapping, parsing, and root-cause error analysis. Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision when handling sensitive historical, financial, and guest records. Remote-First Readiness: Highly tech-savvy with cloud-based workflows and equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection for video coaching sessions. Professional proficiency (verbal and written) in Spanish Bonus Skills to Stand Out (Optional): BI & Analytics Familiarity: Prior experience working with business intelligence dashboards or advanced financial reporting structures. Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary. items.summary: Headquarters: Toronto - Remote About the Role As a Growth Product Manager, HTS Media, you will own the roadmap for growing advertiser demand across brands: more qualified pipeline, faster campaign launches and higher advertiser spend within Hopper's ecosystem, working closely with engineering leadership, the sales team, Ad Operations and Account Ma
items.description: Product Headquarters: Toronto - Remote About the Role As a Growth Product Manager, HTS Media, you will own the roadmap for growing advertiser demand across brands: more qualified pipeline, faster campaign launches and higher advertiser spend within Hopper's ecosystem, working closely with engineering leadership, the sales team, Ad Operations and Account Management. This is a builder role: you will start by owning the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, using AI-assisted systems to create demand and make every seller faster, then grow into owning the platform roadmap, including the campaign buying interfaces, in partnership with engineering leadership. In your first year, you'll be judged on the pipeline your systems create, how much faster campaigns go from signed to live, and growth in spend per advertiser. What would your day-to-day look like Own the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, with goals and success metrics tied to a revenue target Build AI-powered systems that generate demand, from account research and signal-based targeting to personalized outreach and follow-up, and measure the pipeline and meetings they produce Grow into owning the platform roadmap for the campaign buying interfaces with engineering leadership: write the specs and decide what gets built, and in what order Work with Ad Operations to remove friction between a signed campaign and a live one Put insights into the buying interface, such as forecasts, benchmarks and media plan recommendations Use SQL on booking, search and campaign data to size opportunities, find advertiser results and decide what to build next Run demand experiments across channels such as LinkedIn, email and events, and track results in internal dashboards Support HTS Media positioning and reusable sales materials (deck templates, one-pagers and case studies), and the HTS Media website and offers site An ideal candidate has 4+ years of experience in product management or growth at a technology company, ideally in B2B SaaS, marketplaces or ad tech; experience in online advertising or travel is a plus A track record of owning a roadmap and shipping product with engineering that moved a measurable growth metric, such as pipeline, conversion, time to launch or spend per account Hands-on experience building AI-assisted or automated workflows that a real sales team used, with tools such as Clay, n8n, Zapier or Make, and LLM APIs (equivalents are fine), and the ability to describe what you built and what it produced Strong SQL on a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, and comfort turning booking, search and ad-serving data into decisions, forecasts and in-product insights Excellent writing and specification skills, and the ability to work with engineering leadership and communicate clearly with advertisers and internal teams Self-driven and organized, and comfortable building without a playbook in a fast-growing business Perks and benefits of working with us Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue’s telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards! Unlimited PTO Carrot Cash travel stipend Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business Open communication with management and company leadership Small, dynamic teams = massive impact About Hopper At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same And we're continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand's cardholders, and we've since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal. That's our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we're the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works. What that looks like in practice: Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that's a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal Come take off with us! #LI-Remote At Hopper, we leverage AI-driven tools to assist our team in efficiently reviewing applications. These tools help us assess qualifications fairly and objectively. By submitting your application, you acknowledge the use of these automated screening technologies. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hopper-growth-product-manager-hts-media
