items.summary: Headquarters: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States URL: https://www.skillz.com About Beamable Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game sys
items.description: Product Headquarters: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States URL: https://www.skillz.com About Beamable Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game systems, virtual economies, and AI-native tooling: all integrated into a single platform that eliminates the point-solution stitching that has defined game development for too long. Beamable also powers Wingman, an agentic LiveOps product that gives game teams a unified operating system to understand, optimize, and act on live game performance in real time. This is the future of how games are operated. Beamable is part of FIRY , a founder-led global technology portfolio operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Acquired in January 2026, and together with Skillz, our competition platform, and RZR , our AI-driven ad network, Beamable sits at the foundation of a compounding ecosystem that no standalone competitor can replicate. If you want to build the infrastructure that games run on at a company with the vision and resources to back it — Beamable is the right place to do it. About the Role Beamable is seeking a Head of Product to shape its platform vision and lead its next phase of growth in the game backend market. This is an opportunity to build the product function from the ground up, guide the platform from early access through public release, and advance AI integration to deliver meaningful value for game studios. As the company’s senior product leader and sole product practitioner, you will own product strategy, roadmap, launch milestones, and success metrics, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution. You will work directly with studios and design partners, represent Beamable’s product vision at industry events, and translate customer insights into clear priorities. Success in this role means delivering a successful public launch, developing early-access studios into reference customers, and establishing a product foundation that drives adoption and sustained revenue growth. Responsibilities Product Strategy & Vision Ownership. Set the product vision for Beamable’s platform — spanning player engagement, developer tools, data enrichment, and player intelligence — and own the roadmap from early access through public release and beyond. Partner with the CRO on packaging, pricing, and tracking the studio funnel quantitatively. Public Release & Launch Execution. Drive Beamable’s product through its launch milestones: early design partners, public release, and strategic partnerships. Define and own the go/no-go criteria for each milestone, ensuring the product ships when it’s ready to win. Studio Partnership & Customer Discovery. Spend meaningful time every week with studios, design partners, and game developers — running discovery calls, demos, onboarding sessions, and roadmap reviews. Join sales calls and paid pilots with the CRO and turn each design partner into a reference case. AI Integration & Product Intelligence. Define the guardrails, data policies, and feedback loops that make Beamable’s AI capabilities safe, effective, and trustworthy for game teams. Integrate with best-in-class tools studios already use and shape the intelligent systems that differentiate the platform. Metrics Ownership & Product Function Build-Out. Define success metrics across the studio lifecycle — time to value, pilot conversion, retention, usage, and revenue per studio — and do your own analysis in SQL. Establish the product processes Beamable runs on: discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch reviews. Key Competencies Platform Product Strategy. Proven ability to set and execute product vision for a developer-facing platform, owning the strategy across multiple capability areas simultaneously — not just a feature set. Customer-Facing Product Leadership. Equally credible with studio heads, producers, and engineers. Comfortable running a demo, leading a discovery call, supporting a sale, and representing the product at industry events including GDC and Gamescom. Gaming Live-Ops Domain Expertise. Deep understanding of what a studio’s growth or live-ops team does day-to-day — events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, and player data — and what slows them down. AI/ML Product Judgment. Experience shipping AI or ML-driven features to production. Knows where AI adds genuine value, where it needs guardrails, and how to define data policies that serve both studio needs and platform integrity. Data Fluency & Metrics Ownership. Can build dashboards, write SQL, and live with retention, churn, and revenue metrics over time. Runs experiments before big bets rather than after. 0-to-1 Startup Product Leadership. Comfortable being the only PM in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Has built product processes from scratch and can hold the strategy and the execution at the same time. Technical Depth. Conversant in data warehouses, APIs, SDKs, and system design. Can earn the respect of engineers and studio technical leads without needing a dedicated translator. Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. 10+ years in product management, including experience as a product lead or head of product owning a product line’s strategy — not just a feature set. Proven experience in gaming live-ops — either running live games or building tools for teams that do: events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, or player data. Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup as a solo or founding PM, with demonstrated comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities. At least one AI or ML-driven feature shipped to production and used by real customers. Demonstrated data fluency: SQL, product analytics tools, and a track record of living with business metrics over time to drive decisions. Experience with customer engagement platforms (Braze, CleverTap), game backends (PlayFab, Nakama, Unity Gaming Services), or data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) preferred. Experience taking a product from early access to public launch preferred. Total Starting Compensation including Base + Bonus + Equity: $212,625 + Bonus + Equity Location: Remote - CA, NV, or NY Travel Requirement: Less than 10% Why Beamable Comprehensive Benefits. 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. 401K matching, equity incentives, pre-tax benefit options, and more. Wellness Support. Meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, virtual therapy sessions, and more. Time Off. Competitive PTO and company holidays. Beamable embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with applicable fair chance ordinances. #GC-Remote #GC-1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/firy-head-of-product-beamable

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://wisetechglobal.com Company Description WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers. Job Description A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business. WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place. Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit. This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery. What You'll Do Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue. Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence. Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high. Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level. Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals. Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics. Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities. Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission Qualifications What You'll Bring 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred). Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software. Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles. Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges. Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently. Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Additional Information When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture. Creativity is in our DNA. We favor principles over policy, encourage open communication, and prioritize results over busywork. Our global team is united by our mission: to change the world by creating breakthrough products that enable and empower those that own and operate the supply chains of the world. Join us in shaping the future of logistics. Before You Apply From time to time, WiseTech Global may use external service providers to assist us with assessing applications, including testing and background checks, on our behalf. Accordingly, by applying for this role and providing your personal information to WiseTech Global, you consent to WiseTech Global providing this information to our external service providers who are required to treat such information with strict confidentiality in line with privacy and data protection laws and regulations. Compensation: USD 100000 - USD 150000 - yearly To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wisetech-global-e2open-us-area-sales-director-cpg

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Germany Munich Als Head of Lead Generation verantwortest du den Aufbau, die Performance und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Leadgenerierung. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Cold Calling. Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung aus der telefonischen Kaltakquise mit, weißt, wie erfolgreiche Outbound-Prozesse funktionieren, und kannst dieses Wissen an ein Team weitergeben. Du bist sowohl operativ als auch strategisch tätig: Du führst und trainierst unsere Cold Caller, optimierst Prozesse und erschließt bei Bedarf weitere Kanäle zur Leadgenerierung. Dabei bist du technisch affin, prozessverliebt und nutzt gerne technische Lösungen und KI-Tools, um unsere Leadgenerierung smarter und effizienter zu gestalten. Tools wie Zapier, Claude Code, Enrichment Tools wie Lusha und Co sollten dir bekannt sein! Aufgaben Operatives Cold Calling: Du kontaktierst potenzielle B2B-Kunden telefonisch, qualifizierst Leads und vereinbarst Termine für unser Sales-Team Teamführung und Training: Du führst unser Cold-Calling-Team, schulst neue Mitarbeitende und coachst das Team, um die Gesprächsqualität und Performance kontinuierlich zu verbessern Strategische Leadgenerierung: Du entwickelst unsere Leadgen-Strategie weiter, definierst Ziele und optimierst bestehende Prozesse. Weitere Outbound-Kanäle: Du steuerst und entwickelst zusätzliche Kanäle wie LinkedIn-Outreach, Cold Mailing und Paid Ads Performance-Management: Du analysierst KPIs, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und sorgst für die Erreichung individueller und gemeinsamer Ziele Prozessoptimierung: Du entwickelst Leitfäden, Standards und Best Practices für eine effiziente und skalierbare Leadgenerierung und nutzt Technologie, KI und Automatisierung, um unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu optimieren Qualifikation Was du dafür mitbringen musst: Mindestens 1 Jahr praktische Cold-Calling-Erfahrung Erfahrung in der B2B-Neukundengewinnung Erfahrung in der Führung und im Training von Vertriebsteams Du bist technisch affin, prozessverliebt und bringst Erfahrung mit KI-Tools mit und hast Lust, diese gezielt im Vertrieb einzusetzen Idealerweise Erfahrung mit weiteren Outbound-Kanälen Strategisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität Benefits Betriebliche Weiterbildung Flexible Arbeitszeiten 100 % Remote - Arbeite von überall! Unsere Vision? Wir bauen das beste Livetrainingsangebot für Unternehmen im deutschsprachigen Markt auf! Aktuell haben wir zu viele hungrige Interessenten und brauchen dringend High-Performer, die sich unsere Mission anschließen wollen. Wenn du also hungrig auf mehr bist und massiv wachsen möchtest - bewirb dich noch heute bei uns! Art der Stelle: Festanstellung, ggf. Freelance To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lotaro-head-of-lead-generation-remote-m-w-d

items.title: Statistician
items.summary: Role Title: Statistician Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is selecting Statistician to contribute expert knowledge to a customer project focused on advancing data-driven solutions.
items.description: Role Title: Statistician Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is selecting Statistician to contribute expert knowledge to a customer project focused on advancing data-driven solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Clean, preprocess, and structure complex and messy datasets using advanced statistical software (such as R, Python, SAS, or Stata). Apply and document basic descriptive and inferential statistical analyses to uncover trends and patterns in real-world data. Develop clear and compelling data visualizations to illustrate key findings and support model development. Contribute expertise in dataset annotation, labeling, or enrichment to enhance the quality of AI model training datasets. Draft concise, well-organized written summaries of methods, analyses, and results for a non-technical audience. Collaborate asynchronously with project stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities, and improve deliverables through effective written and verbal communication. Continuously identify data quality issues, provide actionable recommendations, and document solutions for handling dirty or incomplete data. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative field. Expertise in cleaning and preparing complex, messy (“dirty”) datasets with R, Python, SAS, or Stata. Proficiency in basic descriptive and inferential statistical techniques, including hypothesis testing and regression analysis. Strong programming skills in Python or R for statistical analysis, data manipulation, and visualization. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to non-technical and technical audiences with clarity and precision. Experience working with large, unstructured, or noisy datasets across a variety of domains. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on detailed documentation and collaboration in remote environments. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Junior Software Engineer with Accounting Experience (Chile)
items.summary: Headquarters: Chile, Remote The salary range for this role is $1,500 - $4,000 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and mo
items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Chile, Remote The salary range for this role is $1,500 - $4,000 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated Junior Software Engineer with a unique blend of accounting experience who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This role is tailored for professionals who started their careers in accounting but pivoted to engineering and now want to leverage their domain expertise to solve technical challenges in fintech. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. The Junior Software Engineer will assist us with the design, development, and installation of software solutions. Your duties will include development, writing code, and documenting functionality. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards and technical design. Interview Process We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed. Application submitted (you are here) Wonderlic test (30-40 min) Coding assessment (~1.5 hours) Interview with recruiters (30 min) Interview with engineers (1 hour) Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min) Offer! Sezzle Technical Stack: Golang backend, React / React Native front-end Grafana / Loki / Prometheus metrics Kubernetes AWS Amazon Aurora (MySQL) RDS Gitlab CI/CD deployments Unit, Integration, and end-to-end testing What You'll Do: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes. Be an integral part of the software development lifecycle. Work as an integrated team member developing new features. Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and improve automation and reconciliation workflows . Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics. Provide support and consulting on software systems usage. Ensure compliance with project plans and industry standards. What We Look For: Prior experience as an accountant or financial analyst. Solid understanding of financial operations such as reconciliation, reporting, and compliance . Proficient in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and familiar with database systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL. Experience with backend API development. Experience with relational database storage and retrieval. Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes. Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field. Sezzle’s Technology Stack: Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native Backend: Golang Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes Version Control: Git CI/CD: Gitlab Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying! About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome: At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. #Li-remote #Full-time To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-junior-software-engineer-with-accounting-experience-chile

items.description: Product Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . We are looking for a motivated Performance Test Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in performance testing, scripting, and analyzing application performance. You will work closely with Performance Engineers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to identify performance bottlenecks, validate application scalability, and ensure our products meet performance and reliability expectations. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, execute, and maintain performance test scripts using tools such as Apache JMeter, Locust, and K6 . Conduct load, stress, scalability, and endurance testing for APIs and web applications. Execute weekly release performance tests , analyze results, identify regressions, and report findings to ensure release readiness. Analyze performance test results to identify bottlenecks, response-time degradation, and resource utilization issues. Monitor application and infrastructure metrics, including CPU, memory, throughput, latency, and error rates. Collaborate with development teams to investigate performance issues and validate fixes. Develop and maintain reusable performance testing scripts and test data. Participate in integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines. Document test scenarios, execution results, and performance findings. Support performance regression testing as part of regular release cycles. Work with senior engineers to improve performance testing frameworks and processes. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in software testing, including hands-on performance testing experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical experience with Apache JMeter or similar performance testing tools. Good understanding of performance testing concepts, including load testing, stress testing, throughput, latency, and concurrency. Experience testing REST APIs and understanding HTTP/HTTPS protocols. Basic programming or scripting experience with Python, Java, or JavaScript. Ability to analyze performance results and troubleshoot application issues. Familiarity with Linux environments and basic command-line utilities. Understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and CI/CD processes. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with K6, Locust , or other modern performance testing frameworks. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus. Working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, EKS, CloudWatch, and basic cloud networking concepts. Basic understanding of Kubernetes and Docker , including containers, pods, deployments, and resource utilization. Experience with UI test automation using frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright. Familiarity with AI-assisted testing and development tools , including using generative AI to create test scripts, analyze results, troubleshoot failures, or improve automation efficiency. Basic knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts. Familiarity with Git commands and repository management , including branching, committing changes, creating merge requests, and resolving basic merge conflicts. Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar automation pipelines. Basic understanding of databases, SQL queries, and application architecture. Familiarity with distributed systems and microservices. What We’re Looking For A curious engineer who enjoys troubleshooting and understanding how systems behave under load. Someone comfortable analyzing data and communicating technical findings. A proactive team player who can work independently on assigned testing activities while collaborating with senior engineers. An engineer interested in leveraging AI and automation to improve testing efficiency and engineering productivity. A strong desire to learn new performance engineering tools, technologies, and methodologies. What we offer you: Outstanding Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage to meet all your healthcare needs. Wellness benefits to help you focus on what’s most important. “Take What You Need” time off policy. Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow your career at Veracode. Generous 401k match to help save for your future . Amazing community of professionals who take pride in what we do every day. Compensation Transparency In accordance with U.S. pay transparency laws, Veracode provides compensation transparency for roles based in the United States. Click here to view our compensation ranges by grade. Please note, specific compensation may be influenced by various factors including candidates experience, education, and work location. Job Grade: Career Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information. Here’s our recruitment promise to you: Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-performance-test-engineer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/9wfGQ1tsnTpFJumPRzBDFL/jobs-at-the-fidget-game About The Fidget Game We're both an educational company and a toy company. We make multisensory educational board games for Pre-K through Grade 6, built on the science of reading and aligned with math standards, plus collectible toys, squishies, and unboxing products kids love to open, trade, and share. Founded by a former teacher with six years of classroom experience across six countries, The Fidget Game has grown into a fast-growing consumer brand: Used in 50,000+ schools 1,000,000+ games sold Featured on Shark Tank Our next chapter: becoming a household name in children's educational games and toys. The Opportunity We're hiring a Senior Head of Marketing to lead our marketing department, strengthen our brand, and drive profitable growth across educational games, sensory toys, and collectibles. This is a hands-on senior leadership role covering both strategy and execution. You'll set the plan, direct the team, and own the results, so our founder can step back from day-to-day marketing decisions. You'll lead the marketing team: Head of Growth: paid media strategy, buying, and acquisition Head of Creative Marketing & Partnerships: creative production, content, and creator partnerships Video Editor, Graphic Designer, and Junior Creative Strategist What you own vs. what you influence. You own marketing strategy, creative direction, campaign and launch priorities, team performance, and the approved marketing budget. The Head of Growth owns the marketing KPIs and paid buying, marketplace teams run Amazon advertising and channel budgets, and the CEO approves the overall budget and major investments. Responsibilities Lead brand positioning, creative direction, storytelling, and multichannel campaign execution. Drive product launches, influencer programs, organic social, and marketplace marketing. Build and manage a high-performing marketing team, agencies, and processes. Partner with growth teams to improve performance through continuous creative testing. Develop integrated marketing strategies aligned with ambitious revenue and growth targets. What You'll Own Strategy & growth Build annual and quarterly marketing plans tied to revenue, profitability, and brand goals. Lead integrated marketing across Shopify/DTC, Amazon (US, Canada, UK), TikTok Shop, retail, and B2B, in partnership with channel owners. Recommend budgets and investments to the CEO, then manage the approved budget against targets. Performance & accountability Align marketing goals, plans, and campaigns with the KPIs owned by the Head of Growth: MER, CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, AOV, LTV, retention, and contribution margin. Build dashboards and reporting that make results visible, and act quickly on what's underperforming. Work with Finance, Operations, and Sales so marketing decisions fit margins and inventory. Brand & creative Sharpen our positioning as both a trusted educational brand and an exciting toy brand, for parents, educators, and kids. Set creative direction and priorities for the Head of Creative Marketing & Partnerships. Run a structured creative testing loop between Creative and Growth, balancing storytelling with commercial results. Social, creators & community Lead strategy for organic social, influencers, creators, UGC, and affiliates, with clear goals for each. Guide founder-led content so it supports brand and commercial objectives. Align organic, creator, TikTok Shop, and paid efforts. Launches, schools & events Build a repeatable launch playbook for frequent product releases, with clear goals, budgets, and owners. Partner with B2B Sales on marketing to teachers, schools, districts, and retailers. Lead marketing for trade shows such as New York Toy Fair, and represent the company at key events. Team & AI Coach the team, set clear expectations, and run regular performance reviews. Put in place a RACI, campaign calendar, and project systems that keep execution consistent. Build practical AI workflows across research, planning, ideation, and reporting, and train the team to use them. Manage agencies and external partners against clear expectations. What Success Looks Like First 30 days: understand and take ownership Learn our products, customers, channels, and unit economics. Assess current performance, team, workflows, budgets, and reporting. Take over day-to-day marketing priorities and team coordination. First 90 days: set the strategy Present a 12-month marketing strategy with quarterly priorities, targets, and budget recommendations. Launch KPIs and dashboards, a creative testing process, and a RACI for the department. Ship the first wave of integrated campaigns under your leadership. First 12 months: deliver growth Hit agreed targets for revenue, acquisition, retention, and profitability. Have repeatable systems running for launches, creators, organic social, and creative testing. Run a department that operates independently, with minimal day-to-day founder involvement. What You Bring Required 8+ years in consumer brand, integrated, or e-commerce marketing, including 3+ years managing teams. Experience as a Head of Marketing, Marketing Director, or equivalent senior leader. A track record helping scale a $20M+ DTC, e-commerce, or CPG brand, with measurable revenue and efficiency gains. Strong command of Shopify/DTC, acquisition, retention, and multichannel marketing. Fluency in marketing financials (MER, CAC, ROAS, contribution margin, AOV, LTV) and experience building budgets and forecasts. Proven wins in brand campaigns, influencer marketing, organic social, short-form video, and product launches. Experience leading creative and performance teams, functional leaders, and agencies. Advanced, hands-on AI skills, with real examples of improving marketing efficiency. Ability to travel occasionally for trade shows and company meetings, such as New York Toy Fair (expenses covered). Bonus points Toy, children's, educational, or family brand experience. Marketing to parents, teachers, or schools. Amazon, TikTok Shop, retail, or international e-commerce experience. Building marketing systems in a fast-growing, founder-led company. Competitive salary based on experience _______________ Due to the high volume of applications, we can only contact candidates who have been selected for an interview. If you haven't heard from us within 3 weeks of applying, please know that we've decided not to move forward with your application this time. To keep the process fair for all applicants, we're unable to respond to direct messages or emails about application status. We truly appreciate your interest in The Fidget Game and thank you for taking the time to apply! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/the-fidget-game-senior-head-of-marketing

We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply! About Thrive Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar. Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon. Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together. The Opportunity This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat. The Role Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You’ll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes. Working Within Our Values: At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required. Your focus of responsibilities will be: Domain: Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers. Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You’re responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators. Client : Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes. Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts. People: Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise. Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care. Company: Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation. Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed. We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role: In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships. In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others. In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. Qualifications You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others). You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level. You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools. You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals. You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You’ve resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables. You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches. --- Equal Opportunity Employer Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) Fortune Change the World (2024) CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) About the Role: Maven is seeking a Manager, Payments & Reconciliation to lead the end-to-end financial operations and reconciliation framework across our enterprise and consumer programs. Reporting into the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team, you will architect a robust, scalable payment integrity program. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of payment funding, from accurate invoicing and money movement oversight to complex account reconciliation, while partnering with Product/Engineering to build automated financial controls that ensure operational excellence at scale. As a Manager, Payments & Reconciliation at Maven, you will: Oversee the end-to-end movement of payment funds across Maven’s Enterprise and Consumer programs, ensuring transaction accuracy, timely disbursement, and integrity across the full funding pipeline, including fee-for-service claims payments. Own client and payer invoicing for payment funding programs and the timely reconciliation of complex claims funding account transactions and balances, ensuring paid claims tie back to funding. Monitor clinic, provider, and fee-for-service claims payments against contracted rates and timeliness standards, identifying overpayments, underpayments, and SLA gaps, and partnering with operations to resolve root causes and recover funds. Manage Maven's floated benefit funding program, including tracking outstanding float balances, driving timely recoupment from clients and payers, and escalating aging exposure to Finance. Lead cross-functional root cause analyses on financial discrepancies and drive continuous process improvements that prevent billing errors, optimize cash flow, and increase the accuracy and scalability of the payments and invoicing function. Partner with Finance during the month-end close process, including supporting the preparation of detailed bank reconciliations, owning reporting deliverables and assisting with analyses around collections risk. Act as the financial subject matter expert for Client Success, equipping CSMs with detailed reconciliation insights and structural solutions to resolve billing disputes and optimize the client funding experience. Act as the business owner for funding tools, collaborating with Product and Engineering to design application enhancements, resolve bugs, and automate financial workflows. This is an exciting opportunity in our Data Science Production Engineering (DSPE) department at Natera (a global leader in precision medicine and genomics testing), to provide critical data analytics support for our lab production operations. As a Senior Data Analyst for Lab Production Support in our DSPE Extended-Hours Support (ExHS) team, you will work in the Weekend Shift team (following the above two rotation schedules). You will have the opportunity to apply innovative data analytics solutions, directly support the most cutting-edge medical diagnostics and genomics applications, and make real & immediate impact to patients and healthcare providers, by providing timely & accurate data analysis support to Natera's production laboratories, as well as for other key business needs. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Technical Execution and Infrastructure Deliver timely data support to Lab Operations teams, unblock production issues, and improve patient results turnaround times. Apply statistical techniques to analyze complex datasets, diagnose operational issues, and support data-driven decision-making. Perform exploratory data analysis, identify trends, and work with stakeholders to interpret findings and drive continuous improvement. Design and implement automated solutions for recurring data analysis and production support workflows, improving operational efficiency and scalability. Extract, transform, and analyze data to generate actionable insights that support lab production operations and business decisions. Document analytical processes, best practices, and insights to ensure consistency and knowledge transfer across teams. Process Improvement Develop and optimize solutions for efficient data retrieval and scalable performance on large and/or complex datasets. Learn and acquire operational efficiencies on new technologies and solutions developed by other DSPE teams. Train and coach junior team members on new technologies, procedures, and guidelines/best practices. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Lab Operations and Product teams to identify process issues, assist with root cause analysis, and provide product support. Represent the Data Science Production Engineering (DSPE) team in stakeholder meetings. Effectively and correctly escalate encountered issues to other DSPE teams. QUALIFICATIONS: Masters degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Operational Research, or other related fields. Minimum 3 years of relevant industry experience. Minimum 3 years of experience working in a highly regulated environment (e.g., CLIA and/or FDA compliant settings). Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, extraction, querying in production support roles. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Working knowledge of the business processes and requirements of diagnostic laboratories. Knowledge of molecular biology, genetics, genomics, and/or bioinformatics is a plus. Proficient in data analysis and statistical techniques. Proficient in Python and SQL development. Working knowledge of Snowflake platform and cloud technologies. Strong understanding of statistical concepts such as hypothesis testing, central limit theorem, time series analysis, anomaly detection, and regression modeling. Good documentation practices and coding style. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience using version control systems such as GitHub or GitLab for managing code and collaboration. Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment. Strong interpersonal skills. Strong integrity. items.description: Role Title: Computational Bioscience Expert (Python) Pay: $60–$120/hour Location: Global, fully remote Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week) Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired micro1 is seeking experienced Computational Bioscience Expert with strong, hands-on Python skills to contribute to projects focused on evaluating and improving advanced AI systems. In this role, you will apply your scientific expertise to create, solve, and review challenging research problems within biology and related fields. You will use Python to analyze scientific data, develop reproducible solutions, validate computational results, and identify errors in technical reasoning or code. Areas of Expertise We are particularly interested in candidates with expertise in one or more of the following: Medicine and biomedical science Computational biology Neuroscience Molecular and cellular biology Biotechnology and bioinformatics Genetics and genomics Ecology and evolutionary biology Biostatistics or biological data science Etc. Scope of Work Create and solve technically rigorous scientific problems within your area of expertise. Develop reproducible Python-based analyses, models, simulations, or data-processing workflows. Review scientific solutions and code for correctness, clarity, and completeness. Preferred Qualifications PhD, MD, or master’s degree with substantial research experience in a relevant life sciences discipline. Strong scientific or applied research background demonstrated through publications, thesis work, computational projects, industry research, or equivalent accomplishments. Practical Python experience for scientific computing, data analysis, modeling, or simulation. Familiarity with tools such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, Matplotlib, scikit-learn, Jupyter, or relevant domain-specific libraries. Process Apply to the role and complete the screening questions. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes. Complete the hiring manager review. Compensation Structure Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply.. Start Timeline & Availability We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Software Engineer - App Stores
items.summary: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. About Canonical Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world’s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. What Canonical offers: Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #stack Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - California; San Francisco, California; USCA SLSQ227R805 While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered. Candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role San Francisco The Partner Strategy team works directly with Databricks' Partnerships leaders to drive operational scale across our Consulting and Systems Integrator ecosystem, in an extremely high-growth environment. We give our stakeholders and senior leadership the insights, tools, and decision criteria to shape proactive, effective, data-driven programmatic strategies. We're looking for a Strategy Manager to be the business partner to the VP of Global Systems Integrators. It's a critical, high-visibility role built on two elements: Strategic business partner to GSI leadership. You partner with the VP of Global Systems Integrators to set the strategy and medium- to long-term goals for the business. Then you lead the execution: building scalable processes, building consensus, and running programs end to end. You're the connective tissue across Partnerships, Sales, Product, Finance, Data, Legal, Commercial, and the broader GTM org. You invest the time to know the SI landscape, our GSI partners, and the SI operating model. A highly technical, analytical operator. You love working with data. You're AI-fluent, and you use cutting-edge AI and data tools for analysis, problem solving, visualization, and automation. You'll own the executive analyses and deep dives that turn SI performance trends into action. You must be able to run the day-to-day operating cadence with rigor, while also stepping back to bring a strategic point of view the leader hasn't asked for yet. You will report to the Director of Partner Strategy & Operations. This is a unique opportunity to help shape and scale the strategy behind one of Databricks' most important growth engines: our Global Systems Integrator partnerships. The impact you'll have Be the strategic business partner to the VP of Global Systems Integrators. Know the GSI partners, programs, and numbers well enough to surface risks, opportunities, and recommendations before you're asked. Own the operating cadence for the GSI business. Run the rhythm of the business and give clear visibility into performance against targets. Lead executive analyses and deliverables, such as board materials and QBRs, with a point of view, not just data. Define and run high-impact cross-functional programs end to end, from strategy through execution. Turn data and voice of the field into a better SI strategy. Dig into GSI performance trends and drive them to action that improves SI strategy and programs. Guide annual GTM planning for the GSI business: FY and long-range modeling, KPI setting, and HC planning. What we look for Relevant experience. 7+ years of strategy & operations experience (e.g., Enterprise SaaS, top-tier strategy consulting, investment banking, business operations). Business ownership. You have the leadership and confidence to partner with VP-level GTM stakeholders like you own the business, not support them from the sidelines. Relentless problem solving. You love to analyze, set priorities, and solve complex problems. You dig deeper to find root causes, and you're not afraid to ask questions. AI and technical fluency. AI and data tools are part of your daily workflow for analysis, problem solving, data visualization, and automation. You keep learning and growing your skills, and you know the common GTM tech stack (Databricks, SFDC, Tableau, SQL, etc.). Comfort with ambiguity. Our GSI business is growing fast in scope and complexity, so things won't always be clean or easy. You embrace that challenge and are excited to build for scale. SI ecosystem fluency. You understand the Systems Integrator, GTM, or sales/partner operating model, and you have the judgment to weigh tradeoffs within it. What this role isn't Not an order-taker or reporting function. You're expected to partner with the VP of Global Systems Integrators to set strategy and own outcomes, not wait for tasks to be assigned. Not a pure strategy role. You'll lead execution of the initiatives you help define. Building processes and consensus is part of the job, not optional. Not a static environment. The GSI business keeps expanding in scope and complexity. If you prefer clean, well-defined problems, this isn't the right fit. Pay Range Transparency Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected base salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipated utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here . Zone 1 Pay Range $162,900 — $223,950 USD Zone 2 Pay Range $146,600 — $201,500 USD Zone 3 Pay Range $138,500 — $190,400 USD Zone 4 Pay Range $130,300 — $179,200 USD About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here . Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: US - Remote Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. About the Role: You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. We're looking for a results-oriented Demand Marketing Manager with proven B2B SaaS experience to lead one of Wrike's flagship global integrated campaigns. These campaigns bring together product, industry and buyer-journey strategy into a coordinated program that generates pipeline, accelerates deals and drives expansion across our customer base. This is a hybrid role: part campaign leader, part hands-on practitioner. You'll own the campaign strategy, plan, budget and results. You'll also directly execute sponsored media and email/nurture programs. At the same time, you'll orchestrate the work of partner teams, including digital, ABM, field and events, and webinars, and make sure it all stays aligned with campaign goals and messaging. You'll partner closely with product marketing, customer marketing, content, digital, field and regional marketing, ABM, sales development, and marketing operations. The ideal candidate has managed complex, multi-region campaigns, thrives in a metrics-driven environment, and uses Wrike to run their own work. Your Impact: Campaign Strategy & Planning Own the integrated campaign brief, strategy and roadmap, aligned to company priorities, product launches, target industries and personas, and buyer journeys. Define the approach for both new-customer acquisition (Land) and existing-customer growth (Expand), including audiences, messaging and channel mix for each. Translate positioning from product marketing into campaign themes and use-case-led messaging that resonates with enterprise buying committees. Manage the campaign budget, allocating investment across channels and adjusting based on performance. Execution (Hands-On) Plan, launch and optimize sponsored media programs, including content syndication (including regional and local-language placements), sponsored webinars and virtual events, podcast sponsorships, and industry publication newsletter or dedicated email placements. Select and manage third-party media and event vendors, negotiate placements within budget, and track delivery and results. Build and manage email, nurture and lifecycle programs for prospects and existing customers, including customer newsletters and workflow- or role-based nurture streams. Brief creative and content teams, and manage production and launch of the assets each tactic needs. Monitor performance, run tests and optimize against targets for actions, MQLs, meetings and pipeline. Program Oversight & Cross-Functional Leadership Oversee the programs run by partner teams, including paid digital (managed by the digital team), ABM (1:1 and 1:few), events (field, executive and customer events), and Wrike-hosted webinars and "deminars", and keep them aligned to campaign strategy, messaging, timelines and goals. Integrate those programs with sponsored media and nurture into one coherent buyer journey, including follow-up and sales handoff. Work with sales and sales development to ensure campaign assets, plays and follow-up cadences support target accounts and pipeline goals. Balance global strategy with regional relevance, including localization, regional events and partner activity, across EMEA, the Americas and APJ. Workflow & Operations Run campaign planning in Wrike, including briefs, templates, dependencies, workback schedules and creative requests, to keep a large cross-functional program visible and on track. Work with marketing operations to build, QA and track programs across tools such as Marketo, Salesforce, 6sense and Tableau. Identify risks, resolve conflicts and escalate when needed to keep the program on schedule. Measurement & Optimization Define campaign KPIs across target-account coverage, engagement, intent, actions/MQLs, meetings, pipeline and revenue, including both sourced and influenced contribution. Establish baselines and measure impact on target accounts, then use the data to recommend and drive optimizations. Report regularly to senior leadership through dashboards, presentations and Wrike updates. Your Qualifications: 5–7 years of experience in B2B SaaS demand generation or integrated campaign roles, including leading large, multi-channel or multi-region programs. Hands-on experience executing sponsored media, content syndication and email/nurture programs. Experience leading both acquisition and expansion campaigns, with exposure to ABM. Demonstrated ability to align many workstreams and stakeholders across digital, events, webinars, ABM and sales outreach, including programs you don't directly own. Experience owning or managing a program budget and working with third-party vendors. Hands-on experience with work management tools (preferably Wrike) for campaign planning and collaboration. Familiarity with marketing automation, CRM and ABM tools such as Marketo, Salesforce, Tableau, 6sense or Sendoso. Strong project management skills, attention to detail and a data-driven mindset. Comfort working across time zones with global teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience marketing to complex enterprise or industry-specific buyers, such as manufacturing. Ownership of campaign workstreams in Wrike, including templates, dependencies and reporting. Experience coordinating localized campaigns, regional events and partner co-marketing. Understanding of enterprise SaaS buyer journeys and content strategies that support multi-stakeholder decisions. Our Work Style: A high-impact role on a high-performing demand generation team. A collaborative team culture that values initiative and innovation. Opportunity to make a direct contribution to revenue growth and brand visibility. Competitive salary, full benefits, and flexible working environment. Benefits & Perks: Flexible Time Off (FTO) Company 401(k) Match Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 2 Volunteer Days Health Insurance (Employees + Dependents) Disability (STD, LTD) & Life Insurance Plans Working from Home Allowance ($40 / Monthly) $500 Working from Home home office set-up Stipend Your recruitment buddy will be Aziza Talhi , Senior Recruiter. #LI-AT1 The range below reflects the total on-target earnings (including base salary and performance-based bonus potential) for this full-time position and applies to all U.S. locations, excluding benefits and other incentives. The final offer within this range will consider factors such as the role, seniority level, geographic location, and employment contract type. An individual’s work location, unique skills, experience, and relevant educational background will also influence the final offer. For tailored compensation details based on your preferred location, please discuss with your recruiter during the hiring process. Total compensation pay range $101,500 — $130,000 USD Who Is Wrike and Our Culture We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow. Hybrid work mode Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations. While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection. Our persona Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched. Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too! Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. Our culture and Values Customer-Focused We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind. Collaborative We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement. Creative We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. Committed We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth. Check out our LinkedIn Life Page , Company culture page , Instagram , Wrike Engineering Team , Medium , Meetup.com , Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-senior-demand-generation-marketing-manager
