items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Germany (Remote) Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity Grafana Labs is looking for a Commercial Account Executive, Growth based in Germany who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across DACH. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before. What You’ll Be Doing Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals Outbound prospecting into net-new customers Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations) Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests What Makes You a Great Fit: 2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer) Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually Fluent in English & German Bonus Points For: Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage Experience using Salesforce Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal Compensation & Rewards In Germany, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 175,000 - EUR 185,000 . Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/grafana-labs-commercial-account-executive-growth-remote-germany

items.description: Why Socure? Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Automation team. You will play a critical role in designing and building scalable data platforms and pipelines that power Socure’s identity verification products and analytics. This role is ideal for someone who has a strong passion for solving real business problems with data, and combines deep hands-on data engineering expertise with strong ownership. What You'll Do • Design and build batch and streaming data pipelines to support automated data ingestion, ML feature engineering and analytics across multiple product domains. • Own end-to-end delivery of complex, ambiguous data initiatives, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and documentation. • Develop and evolve the data platform to support large-scale data processing using modern cloud-native technologies. • Automate data operations (validation, quality checks, alerting, backfills, and recovery workflows) to reduce manual effort and improve consistency. • Optimize cost, performance, and reliability of data workloads. • Partner closely with cross-functional teams (Data Science, Product, Engineering) to understand requirements, translate them into technical solutions. • Evaluate and adopt new technologies (new processing engines, storage formats, orchestration tools, GenAI-assisted ingestion) to keep the platform modern and efficient. What You Bring • 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, building and maintaining production-grade data platforms and pipelines. • Strong programming skills in general-purpose language (such as Python or Scala) for data processing, and SQL for data analytics. • Deep experience with distributed data processing frameworks, such as Apache Spark, including performance tuning and optimization. • Proven experience building data solutions using services on AWS (EMR, Lambda, s3, etc). • Strong understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts, including partitioning, schema design for large-scale datasets. • Experience operating and supporting production pipelines, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and improving reliability over time. • Solid foundation in software engineering practices, including version control, CI/CD, testing strategies, and code review. • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with streaming or near-real-time data processing (Kafka, Kinesis, etc). • Hands-on experience with data orchestration tools (Airflow, Step Functions, etc). • Familiarity with modern data platform patterns such as Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh, and large-scale data sharing across teams. • Experience with prompt engineering using modern GenAI, Large Language Models (LLM). • Experience mentoring other engineers and contributing to engineering-wide standards, best practices. As a note; Socure cannot provide sponsorship now or in the future for this role. Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly. Follow Us! YouTube | LinkedIn | X (Twitter) | Facebook

items.description: About Wurl , LLC. At Wurl, our mission is to create innovative technologies and services that help accelerate the shift to streaming. At our core, we are innovators focused on driving the streaming industry forward with technologies that help connect viewers to the right content and ads. Our technology and data-driven solutions help companies reach new audiences, engage high-value viewers, and ultimately increase their revenue. In 2022, Wurl was acquired by AppLovin (Nasdaq: APP), a leading marketing platform, giving our employees the best of both worlds: the dynamic environment of a 150+ person startup as well as the stability of a high-growth public tech company. We invest in providing a culture that fosters passion, drives excellence, and encourages collaboration to drive innovation. Wurl is a fully-remote company that has been globally recognized for our people and technology, having been named a Great Place to Work by Fortune in 2022, 2023, and 2024; an Ad Tech Company of the Year finalist by the UK Business Tech Awards in 2023; a BIG Innovation Awards winner in 2024 and 2025; and the “Innovation in Advertising” winner by the StreamTV Awards in 2024. We’re looking for a Data Engineering Intern to assist in enhancing the quality and reliability of our data collection platform. This role will provide hands-on experience in data engineering, security operations, and cloud infrastructure, with guidance from experienced engineers and cross-functional teams. What You’ll Do Review and validate ETL processes for completeness and data consistency. Improve our data-consistency validation processes by migrating legacy and semi-manual validation processes to our new framework. Assist in developing monitoring and alerting systems for data consistency and configuration integrity. Work with the data team to analyze, streamline, automate, and improve ETL processes, including ingestion of new data sources. In particular, you’ll focus on improving the automation of our data-related channel-launch processes. Contribute to internal documentation and knowledge bases related to ETL, validation, and alerting procedures. Learn about and contribute to large-scale, cloud-native data systems. What You Bring Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field. GPA of 3.5 or more Familiarity with SQL and Python. Understanding of basic cloud concepts (AWS preferred). Proven experience with industry-grade database solutions and with AWS (1+ years) Experience with ETL creation Agentic experience when it comes to the above 1+ years of relevant past internships Strong interest in data analysis and automation.. Eagerness to learn and contribute to a fast-paced, remote engineering team. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Availability of at least 20 hours per week for at least 6 months Location US/CA Remote What We Offer Paid internship with flexible scheduling. Remote-first work culture and support. items.title: 🌍 Finance Research Expert, Remote- Contract
items.summary: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: • Equity Research • FP&A • Corporate Finance • Accounting or Audit • Investor Relations • Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: • Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours • Location: Remote, worldwide • You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP • Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: • You will work on questions about real US public companies.
items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence. (Securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works: Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Renton, Washington, United States URL: http://www.hasbro.com We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime. This is a temporary assignment through Workwell supporting Wizards of the Coast. Job Overview This Contract Senior Editor role offers an outstanding opportunity to help lead the editorial voice and excellence of the world's greatest roleplaying game. Join our ambitious team and contribute to shaping content that inspires, informs, and empowers players around the world. Working closely with designers, producers, and fellow editors, you will take ownership of the editorial process for select products—especially those focused on narrative, setting, or system-neutral content—and help uphold the high standards that define the Dungeons & Dragons experience. Location and Work Arrangement This is a remote role open to candidates who reside and will work in an eligible U.S. state. Currently, we are unable to employ candidates working from Alaska, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, North Dakota, Vermont, or Washington, D.C. What You'll Do Lead editorial planning and execution on full product releases ensuring clarity, tone, consistency, and structural polish. Collaborate with designers, producers, and fellow editors to refine content across the Universes Beyond product line. Edit and synthesize multi-author contributions, including outsourced content, into a cohesive player-facing experience. Provide feedback to junior editors and freelancers, supporting consistent editorial quality across projects. Contribute to maintaining and evolving internal style guides, standard methodologies for editorial work, and documentation for contributors. Support editorial quality assurance (QA), integration, and final delivery across formats and platforms, ensuring content readiness for publication or release. What You'll Bring 5+ years of experience in editing—ideally in games or another technical editing field. Outstanding grammar, language, and copyediting skills, with a deep understanding of tone, clarity, pacing, and voice across large-scale content. Familiarity with Dungeons & Dragons systems, lore, and stylistic conventions for both print and digital publishing. Ability to prioritize clear, player-friendly text, preserve the original author's voice, and recognize the designers' solutions to development problems while editing. Experience leading editorial workflows on content with multiple contributors, complex structure, or cross-departmental dependencies. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and confidence managing feedback loops with multiple collaborators. What Sets You Apart Experience editing for modular game systems, interactive tools, or platform-native content. Familiarity with digital-first content production. A background in editorial operations or process design within creative teams. Employment Details This is a temporary assignment supporting Wizards of the Coast. The selected individual will be employed and paid by Workwell as a W-2 employee and will not be an employee of Wizards of the Coast or Hasbro. Employment Type: Temporary Assignment Location: US Remote Duration: 12 months Hourly Pay Range: $40.00 - $55.00 USD In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the hourly pay range for this role. Benefits through Workwell For US: Workwell offers temporary workers in the United States medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as paid time off, holiday pay, a health savings account, an employee assistance program, a 401(k) retirement plan, and paid sick leave. Paid sick leave may vary by location. For Canada: Workwell offers temporary workers in Canada extended health care, dental coverage, employer-sponsored life and AD&D insurance, paid sick leave, paid time off, and holiday pay. Paid-leave benefits may vary by location. Who We Are We’re a team of creators, storytellers, and innovators united under the Hasbro family and home to beloved brands, AAA digital games studios and immersive experiences that spark imagination across generations. Together, we’re committed to a culture rooted in creativity, excellence, curiosity, and inclusion and where every employee is empowered to think boldly, act with integrity, and spark joy for all. Additionally, employees may be eligible for annual and long-term incentives as part of their overall compensation package. Pay Range $40 — $55 USD Employees may be eligible for annual and long-term incentives as part of their overall compensation package, depending on role, location, and eligibility. items.description: Product Headquarters: Germany (Remote) ; Ireland (Remote); Netherlands (Remote) ; Portugal (Remote) ; United Kingdom (Remote) Who we are Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot. About the role At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human. We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working. This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates. You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes. Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations. What you'll do Own and improve our IT operations Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution. Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems. Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management. Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience. Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects. Build smarter systems through AI and automation Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT. Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency. Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes. Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work. Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance. Think like a product owner Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements. Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact. Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs. Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience. Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning. Collaborate across Typeform Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues. Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members. Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation. What you'll bring Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company. ITIL certification and practical experience applying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management. Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations. Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian. Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools. Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity. Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management. Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution. A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams. Nice to have Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations. Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems. Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms. Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting. Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance. Experience leading technology migrations or large internal systems improvement projects. *Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team , empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/typeform-senior-it-engineer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Poland (Remote) Who We Are At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more. About the Opportunity We are looking for a dedicated and proactive Senior Business Development Manager to join our team. As a Business Development Manager, you will play a key role in expanding our network of Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and affiliates in Poland. This role is responsible for those partnerships from a to z. What You'll Be Doing Expert Knowledge: Demonstrate extensive knowledge of the trading and crypto industries, including market trends, regulations, and key players, to make informed business decisions. Affiliate Recruitment: Proactively search for and attract new affiliates, VIP traders and trading/crypto communities and influencers, fostering strategic partnerships to enhance our network. Results-Driven Approach: Implement strategies and campaigns to drive measurable results, focusing on creating content, increasing trading volume, acquiring new users, and promoting active transactions through affiliate channels. Relationship Building: Cultivate and maintain strong business relationships with VIP and affiliates, ensuring their needs are met and aligning their strategies with our business objectives for mutual growth. Partnership Expansion: Initiate and participate in meetings with partners, exploring opportunities to expand cooperation and strengthen existing relationships, both locally and internationally. Collaboration with Product Team: Collaborate closely with colleagues from the product department, providing valuable market insights to optimize product offerings and attract qualified users. Competitor Analysis: Stay updated on competitors' advantages and industry trends, utilizing this knowledge to refine our strategies, maintain a competitive edge, and capitalize on market gaps. What We Look For In You Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent years of experience) Fluency in English and Polish Proven experience in affiliate operations, performance marketing, or BD within crypto, finance, or trading - especially in Poland Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience using data/BI tools (e.g. Excel, SQL, Tableau/Looker or similar) to driving decisions Solid understanding of affiliate marketing operations: tracking, attribution, campaign management Highly organized, process-oriented, and comfortable owning operational details end-to-end Goal-oriented mindset, with a focus on measurable results and continuous optimization Understanding of financial market dynamics and regulations relevant to the Polish/Eastern European region Nice to Have Experience working across time zones and cross-cultural teams Bonus points if you have previously worked at a crypto exchange, trading company, CFD broker! Passionate about blockchain technology and the crypto trading space Knowledge of other Eastern European languages is a strong plus Perks & Benefits Competitive total compensation package L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development Various team building programs and company events More that we love to tell you along the process! Our mission is to help small and medium-sized US businesses grow and become more profitable by having access to highly engaged, skilled, and experienced talent at a fair price, and to generate career opportunities for bilingual professionals in Latin America with fair compensation and opportunities for professional and personal growth. We are currently looking for a Marketing Assistant to support marketing and communications efforts. This is a hands-on execution and ownership role for a seasoned marketing professional who can independently manage campaigns, create high-quality content, and help elevate brand presence across all channels. This is not an entry-level role - we are looking for someone who understands marketing strategy, executes at a high level, and brings ideas forward - not just deliverables. In Teamswell, every team member has an instrumental role and impact on the success of our business and our clients’ success, so we seek to have highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced work environment, who are intelligent, eager to work hard, reliable, and able to communicate effectively with all levels of an organization. items.description: We are a leading trading platform that is ambitiously expanding to the four corners of the globe. Our top-rated products have won prestigious industry awards for their cutting-edge technology and seamless client experience. We deliver only the best, so we are always in search of the best people to join our ever-growing talented team. We are hiring a Lead Observability Engineer to design and build our in-house observability platform, including APM. The platform must be resilient, highly available and scalable, adopted by default by every service, and cheaper than an external vendor. This is the first hire of our new Observability team, so you will also hire and lead the people who run it. Responsibilities: Design and own the observability platform for metrics, logs, traces and APM across thousands of services and hundreds database clusters, on Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana and OpenSearch. Build APM and distributed tracing for our Java services, linking every alert to the trace and logs behind it. Replace noisy alerts with SLO-based alerting, routed to the owning team on Slack, with automatic escalation and automatic incident creation. Make telemetry on by default: every new service and database is observable from day 1, without a ticket. Make the platform resilient to the loss of a zone or a whole region, and make sure we know when the platform itself is down. Keep costs under control, with costs and limits per team, and show that in house is cheaper than a vendor. Hire and grow the Observability team, and work with SRE, DBRE, Security and product teams to get adoption without becoming a gatekeeper. Requirements: 6+ years of experience designing and running observability platforms at scale: millions of active series, terabytes of logs per day. Deep hands-on knowledge of Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, and OpenTelemetry. Experience delivering APM and tracing that engineers use during incidents. Infrastructure as code as your normal way of working, for the platform as well as dashboards and alerts. We care about the practice, not a specific tool. Experience with SLOs, error budgets and alerting that people trust. Strong Kubernetes and AWS experience. Experience leading engineers, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs and costs to senior stakeholders. Nice to have: Experience replacing a commercial observability vendor with an in-house platform. Experience in financial services or another regulated environment. Experience with Kafka-based telemetry pipelines and tail-based sampling. What you will get in return: Competitive Salary: We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated. Work-Life Harmony: Join a company that genuinely cares about you - because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock. #LI-Hybrid Annual Performance Bonus: Your hard work doesn’t go unnoticed! Celebrate your achievements with a well-deserved annual bonus tied to your performance. Generous Time Off: Need a breather? Our annual leave policy lets you recharge and enjoy life outside of work without a worry. Employee Referral Program: Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team. Comprehensive Health & Pension Benefits: From medical insurance to pension plans, we’ve got your back. Plus, location-specific benefits and perks! Workation Wonderland: Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits! Volunteer Days: Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. What you will do as a Manager, Customer Engineering The Manager, Customer Engineering leads a team of Customer Engineers (CE) who own the full customer technical journey from initial discovery through long-term adoption, retention, and account expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Senior Leader, you will be responsible for building, coaching, and enabling a high-performing team of quota-carrying technologists. You will ensure your team leverages AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil and focus on high-value architectural design, technical validation, and the delivery of measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey. This is a player-coach role where you have the ability and willingness to step into the field and lead by example. You will manage daily, forecast weekly, and hire always while remaining deeply connected to the technical, commercial, and operational realities of the customer engineering motion. Key Responsibilities Team Development & Performance: Recruit, onboard, coach, and retain a diverse team of Customer Engineers across multiple levels. Set clear expectations, conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and maintain a strong feedback culture that accelerates growth. Pipeline & Forecasting: Manage your team’s opportunity pipeline, forecast new business and expansion outcomes weekly, and own the accuracy of your team’s number. Identify risk early and coach reps on deal strategy. Commercial Accountability: Be accountable for your team’s achievement of new business acquisition, expansion, adoption, and consumption targets. Partner closely with Sales, Customer Experience, Professional Services, and regional leadership on account planning and execution. Deal Coaching & Technical Strategy: Accompany Customer Engineers on critical customer calls, QBRs, discovery sessions, and PoC reviews. Provide real-time coaching on architecture, commercial positioning, and executive communication. Operational Excellence: Ensure the team operates efficiently within established GTM processes (forecasting, opportunity management, account planning, QBR cadence). Use dashboards and operational reviews to spot trends, unblock friction, and drive consistency. AI & Productivity Enablement: Champion the adoption of AI agents, LLMs, and automation tools across the team. Identify opportunities to reduce toil, improve response quality, and scale technical advisory impact. Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the voice of your team and your territory in leadership meetings. Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing, and Enablement to surface field feedback and advocate for customer and team needs. Culture & Values: Model Cloudflare’s values and build an inclusive, high-performance team culture rooted in curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement. Minimum Qualifications Experience: 5+ Years of proven experience leading quota carrying customer-facing technical teams in a SaaS, cloud, or infrastructure environment. Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining technical talent. Prior quota-carrying Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Sales Engineering, or related technical field experience is strongly preferred. Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly enough to guide coaching and deal review. Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives. Revenue Acumen: Demonstrated success owning and forecasting a revenue number, preferably in an enterprise B2B SaaS or infrastructure environment. Deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles, SaaS metrics, ACV, renewal, and expansion motions. Leadership & Coaching: Excellent people management skills with the ability to coach technical sellers through complex deals, difficult conversations, and career growth. Comfortable giving direct, actionable feedback. Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication with the ability to influence executives, peers, and cross-functional teams. Capable of representing the team in executive QBRs and regional business reviews. AI Proficiency: Familiarity with AI-augmented workflows, LLMs, and automation approaches that improve team productivity. Willing to lead by example in adopting AI tools. Technical Fluency: We do not expect managers to be hands-on engineers across every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate fluency in at least two or three of the following technical areas, with the ability to follow architecture discussions and coach reps: Internet fundamentals: Strong foundational understanding of how the Internet works, including DNS, HTTP(S), TCP/IP, and SSL/TLS. Security: Foundational knowledge of security concepts such as WAF, Bot Management, Zero Trust, SASE, and threat mitigation. Performance: Foundational knowledge of performance concepts such as caching, latency, content delivery, and traffic steering. Platform / Cloud Fluency: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, edge services, APIs, automation, or developer tooling. Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The “Good-to-Haves”) Cloudflare Ecosystem Expertise: Experience with Cloudflare’s product portfolio or familiarity with CDN, security edge, Zero Trust, developer platform, or AI workloads. Scaled Management Experience: Experience managing managers or teams distributed across regions and time zones. GTM Process Design: Track record of improving operational cadence, enablement, and forecasting discipline within a fast-growing technical sales organization. Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, or FedRAMP. Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth. Education: Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. Travel This role may require travel up to 25–50% to attend customer meetings, team offsites, industry events, and in-person collaboration. Compensation This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tied directly to team performance against new business acquisition, expansion, adoption, and retention targets. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Digital Native Account Executives at Cloudflare sell into the most innovative companies in Benelux. The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams. Responsibilities Develop, execute, and maintain a strategic account plan for your named accounts to exceed quarterly sales targets and annual quota assignment across Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg. Be an expert in three unique sales motions: new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross-sell of Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your named account list. Lead complex, multi-product, six- and seven-figure opportunities from first conversation through to contract negotiation, partnering closely with Solution Engineers, Customer Success and Legal. Build a robust sales pipeline utilizing the four sourcing funnels: AE-led outbound, BDR, Channel, and Marketing Inbound and VCs Build relationships with the Benelux technology ecosystem - venture capital and growth investors, scale-up communities, cloud and technology partners - to identify high-growth companies early and become their trusted infrastructure partner. items.description: What is PerfectServe? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! About the role PerfectServe is investing in a unified data platform spanning our product portfolio — the data store, the shared taxonomy, and the pipelines that will let the business answer questions across the whole platform. Our architecture team has mapped the high-level direction and target state. The detailed design is deliberately still open. This is the senior engineering seat that takes it from direction to working platform. You will shape the detailed architecture alongside our architecture team, own the implementation and integration design, and set the engineering standards the team works to — building it with a dedicated team. Why this role, specifically We have done real thinking here — the high-level direction and target state are mapped, and the business case is made and funded. What is deliberately not settled is almost everything below that line. We would rather hire someone with strong opinions about it than fill it in ourselves before you arrive. That is where the consequential decisions live — how entities resolve consistently across a broad portfolio, how time is modeled so a question about last quarter resolves against last quarter's reality, how a metric gets defined once and trusted everywhere. Cheap to get right now, expensive to correct later. So you get a direction to work from and an architecture team to partner with, plus genuine influence over both. If you would rather bring your experience to bear on a platform while it is being built than inherit one that is already set, this is that role. What you will do Own the implementation design across the platform — ingestion, modeling, and the surfaces people consume Shape the detailed architecture from the high-level direction, working with our architecture team Own integration design across a varied set of production source systems Build ingestion pipelines from those systems Model raw data into business-ready datasets, with one agreed definition per metric Set the engineering standards the team works to, including data quality and testing Partner with our platform and operations teams on safe, low-impact extraction from production databases Work directly with the people who need the data, so what gets built answers real questions Mentor data engineers and help shape their work What you bring Substantial experience building and operating cloud data platforms, ideally including one you designed from scratch Comfort making decisions with incomplete information, and the judgement to know which ones are expensive to get wrong Deep SQL, and strong command of a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks or similar) A transformation framework such as dbt, with clear opinions on how to structure a project ELT and change-data-capture experience across relational sources AWS — read replicas, object storage, and moving data between regions without surprises Dimensional or medallion modeling, applied rather than theoretical Workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect or similar) and data quality testing as a habit Nice to have Healthcare data, and experience handling protected health information Multi-tenant data isolation Semantic layer or metrics layer design Modern BI and self-serve reporting tooling Why Join PerfectServe? At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission‑driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation. We offer a salary range of $170,000–$200,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and growth potential. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. Compensation is determined by several factors, including experience, skills, and team impact. We regularly review compensation to ensure fairness and consistency. Current employees with questions are encouraged to connect with their manager or People Operations. Benefits: Remote first work environment Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one. 401K - with match and immediately vested. 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy Internal Advancement Opportunities PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: Remote Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025). The Role We're hiring a Nurse Practitioner to serve as the primary clinical point of contact for patients navigating their remote care journey. In this role, you will lead clinical decision-making with a strong emphasis on guideline-directed medical therapy for heart failure, as well as adherence to evidence-based guidelines for type 2 diabetes and hypertension, including proactive and asynchronous medication titration based on patient vitals, symptoms, and trends. You will oversee patients, manage clinical escalations, and collaborate closely with the patient’s physician or provider to optimize treatment plans, adjust medications, and determine the appropriate level of care. This role requires a high level of clinical autonomy, strong judgment, and close collaboration with Registered Nurses and Patient Success teams to deliver timely, patient-centered, and scalable remote care. Although this position is fully remote, it is a highly collaborative, fast-paced clinical role with clear expectations for productivity, responsiveness, and quality. Licensure Requirements Required: Active Compact Multi-State RN license. Required: Active NP licensure in MS. Licenses must be active and in good standing at time of hire. Schedule Requirements This role is fully remote. Monday through Friday schedule with a core shift schedule of 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Central Time. What You'll Do Manage a panel of patients receiving remote care, making timely clinical decisions based on evidence-based guidelines for heart failure, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes. Deliver high-quality, evidence-based care by following established clinical protocols and workflows while applying sound clinical judgment to individual patient needs. Initiate and titrate guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) while collaborating closely with physicians, RNs, and care teams to optimize outcomes. Respond promptly to clinical escalations generated through remote patient monitoring, including abnormal vitals, symptoms, and laboratory results. Provide both synchronous and asynchronous patient care, including reviewing patient-generated health data, responding to remote patient monitoring alerts, communicating through secure messaging, and conducting scheduled virtual visits when appropriate. Deliver safe, efficient, high-quality care while consistently meeting established productivity and documentation expectations. Adapt quickly to evolving workflows, software enhancements, and operational processes as we continuously improve our care model. Use multiple technology platforms confidently and provide feedback that helps improve our clinical operations and technology. Collaborate across clinical and operational teams to identify opportunities to improve patient care, efficiency, and scalability. Help shape the future of a rapidly growing digital health organization where every team member contributes to building better processes—not simply following established ones. These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management. Who You Are Successful Nurse Practitioners at Cadence: Balance exceptional patient care with strong operational efficiency. Are comfortable working in an environment where workflows evolve rapidly as we grow. Embrace change and view new technology and processes as opportunities rather than obstacles. Consistently meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality clinical decision making. Communicate proactively when they encounter barriers or identify opportunities for improvement. Take ownership of problems and work collaboratively to solve them. What You Need Active Compact Multi-State RN license. Active NP licensure in MS. Ability to consistently work Central time hours, including later weekday coverage as needed 5+ years experience treating patients with chronic diseases (CHF, Hypertension, T2D) either in an outpatient or inpatient setting at a high-performing medical center. 3+ years of cardiology experience with a focus on heart failure management and guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT). Active ANCC or AANP certification. Master’s Degree as a Nurse Practitioner with the willingness to expand state licensure as Cadence adds new markets and partners. Home office setup with consistently stable Wi-Fi with strong upload and download speeds. A Wi-Fi speed test is required during the interview process to verify that these standards are met. Demonstrated success working in fast-paced environments where priorities, workflows, and technology evolve frequently. Comfortable receiving frequent feedback and continuously adapting processes. Highly organized with excellent time management and the ability to balance patient care with productivity expectations. Self-directed and accountable while working remotely with minimal supervision. Curious, resilient, and energized by helping build new ways of delivering care. Experience working in a CHF bridge clinic or T2D clinic, a startup environment, and working with remote patient monitoring technology is preferred. Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini, Open Evidence, or comparable platforms) while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://impulseuniverse.com Benefits: Bonus based on performance Company parties Flexible schedule About the Event America’s largest Lunar New Year spectacle is back and bolder than ever! Spanning 7 massive halls with over 1,400 vendors, the Asian American Expo brings you the ultimate celebration of mouthwatering Asian street food, nonstop cultural performances, and high-energy excitement. Step into the Year of the Ram, grab your official Red Envelope at the door, and get ready to experience the luckiest weekend of the year! About the Role We are seeking a high-energy, results-obsessed Marketing Contractor to drive direct ticket sales for the Asian American Expo 2027, America’s largest Lunar New Year celebration (7 massive halls, 1,400+ vendors, and hourly cash Red Envelope prize drops taking place January 16–17, 2027 at the Fairplex in Pomona, CA). This is NOT a brand awareness or vanity metrics role. We are looking for a direct-response outreach strategist whose sole focus is converting Southern California local audiences into paying ticket holders through nano/micro-influencers and grassroots digital community channels. Core Responsibilities Nano & Micro-Influencer Acquisition: Identify, pitch, and onboard local SoCal nano/micro-influencers (foodies, lifestyle, family, culture, and local deals) with active, hyper-local followings to promote the Asian American Expo. Grassroots Community Marketing: Actively seat promotional messaging, ticket offers, and event announcements across regional SoCal Facebook groups, local community forums, Nextdoor, Reddit, and cultural community boards. Direct-Response Campaign Execution: Focus messaging around high-converting hooks, specifically highlighting the event scale, food night market, and the "Luckiest Weekend of the Year" Red Envelope cash/prize drops. Weekly Conversion Tracking: Monitor link clicks, promo code redemptions, and ticket conversion rates, optimizing or sunsetting non-performing partnerships weekly. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Primary Metric: Total Event Ticket Sales & Revenue Generated (analyzed on a day by day snapshot compared to last year). Secondary Metric: Number of activated, high-converting local SoCal creators actively posting and driving trackable sales. Qualifications & Requirements Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience in direct-response marketing, affiliate management, event ticketing, or conversion-focused influencer outreach. SoCal Market Familiarity: Deep understanding of Southern California sub-markets, local food culture, Asian community networks, and regional interest groups (LA, SGV, Orange County, IE). Outreach Hustle: Strong negotiation and persuasion skills to quickly secure high-converting partnerships on lean timelines. Tools: Proficiency with Google Workspace, affiliate/promo tracking tools, Meta/Facebook group networking, and social outreach management. How to Apply Submit your resume along with 1–2 examples of previous campaigns where you directly drove sales or ticket conversions through grassroots outreach or creator partnerships. This is a remote position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/impulse-universe-inc-asian-american-expo-marketing-local-community-influencer-outreach

items.description: Popis společnosti Turner & Townsend je globální společnost poskytující profesionální služby s více než 22 000 zaměstnanci ve více než 60 zemích světa. Spolupracujeme s našimi klienty v oblasti nemovitostí, infrastruktury, energetiky a přírodních zdrojů a společně realizujeme projekty, které zlepšují kvalitu života lidí. Díky úzké spolupráci jsme schopni dodávat jedny z nejvýznamnějších projektů a programů na světě, přičemž proměňujeme výzvy v příležitosti a složitost v úspěch. Naše odborné služby zahrnují řízení programů a projektů, cost management, asset a commercial management, project controls a performance management, procurement a supply chain, strategie pro dosažení uhlíkové neutrality (Net Zero) a digitální řešení. Popis nabídky práce Na této pozici se budete věnovat technickému poradenství v oblasti komerčních nemovitostí. Vaším hlavním úkolem bude posuzování technického stavu budov, identifikace případných závad a rizik a doporučování vhodných řešení. Budete se podílet především na technických auditech nemovitostí (Technical Due Diligence) pro investory a nájemce, ale také na projektech rekonstrukcí, modernizací a technického zhodnocení budov. Co bude Vaší náplní práce? Provádění technických auditů komerčních nemovitostí (Technical Due Diligence) v rámci jejich nákupu, prodeje, pronájmu nebo financování. Posuzování technického stavu budov na základě dostupné projektové a technické dokumentace a osobních prohlídek nemovitostí. Kontrola stavebních konstrukcí, střech, fasád, obálky budov, požární bezpečnosti a souladu s platnými stavebními předpisy. Identifikace technických závad, rizik a nedostatků v údržbě, včetně návrhů vhodných nápravných opatření. Příprava odborných technických zpráv, doporučení a odhadů nákladů na potřebné opravy či rekonstrukce. Posuzování souladu nemovitostí s legislativními požadavky a zohledňování principů udržitelnosti. Spolupráce s českými i mezinárodními klienty, především v oblasti kancelářských, logistických, rezidenčních, obchodních a hotelových nemovitostí. Většina technických zpráv a dalších výstupů bude připravována v angličtině. Kvalifikace Máte vzdělání nebo odpovídající odbornou kvalifikaci v oblasti stavebnictví, architektury nebo technické správy budov. Máte alespoň 5 let relevantních pracovních zkušeností. Máte přímou praktickou zkušenost s prováděním technických auditů nemovitostí (Technical Due Diligence), například v souvislosti s jejich akvizicí, prodejem, pronájmem nebo financováním. Dokážete samostatně posoudit technický stav budovy, identifikovat stavební závady a technická rizika a navrhnout vhodná nápravná opatření. Orientujete se ve stavebních konstrukcích, českých stavebních předpisech, povolovacích procesech a požární bezpečnosti. Plynule komunikujete anglicky, a to slovem i písmem. Dokážete připravovat srozumitelné odborné zprávy a technickou dokumentaci v angličtině. Umíte samostatně analyzovat technické problémy, vyhodnocovat rizika a formulovat odborné závěry. Jste pečliví, dobře organizovaní a zvládáte pracovat na více projektech současně, často s krátkými termíny. Dokážete jasně komunikovat své závěry, obhájit odborný názor a jednat s klienty i dalšími účastníky projektu. Ovládáte MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Máte řidičský průkaz skupiny B a jste ochotni cestovat podle potřeb projektů. Další informace Co nabízíme? Zajímavou finanční odměnu Práci v úspěšné mezinárodní společnosti Vedení zajímavých projektů pro nadnárodní firmy Plný úvazek s flexibilní pracovní dobou a možností home office - záleží nám na dodržení termínů a kvalitě výsledku, ne na tom, jestli jsi v kanceláři od 9 do 17 Skvěle fungující a soudržný tým, který tě vždycky podpoří a ocení tvoje úspěchy Zázemí moderních kanceláří v centru Prahy včetně všech výhod s tím spojených Celofiremní akce a k tomu ještě navíc 3x do roka sportovně laděné nezapomenutelné teambuildingy Standardem je pět týdnů dovolené, příspěvek na stravování formou stravenkového paušálu (100 Kč /den), 2 dny zdravotního volna, narozeninové volno, volno na dobročinné účely, příspěvek na penzijní připojištění, Multisport karta, jazykové kurzy, finanční odměna za doporučení kolegy, neomezené množství výborné kávy, notebook, mobilní telefon a v neposlední řadě u nás podporujeme kariérní růst - nabízíme pestrý školící program, který je k dispozici všem Naši zaměstnanci sdílejí naši vizi a poslání. Nabízíme inspirativní pracovní prostředí, kde má každý příležitost přispět svými nápady a ovlivňovat pozitivní změny. Chceme, aby naši zaměstnanci byli úspěšní nejen v práci, ale i v osobním životě. Proto podporujeme zdravé, produktivní a flexibilní pracovní prostředí, které respektuje rovnováhu mezi pracovním a soukromým životem. Společnost Turner & Townsend je zaměstnavatelem poskytujícím rovné příležitosti. Vážíme si rozmanitosti a zavazujeme se vytvářet inkluzivní pracovní prostředí pro všechny zaměstnance. Aktivně podporujeme uchazeče ze všech prostředí a komunit. No recruitment agency working with Turner & Townsend will ask candidates to pay a fee at any time._ Any unsolicited resumes/CVs submitted through our website or to Turner & Townsend personal e-mail accounts, are considered property of Turner & Townsend and are not subject to payment of agency fees.
