Built on a native, AI-powered platform and m
items.description: Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments. Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch. By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com. About this position: Later is seeking a passionate Creative Director to lead our Creative Team and give the brand a distinct point of view in a category that gets louder every day. You will set the creative vision across Later’s brand, then make it real through integrated work spanning digital, video, print, and experiential/events. Reporting directly to the Head of Marketing, you will partner closely with Executive Leadership, Sales Leadership, Strategy Leadership, as well as Events and Growth Marketing teams to turn their priorities into creative that performs across both of Later’s core audiences: senior brand marketers and creators. This is a high-visibility role that sits on the marketing leadership team with regular exposure to executive leadership and direct influence on how the market understands and perceives Later. This role is ideally a hybrid position with 3 days in office in our Boston or New York hubs, but remote applicants will be considered. What you’ll be doing: Brand and creative strategy Understand Later’s target audiences, market trends, business objectives, and business outcomes to help support and optimize marketing strategies with stakeholders Own Later’s brand and creative vision across digital, web, print, and experiential/events (in close collaboration with the events team) Continue to innovate the creative vision to keep Later ahead of the curve Lead concept development for integrated brand campaigns across digital, video, print, and experiential, built for the specific audiences we are trying to reach Lead the evolution of Later’s imagery library while guiding the team to build a scalable process for sourcing, curating, and creating on-brand stock and AI-generated imagery Use your knowledge of the sales cycle, content marketing, and the marketing funnel to streamline creative deliverables/processes for sales enablement and marketing tactics Collaborate with marketing/brand experts to develop and evolve the company’s brand guidelines, empowering the team to apply them consistently and cohesively across all touchpoints Apply best practices and industry standards in brand and conversion design, incorporating persuasive elements, great calls-to-action, and effective use of visual hierarchy and storytelling techniques Build trust through influence by sharing rationale for design decisions via data-driven insights Team leadership Provide strategic direction to coach and grow the Creative Team, ensuring they deliver impactful, on-brand work on time Foster a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing, promoting best practices, and inspiring the team to push the boundaries of design excellence Own the quarterly creative roadmap, including prioritization, resourcing, and timelines, ensuring the team is focused on the highest-impact work and delivering quality work on time Conduct performance evaluations, quarterly coaching sessions, and provide constructive feedback to the team members to enhance their skills and improve their performance Drive efficiency of the team by optimizing processes & workflow Understand and manage internal stakeholder requirements and expectations Set priorities and manage capacity across competing requests, making clear calls about what the team takes on and what it does not Contribute to budget discussions, and manage spend and contractors Cross-functional partnership Partner with Content, Events, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Sales to turn strategic initiatives into creative that delivers business impact Streamline creative intake, briefing, and review so partners know how to work with the team and what to expect Represent Creative in Marketing planning and GTM motions, with regular exposure to senior leadership Deliver consistent creative across Later’s lines of business, including Later Influence, Later Social, and Later for Creators Experimentation and performance Partner with stakeholders to design and run tests on ads, landing pages, and campaign assets, from hypothesis through to result. Analyze test outcomes, identify winning variations, and share what you learn so the next round of work starts smarter. Apply insights to guide the team in refining the design of the customer journey, to improve engagement, conversion rates, and overall experience. Track industry trends, emerging tools, and AI-assisted production methods, and bring the ones worth adopting into the team’s workflow. What success looks like: Within the first 90 days, you know the brand, the team, and the request pipeline well enough to have a clear point of view on how Later’s creative should look and where the current work falls short. By 6 months, brand guidelines have evolved to reflect Later’s ideal/new creative state and consistently applied, and creative intake and review move fast enough that partners stop routing around the process. By 6 months, campaign creative is producing measurable lifts in engagement and conversion, with results shared back across Marketing. Within 12 months, the Creative Team operates as a strategic partner rather than a service desk, with the capability, process, and staffing to support every line of business. Within 12 months, Later’s brand is visibly distinct in the influencer marketing category. Our brand identity and creative output is one of the reasons brands and creators take us seriously. What you bring: We are committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. If you identify with any of the following, we encourage you to apply! A portfolio with real range across digital, web, campaign, and print work, showing that the work performed and not just that it shipped. Experience leading a Creative Team, including hiring, coaching, and performance management. Depth in creative strategy, concept development, and brand storytelling for a B2B or SaaS audience. Fluency with Adobe Creative Cloud and Figma, and comfort directing work in whichever tools the team uses. Comfort with marketing analytics and reporting, and a track record of using data to shape creative decisions. Experience developing and reading A/B tests, and translating results into business and audience insight. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain creative thinking to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong project management instincts, and the ability to keep several workstreams moving in a fast-changing environment. Hands-on understanding of generative AI design tools and workflows (such as Midjourney, Weave, Firefly, or similar), with a strong point of view on how to use them responsibly and on-brand. Experience in the creator, social, or influencer marketing space is a bonus. Experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo or Klaviyo is a bonus. Experience working in an agile marketing setup (Kanban, Scrumban, or similar) is a bonus. Experience building a brand through a rebrand or repositioning is a bonus. How we work: We will do whatever it takes to win: We win when our customers and creators win. We bring full commitment to outcomes that matter, not just effort. We have no limit to our aspiration: We think big, push beyond what seems possible, and refuse to let conventional thinking set the ceiling. We are relentless: We keep going. Through ambiguity, setbacks, and competing priorities, we find a way forward. We deeply understand our business: If we don’t have the knowledge, we figure it out. We take ownership of understanding how Later works and what drives results. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves: We bring rigor and accountability without ego, and we make space for each other to do our best work. Our approach to compensation: We take a market-based and data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors. Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only. To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted. Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package. Salary Range: $160-200k OTE #LI-Hybrid #LI-Remote Where we work: We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located. Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility: At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit . We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change. We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer . All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or age. Please let us know if you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process.

items.title: AI Transformation Lead (Senior Product Owner / Business Analyst)
items.summary: The role You sit with US business owners, find the problem worth solving, build the roadmap, and make sure it pays off.
items.description: The role You sit with US business owners, find the problem worth solving, build the roadmap, and make sure it pays off. You combine three jobs most companies split up: strategy and analysis, project management, and adoption. Within three months you fully lead your own delivery team. This is not an engineering role. Our developers write the code; you decide what gets built, lead the team through it, and make sure the client sees the results. If you've been a Product Owner, Business Analyst or Technical Project Manager, this is your next step. What you will do Lead strategic conversations with business owners and build or realign their roadmap. Turn each initiative into a clear plan: scope, user stories, acceptance criteria and estimates with your team. Run the build with your team and keep scope under control. Make sure the client's team uses what we built, with training and live KPI dashboards that show each person whether they're on track. Review results with the client and show the value in their numbers. Your first 90 days: you will have realigned or built a client's roadmap, delivered one or two initiatives from it, and scheduled the review that shows the client what it's worth. What you bring 6+ years as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Technical Project Manager or consultant, working directly with owners or executives. Roadmaps, user stories and acceptance criteria that developers can build from. Experience leading a small team, or clear readiness to. Proof that people used what you delivered, and a business result you can name with a number. Fluent English, and the ability to explain technical ideas in plain words. At least 3 custom web application projects behind you, and a solid understanding of how systems fit together (data, integrations, AI agents), so you can design the right system with your developers and recommend it with confidence. What we offer $5,000 to $6,000 a month (USD, B2B), plus a monthly team bonus for every sprint point your team delivers. 20 paid days off a year and 5 paid sick days. At least $200 a month for the AI tools you use, with room for more. An intense first month: one-on-one time with the team and both co-founders, and a curriculum on how we get results for clients. We want to learn from your experience too. Room to grow into a bigger leadership role as we scale. Remote. You need to be available for team meetings from 9:00 CET and for US clients in their morning (late afternoon into early evening CET). Central and Eastern Europe preferred; South Africa welcome. Built for people who lead change. This role asks a lot: you'll be the person who helps a client's business change for the better, using AI to give the owner, the team and their customers time for what matters most. If that kind of challenge energizes you, we'd love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Japan Who we are: Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products. Our culture: We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule. We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless. Location: Remote - Japan About the role As we expand globally, we’re looking for passionate QA automation engineer. You’ll be part of global QA team, working closely with both global team and client-facing team in APAC region. This role requires business-level English and Japanese skills. You will design a clear set of test scenarios, decide what to automate and what to keep manual, and work with stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Professional Services, and our clients, including banks. What you'll be doing Own automated coverage for APIs and client-facing dashboard in sandbox and production Be the named QA on APAC bank integrations: structured test scenarios, UAT support, regression tests. Set the automation strategy for the surface you own: what runs in CI, what stays exploratory, and what is better left manual. Work with engineers across the full SDLC and shift left. Join design and planning so quality is in the conversation before code is written. Find, record, and document defects so engineer and customer partners can both act on them. Partner with Professional Services and Post-Sales on structured acceptance testing for bank and enterprise deployments. Own the health of the suites you run in CI so failures are real and actionable. What you'll bring Strong hands-on automation (API first, in TypeScript or JavaScript), with a clear strategy for what to automate. Our suites run on Cypress; Playwright or similar experience transfers. You can organize test scenarios so someone else can read the map: scope, priority, automation vs. evidence. 5+ years in software quality, including owning a product or integration end to end. Great written and verbal communication skills in English and Japanese for both internal and external communication. Strong ownership on everything around quality Hands-on with CI and a habit of keeping suites maintainable. Experience in Software Engineering is a plus Experience in working SaaS company is a plus Nice to have: experience with banks or regulators in APAC (for example data privacy under APPI in Japan); Cypress or similar for the occasional UI path; reading Go (our services and their unit tests); Qase or another test-management tool; prior file-based or batch testing. Benefits we offer: Generous compensation in cash and equity Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture Flexible paid time off and Year-end break Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific MacBook Pro delivered to your door One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc. Monthly meal stipend Monthly social meet-up stipend Annual health and wellness stipend Annual Learning stipend Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you. To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sardine-qa-automation-engineer

We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress. If you're r
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: URL: http://cmswa.com Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress. If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team. About Custom Mechanical Solutions Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support. As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization. Title: Quality & Reliability Engineer Department: CMS National Accounts Location: Fully remote within the United States Travel: Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes. Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales. The opportunity CMS is looking for a Quality & Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure. This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects. Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions. What you will own Lead field-to-factory investigations. Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure. Turn field intelligence into action. Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation. Create field-ready solutions. Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence. Drive clarity and accountability. Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed. Use data to improve the program. Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners. Go where the evidence is. Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness. You will probably love this role if... When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer. You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly. You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed. You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved. You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one. Required qualifications A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience. At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support. Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills. Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure. Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10–20%, including travel to manufacturing facilities in Mexico. A valid passport at the time of hire is preferred; candidates without one must be able to obtain one within the first 90 days of employment. Preferred qualifications Five or more years of relevant quality, reliability, field-service, commissioning, or technical investigation experience. Direct experience with commercial or industrial HVAC equipment. Experience with custom air-handling equipment, controls, construction drawings and specifications, startup, commissioning, or active job-site processes. Experience working directly with manufacturing facilities, suppliers, factory quality teams, or field-service organizations. Experience developing technical repair procedures, Field Service Bulletins, corrective-action documentation, or quality dashboards. Compensation and benefits Base salary: $95,000-$125,000 annually, depending on experience. This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus. Eligible employees may participate in Meriton’s benefits programs in accordance with applicable plan terms. Why CMS National Accounts You will join a fast-moving team supporting complex equipment and significant projects where expectations are high, and the connection between field performance and customer experience matters. This role offers the opportunity to make quality information more complete, corrective actions more durable, repairs more repeatable, and lessons learned more useful across a growing portfolio. If you are ready to solve meaningful technical problems and help build a stronger quality and reliability program, we would like to hear from you. Custom Mechanical Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship. Salary ranges listed are dependent upon a candidate’s qualifications, experience, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the specific role and location. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/custom-mechanical-solutions-quality-and-reliability-engineer

items.title: Director, Workforce Management
items.summary: Headquarters: Remote - USA The Clover Care Services organization delivers proactive support and care to our members through our clinical Clover Home Care teams, and quality improvement services to our aligned providers through our practice engagement team. Clover has built one of the most proactive, data-driven health care services platforms and is
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - USA The Clover Care Services organization delivers proactive support and care to our members through our clinical Clover Home Care teams, and quality improvement services to our aligned providers through our practice engagement team. Clover has built one of the most proactive, data-driven health care services platforms and is excited about how technology impacts our ability to bring transformative results to both patients and providers. Clover Care Services is entering a significant period of clinical growth. As we scale our Clover Care Visit (CCV) team, we need a dedicated leader who can turn an ambitious hiring plan into a reliable, repeatable workforce engine—from recruiting pipeline and onboarding capacity through clinician readiness, productivity, and performance. As the Director, Workforce Management , you will connect workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, leadership capacity, and performance management into one operating system, giving the organization clear visibility into whether we are on pace and what needs to change when we are not. As Director, Workforce Management, you will: Own the CCV workforce plan end to end. Build and run the staffing strategy required to scale the clinician organization, translating long-range growth targets into weekly and monthly hiring, onboarding, and readiness goals. Create visibility from candidate pipeline to “ready to visit.” Establish the operating metrics, forecasting, and reporting needed to understand recruiting conversion, onboarding lead times, attrition, training capacity, and clinician readiness—and surface risks early enough to act. Build a scalable clinician onboarding model. Partner across Clinical, Talent, IT, Operations, and other teams to evolve today’s high-touch onboarding journey into a structured model that can support significantly larger hiring cohorts without sacrificing clinical quality. Build the leadership capacity required to scale. Determine the right model for preceptors, clinical leads, onboarding cohorts, and frontline management so that rapid growth does not create an unsustainable burden on existing clinical leaders. Own workforce performance management. Establish clear, actionable standards and operating rhythms across areas such as attendance, cancellation rates, Clover Assistant Touch, productivity, and normalized performance measures. Make quality and productivity work together. Build performance expectations that reflect accurate, sustainable clinical performance—not simply higher activity—and partner with clinical leaders to ensure workforce decisions support both member experience and quality of care. Turn workforce data into decisions. Build the dashboards, forecasts, and management routines leaders need to understand capacity, identify constraints, allocate resources, and stay ahead of hiring or performance gaps. Create repeatable workforce-management capabilities for CCS. Use the CCV ramp as the first proving ground for processes, tools, and operating models that can later support In-Home Care and other Clover Care Services programs. Operate as a cross-functional leader. Bring together Clinical Activation, clinical leadership, Talent, Operations, Finance, analytics, and other partners around one integrated workforce plan with clear owners, milestones, and escalation paths. Success in this role looks like: In your first 90 days, you will: Build a clear baseline of the CCV workforce funnel and translate the 2027 growth target into a measurable workforce plan spanning recruiting, onboarding, training capacity, clinician readiness, and attrition. Identify the biggest risks and bottlenecks in the ramp and establish the metrics, operating cadence, and accountability needed to address them. Within your first 6 months, you will: Establish a predictable recruiting-to-readiness operating model, including scalable onboarding cohorts, preceptor capacity, and clinical leadership support. Launch workforce dashboards and performance-management routines that enable leaders to anticipate capacity gaps, manage performance, and increase clinician onboarding volume without sacrificing quality. Over time, you will: Help CCV reach its clinician-capacity goals ahead of the 2027 AEP cycle through a sustainable, data-driven approach to hiring, onboarding, and performance. Build repeatable workforce-management capabilities that can extend beyond CCV to support In-Home Care and other Clover Care Services programs. You should get in touch if: You have built or led workforce planning, capacity management, clinical operations, field operations, or another complex people-scaling function where success depended on turning ambitious growth targets into an executable operating plan. You are comfortable owning the full workforce funnel—from recruiting demand and hiring pace through onboarding, readiness, productivity, performance, and attrition. You know how to scale a high-touch operating model without sacrificing the quality, judgment, and human support that made it successful. You are highly analytical and can turn workforce data into useful forecasts, metrics, dashboards, and decisions. You know how to balance productivity with quality, accuracy, and member experience when defining and managing performance. You are an effective cross-functional operator who can create alignment and accountability across clinical leaders, recruiters, operators, analysts, and executives. You are comfortable moving between strategy and execution and thrive in environments where the operating model is still being built. You bring experience scaling distributed clinicians, field teams, home-based care, or another operationally complex healthcare workforce. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most. We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: $161,500 — $210,000 USD To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clover-health-director-workforce-management

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote URL: https://oscarhealth.com Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Manager, Network Medical Economics to join our Actuarial team. Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family. About the role: The Senior Manager, Network Medical Economics leads financial analysis and provides actuarial insight to support Oscar's provider contracting and network strategy. You will own end-to-end financial evaluation of complex, high-impact provider negotiations and develops contracting guardrails, unit cost targets, and financial benchmarks to advance network affordability and performance. In close partnership with Network Strategy & Performance, Regional Actuarial, Medical Economics, and Data teams, the Senior Manager evaluates new network strategies, identifies financial risks and opportunities, and strengthens analytical methods and tools. You will translate complex analyses into clear recommendations and reporting, helping business and operational leaders make informed decisions about provider reimbursement and network initiatives. You will report into the Director, Actuarial. Work Location: This position is fully remote and open to candidates residing in the U.S., excluding Alaska; Delaware; Hawaii; Louisiana; Montana; North Dakota; Oklahoma; West Virginia; Wyoming; and U.S. Territories. Daily work is completed from your home office, with occasional travel required for team meetings and company events. #LI-Remote Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role in the states of California, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, and Washington is: $163,944 - $215,176 per year. The base pay for this role in all other locations is: $147,549 - $193,658 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program and annual performance bonuses. Responsibilities: Own end-to-end financial analysis for complex, high-impact provider negotiations, evaluating proposed reimbursement rates, contract terms, and alternative structures to inform negotiation strategy and decision-making. In collaboration with Network Strategy & Performance, provide recommendations and thought partnership based on financial analysis and actuarial principles related to new network strategies and initiatives. Develop and maintain contracting guardrails, unit cost targets, and financial benchmarks aligned with business objectives. Strengthen analytical methods and processes for evaluating provider contracts, establishing consistent modeling standards and partnering with Regional Actuarial, Medical Economics, and Data teams to improve tools, reporting, and analytical efficiency. Identify and quantify financial risks and affordability opportunities through analysis of provider reimbursement, utilization, medical cost trends, and competitive benchmarks; recommend actions to improve network financial performance. Develop and deliver detailed reports, presentations, and dashboards that distill complex network medical economics insights for internal stakeholders, project teams, and business unit leaders. Maintain strong working relationships with key business and operational leaders (e.g., Network, Market P&L, Payment Integrity, Claim Operations) to ensure analytic solutions meet their needs. Other duties as assigned. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in a STEM field, or 4 years commensurate experience. 7+ years of quantitative analysis in the healthcare industry. Proven experience in health insurance / payer analytics, with an understanding of medical claims data (e.g., CPT/HCPCS, ICD-10, DRGs) and standard healthcare industry data sources. Bonus points: Excellent communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills. Strong process management skills, with experience streamlining workflows and driving operational efficiency. Experience translating between clinical, business, and analytic vocabularies. Familiarity with ACA-specific healthcare laws, regulations, and compliance requirements. Associate or Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (SOA), or on the track to become one. This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity. At Oscar, being an Equal Opportunity Employer means more than upholding discrimination-free hiring practices. It means that we cultivate an environment where people can be their most authentic selves and find both belonging and support. We're on a mission to change health care -- an experience made whole by our unique backgrounds and perspectives. Pay Transparency: Final offer amounts, within the base pay set forth above, are determined by factors including your relevant skills, education, and experience. Full-time employees are eligible for benefits including: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, paid sick time, paid parental leave, 401(k) plan participation, life and disability insurance, and paid wellness time and reimbursements. Artificial Intelligence (AI): Our AI Guidelines outline the acceptable use of artificial intelligence for candidates and detail how we use AI to support our recruiting efforts. About the Finance team The Finance team ensures Affirm remains financially sound and strategically positioned for growth. Our team manages financial planning, accounting, pricing, vendor management, tax, investor relations, and corporate development. We deliver timely insights, accurate reporting, and careful analysis to support decision-making. From day-to-day financial operations to major investments, we enable sustainable, informed growth by maintaining strong fiscal discipline. About the role We are looking for a self-motivated, hardworking, and analytically minded professional to join the Strategic Finance team during a pivotal moment of growth! As Affirm Bank is currently in its formation phase, we are actively building out our foundational team. Reporting to the Bank Head of Strategic Finance, the Bank Strategic Finance Lead will play a key role in the formation and operational build-out of the Bank. You will develop and monitor Bank financial and KPI forecasts, drive strategy, and perform financial analyses throughout the Bank. Your work will help set Bank-level goals, annual budgets, capital stress testing and monitoring, and stakeholder guidance, while building the infrastructure to hold the Bank accountable to achieving its goals. You will have a unique opportunity to work cross-functionally and use quantitative insights to drive better decision-making across the organization. The ideal candidate will not only have superb technical skills but also strong interpersonal skills and the ability to influence cross-functionally and present to all levels of the Bank organization. What you’ll do Develop the end-to-end forecasting and budget process, and design, build, and maintain complex financial models to support strategic planning, scenario analysis, and decision-making Drive business outcomes and performance management by developing automated financial analytics dashboards and reporting infrastructure Analyze, diagnose variances, and report realized financial performance to Bank Executives, the Bank CFO, and other company leaders Develop capital stress testing, ongoing monitoring, and help establish performance measurements and targets while ensuring analytic rigor in decision-making Partner closely with Affirm, Inc. cross-functional teams to integrate financial workflows and join a tight-knit team with outsized impact What we look for Passion and drive to build robust financial models Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related field 3+ years of relevant experience in analytical roles (e.g., strategic finance, consulting, data science, or analytics) Strong working knowledge of financial modeling tools Excellent proficiency in predictive analytics and forecasting Familiarity with fintech, lending, and payments business models preferred Proven ability to operate with ownership and influence in a fast-paced, dynamic, and ambiguous work environment with strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills Base Pay Grade - K Equity Grade - USA 6 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $145,000 - $205,000 USA base pay range (All other US states) per year: $128,000 - $188,000 Location - Remote U.S. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments. Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years. We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. Reporting to Sam Pinsak, Privacy’s Product Lead, who oversees both product and marketing, you'll partner closely with your engineering manager, eng lead, and the engineers on your pod, a product designer, and, depending on the work, leads across risk, payment, and dispute ops, compliance, biz ops, and support. The product team is small, senior, and moves fast. This is a hands-on role: you'll own a broad surface and live in the details — writing the specs, pulling the data you need to make a call, staying close to customers, and sitting in planning and grooming with your engineering squad. You're self-sufficient with data day to day and partner with an analyst on the deeper dives, and you lean on AI tooling to do the work of a much bigger team. Every bet ties back to the P&L, scope gets cut hard, and you'll have a short path to the CEO and to real customers. What You’ll Do: Own the roadmap and strategy for a core product surface Own the surface and its year-long roadmap; keep the whole thing moving while going deep where it counts most right now Pick the right problems across that surface and frame them into testable bets with clear outcomes; set the product vision and strategy Act as the default decision-maker for your surface and make cross-area trade-offs; defend your calls under ambiguity at leadership review Drive decisions with data and deep customer + business understanding Own the metrics that roll directly into financial and business outcomes for your surface; know which levers move them and which to pull first to hit a target Reason in contribution-margin and unit-economics terms, not just feature impact; hold a segment-level model of our customers and spearhead the research that resolves high-impact, ambiguous questions Build the dashboards and success metrics other teams adopt, and use data to drive cross-functional buy-in Lead the team and work cross-functionally Lead an engineering squad as its product manager, and influence cross-functional teams to re-prioritize toward your roadmap Turn recurring decisions into playbooks the team reuses; push for configurable systems and AI/tooling patterns that lift the whole team, not just you Communicate clearly from the detail level up to the strategic picture, adapting to your audience; mentor other PMs and raise the team's craft bar What You’ll Bring: Ownership of a product area (or multiple connected areas) end-to-end and set its strategy — not just execution of a roadmap handed to you Demonstrate strong judgment under ambiguity: you pick the right problems, make defensible calls, and know when to walk away from one Fluent in unit economics and how product decisions move the P&L Ability to find the levers that matter in performance data and turn them into a clear story for non-technical audiences Fluent with AI-assisted tools and actively building with them to multiply your own and the team's output Ability to ramp quickly across unfamiliar domains and get to real depth quickly Consumer or D2C product experience; consumer fintech or payments a strong plus, not a requirement Ability to operate autonomously, with strong communication skills, ruthless about scope without sacrificing quality, and humble The annual US salary range for this role is $ 168,000 - $225,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Benefits for Full-Time US Employees: Unlimited PTO 12-weeks fully paid parental leave 4-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5-year anniversary) Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4-weeks each year 3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary Privacy.com employee account Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match 401(k) match Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD NYC-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs. In-office employees receive: Commuter benefit Catered lunch every Tuesday and Thursday To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lithic-staff-product-manager-privacy

items.description: Product Headquarters: Hidalgo del Parral, Chihuahua, Mexico URL: https://customer.io About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. About the role Hi, my name is Megan Berry, Senior Director of Product at Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Senior Product Manager to help us turn customer signals into products people actually want. Our team is six product managers who partner closely with Design and Engineering to launch first-class products that drive customer and business outcomes. You need to be able to synthesize customer research, market research, analytics and your own taste into a customer-first roadmap and set of releases. You will work with a cross-functional team with a high level of autonomy to validate ideas early and help the team ship excellent work. This role focuses on Workflows. What we value Surfacing customer problems based on qualitative and quantitative data. Driving alignment through effective communication. Performing market research and presenting findings. Using AI to accelerate discovery. Helping our teams ship sooner. What you’ll do Identify and validate customer problems through user research, usage analytics, partner insights, and AI-powered discovery tools. Rapidly prototype and run focused experiments to test hypotheses and de-risk new ideas early in development. Lead cross-functional planning by aligning Engineering, Design, and business stakeholders around clear product goals and trade-offs. Drive feature strategy and influence roadmaps by proposing initiatives rooted in customer impact and market opportunity. Break down complex projects into incremental, testable releases, using component reuse and system thinking to accelerate delivery. Define product success metrics upfront and track adoption, engagement, and retention to inform iterative improvement. Take on Technology Lead responsibilities for specific initiatives when needed, including data analysis, prototyping, coordinating engineering work, and managing delivery risks. Look at product metrics after launch and work with GTM stakeholders to ensure your launches are successful and create the product and business outcomes we want. What we're looking for 7+ years of product management experience, ideally including time in B2B SaaS or platforms that leverage behavioral data for automation or messaging. Strong analytical skills, comfort with metrics dashboards, and experience using data to shape direction and evaluate impact. Proven ability to lead feature development independently, reduce scope, and deliver successful outcomes with tight teams. High product intuition balanced with humility and experimentation. You're comfortable being wrong and eager to learn quickly. Exceptional written communication and decision-framing abilities, especially in remote and async-first environments. Experience using or developing AI-powered tooling in your product workflow. Technical background with demonstrated ability to build basic web applications, write scripts, and work with engineering teams on topics such as data models, APIs, and performance requirements. Track record of serving as a point of contact or DRI for engineering initiatives, with the ability to choose objectives and navigate trade-offs. Experience with products that involve complex workflows or automations is a plus. Compensation & Benefits We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $170k–$200k USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. Zone 1: $204k–$240k USD Zone 2: $187k–$220k USD Zone 3: $170k–$200k USD We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more. See full benefits here → Our Process No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision. 30-minute video call with a Recruiter 30-minute video call with the Hiring Manager 60-minute Engineering working session (Product case, Part 1) 60-minute Product case presentation with the Product team and Hiring Manager (Part 2) All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process. Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact. Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io . Join us! Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-senior-product-manager-workflows

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Taguig, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: http://getmagic.com Account Manager, Retention & Growth - Remote Application Deadline: 5 December 2026 Department: Talent Team Employment Type: Full Time Location: Philippines Reporting To: Andrew Valle Compensation: ₱60,000 - ₱80,000 / month Description Backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, Magic has spent 10+ years connecting fast-growing businesses with top remote talent. This is a full-time, in-house, permanent role with full benefits. You'll be a Magic employee owning client relationships on the company's behalf, not a VA placed with a client. Our clients are busy founders and executives who need remote workers to deliver real ROI, and they need a strategic partner to make that happen. You're not here to answer tickets. You're here to protect revenue, grow accounts, and turn happy clients into loud advocates. The pace is live and constant: client calls, escalations, and account health across a real portfolio, every single day, with no handoffs and no delays. Shift: US Eastern hours, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM ET, Monday to Friday (a 9-hour shift), with occasional early or late calls for West Coast clients or urgent situations. Fully remote, Philippines-based. Key Responsibilities Guard your book of business: own a portfolio of accounts sorted by size, health, and growth potential, and hold 90%+ gross revenue retention (GRR) and 110%+ net revenue retention (NRR). Those are the numbers you're graded on. Spot at-risk accounts before clients say a word. Start renewals 60–90 days out, and get save plans moving early. Launch every new client fast: kickoff call within 24–48 hours of signing, then Magic's 30-60-90 day onboarding framework, with a success plan tied to their business goals and an intro to their remote worker. Host quarterly business reviews (QBRs) clients actually look forward to: data-driven, strategic, action-oriented. Become the trusted advisor to founders and C-suite, and multi-thread across each client so one champion leaving doesn't sink the account. Hunt expansion opportunities and make the business case before anyone asks. Surface the story in the data: track churn risk and expansion signals, keep HubSpot clean, send a monthly portfolio health report (retention, NRR, CSAT, NPS, QBR completion), and own every escalation from intake to resolution. Qualifications & Technical Requirements 3+ years of B2B customer success or account management experience, juggling a portfolio of accounts at the same time Direct ownership of revenue retention and expansion targets across the full customer lifecycle from onboarding to renewal Background in SaaS/tech, outsourcing/staffing, professional services/BPO, or marketplace platforms HubSpot experience used daily for pipeline and account health (intermediate-to-expert Salesforce or a similar CRM also works) Intermediate-to-advanced Excel or Google Sheets: pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX MATCH, dashboards, trend analysis Real US market experience: you know US business culture, SMB challenges, and how executives like to communicate Strong written and spoken English, good enough for daily conversations with US-based C-level and Director clients A professional home office: high-speed internet (50+ Mbps), a headset, and a quiet space You treat customer success as a revenue function, not a help desk. You own the outcome, so you don't wait to be told an account is wobbling; you've already spotted it, and your save plan is moving. You're comfortable in a room with a founder or a C-suite exec, and you can plow through a messy escalation without losing the relationship. You read the data, find the story, and walk into every QBR with a point of view. You pitch expansion because the numbers back it up, not because a quota told you to. When something breaks, you adapt, get the right people in the room, and keep going. Application + pre-qualifying questions → HR interview (45 min) → 24-hour reflection period → Panel Interview with Senior CSMs → interview with CS Director → Final Interview with the Head of Sales & CS → Job Offer What's In It For You ₱60,000–₱80,000 gross per month, permanent and full-time, fully remote (Philippines). HMO coverage after regularization, 12 vacation days and 10 sick days a year, 13th month pay, SSS, PhilHealth, and PAG-IBIG. We offer paid training and promote from within: top CSMs move into Senior CSM, Team Lead / CS Manager, and CS Director roles. We're an ambitious, driven team that plows through obstacles instead of waiting for perfect conditions. There's no hierarchy and no politics: you can talk to anyone, on any team, about anything. We respect each other's time, and we actually like working together. Magic is backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, with more than 10 years of connecting top remote talent with fast-growing businesses and 2,000+ remote workers worldwide. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/magic-inc-account-manager-retention-growth-remote

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - Ireland Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . Hiring and how we work We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. . See yourself at Twilio Join the team as our next Software Engineer on Twilio’s platform engineering observability team. About the job This position is needed to help our platform engineering observability team. Twilio is undergoing a large-scale observability transformation—and you can help shape the foundation. Observability is a strategic pillar and a key enabler for faster incident response, deeper customer-centric insights, and more cost-effective platform operations. As a Software Engineer on the Platform Observability team, you’ll play a critical role in re-architecting how telemetry flows and is utilized through Twilio—making it structured, accessible, affordable, and actionable. Over the next 3 years, Twilio is rebuilding nearly every component of our observability platform, from data collection to real-time analytics. You will drive core initiatives that shift Twilio from fragmented tooling and wasteful data sprawl to a unified, OpenTelemetry-first observability stack built for scale. You’ll lead technically and strategically—designing platform components, influencing org-wide architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, and engaging directly with teams across Platform Engineering and R&D Responsibilities In this role, you’ll: Lead the end-to-end architecture and delivery of key observability platform components, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and usability. Drive consistency and quality across all observability signals—logs, metrics, traces, and continuous profiling—building intuitive workflows for engineers. Serve as a technical advisor and mentor across the platform org, guiding design decisions and aligning cross-team efforts with long-term architectural goals. Go deep in one or more problem areas (e.g., high-cardinality telemetry, distributed tracing correlation, compute cost insights), while ensuring the platform scales horizontally. Collaborate with product teams, SREs, and developer experience groups to deeply understand telemetry needs and integrate observability into core engineering workflows. Design and build developer-friendly tooling and APIs to support incident response, performance analysis, and platform debugging at scale. Leverage (and optionally contribute to) open-source standards like OpenTelemetry to ensure interoperability and extensibility. Champion a pragmatic approach to observability—balancing performance, cost, and user value across diverse engineering teams. Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! *Required: Proven expertise in building and scaling observability systems (e.g., logging platforms, metrics pipelines, tracing infrastructure, or profiling tools). Lead technical execution for major components of Twilio’s observability overhaul, including our shift to centralized S3-based data lakes, OpenTelemetry instrumentation, and ClickHouse-backed query engines. Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Go, Python, Java). Familiarity with high-cardinality data challenges and telemetry correlation techniques. Experience designing high-scale telemetry systems (e.g., Prometheus, ClickHouse, OpenTelemetry, Kafka, or equivalent). Solid understanding of distributed systems and the challenges of observability in complex, microservice-based environments. Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code tools. Provide architectural guidance and thought leadership across teams, helping to establish clear telemetry standards, efficient usage patterns, and scalable platform abstractions. Ability to make forward-looking technical decisions and lead others through ambiguity and chan Desired: Familiarity with ClickHouse, Grafana Mimir, Athena, or equivalent systems for log and metrics querying. Contributions to open-source observability tools or communities. Experience building cost visibility or FinOps tooling for cloud compute and telemetry pipelines. Location This role will be remote from Ireland. Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. . Twilio thinks big. Do you? We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. . Stay alert to recruitment fraud We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps. . Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twilio-devops-engineer-observability

items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote - India Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. Location Note We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. The Opportunity Oportun is seeking a talented, customer-focused, and analytical Senior Product Manager to join the Servicing & Payments team. You will help create a trusted post-disbursement experience that strengthens members' confidence in Oportun, supports their financial health, and encourages continued engagement and repeat member behavior. You will define product strategy, set measurable objectives and key results, create outcome-oriented roadmaps, and partner with engineering, design, data, operations, risk, compliance, and other teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions. You will help make repayment easy, intelligent, successful, and accurately reflected for lending members. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You'll define and execute product strategy and roadmaps that improve repayment outcomes, member trust, and repeat engagement. You'll own initiatives end to end - from discovery and requirements through delivery, measurement, and iteration. You'll create simple, transparent, and reliable servicing and payment experiences across self-service and assisted channels. You'll use member insights, data, and experimentation to improve payer rate, payment success, DQ prevention, and lending-member NPS. You'll lead cross-functional delivery with engineering, design, data, operations, risk, compliance, legal, and finance. You'll communicate product strategy, trade-offs, progress, and measurable business impact to senior stakeholders. You'll bring ideas for how we can do things better - proactively, not just when asked. You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully - to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You're customer-focused and analytical, with a track record of navigating complex problems and turning member needs and data into practical product decisions. You're collaborative, communicate clearly, and build consensus across a wide range of cross-functional partners. You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. What You Bring Skills & experience You'll have 5+ years of product management experience in high-growth environments. You've demonstrated experience partnering with business executives and cross-functional teams across compliance, risk, operations, fraud, technology, business intelligence, finance, training, legal, and cybersecurity. You bring strong analytical problem-solving skills, including experience with data-informed decision making, testing and experimentation, metric definition, and data analysis. You've demonstrated a track record of shipping and iterating on impactful products while building consensus across a broad group of cross-functional partners. You bring strong product execution skills and the ability to help teams push through obstacles and blockers to deliver value for members. You communicate clearly and concisely and have strong documentation skills. Nice to Have Experience launching products within complex legal and regulatory frameworks, including financial services. Experience with SQL. Experience working with a multinational workforce. You've used AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to improve your own productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. WORKING AT OPORTUN What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: India Benefits: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance; Provident Fund; Life & Accident Insurance; Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances. This is a summary of select benefits and does not represent the full benefits package. Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-product-manager-r14206
