items.summary: Vendavo powers the shift to digital business for the world’s most demanding B2B companies, unlocking value, growing margin and accelerating revenue. Companies in chemicals, distribution, high-tech and manufacturing use Vendavo to build customer insight and pricing strategies that maximize margin and improve sales effectiveness. Vendavo Intelligent
items.description: Vendavo powers the shift to digital business for the world’s most demanding B2B companies, unlocking value, growing margin and accelerating revenue. Companies in chemicals, distribution, high-tech and manufacturing use Vendavo to build customer insight and pricing strategies that maximize margin and improve sales effectiveness. Vendavo Intelligent CPQ (iCPQ) is our configure-price-quote product, built on C#/.NET. It runs complex pricing, product configuration, rules and approval workflows for large enterprise customers worldwide. THE OPPORTUNITY • Own the technical direction of the iCPQ .NET codebase: architecture, coding standards, and the modernization roadmap (runtime upgrades, dependency and security updates). • Lead and mentor a distributed team of senior engineers, including partner engineers; run design reviews and code reviews and raise the bar on quality. • Analyze requirements with Product Management, break them into deliverable work, estimate it, and make the trade-offs explicit; write RFCs and operational runbooks for CloudOps and Support. • Design, build and review core backend services and APIs in C#/.NET, including integrations with Vendavo platform services (IAM, Kafka-based data exchange, AI Platform). • Drive test automation and code quality: MSTest unit tests, Reqnroll/Playwright UI regression, help introduce an enforced code-coverage gate on pull requests, and reliable Azure DevOps pipelines. • Lead diagnosis of production issues (performance, memory, concurrency) down to root cause, and turn the findings into lasting fixes. • Support the release cycle (three major releases a year, patches and P1 hotfixes) and work with QA, CloudOps and Services so customer upgrade waves are planned, tested and low-risk. • Use AI-assisted development (Claude Code) in line with our engineering standards, and help the team adopt it well. THE SKILLS • 8+ years of professional software development, 5+ of them in C#/.NET. • Strong knowledge of .NET 9 and ASP.NET Core, plus ASP.NET MVC and .NET Framework 4.8, with hands-on experience migrating legacy .NET Framework code to modern .NET. • Solid SQL Server / Azure SQL skills: query performance, database-per-tenant setups, schema changes in a live product. • Hands-on unit and integration testing (e.g. MSTest, Moq) and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps). • Proven troubleshooting of production systems: profiling, memory and performance analysis, root-cause analysis. • Experience leading engineers technically: design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, setting standards. • Git, pull-request workflows, Agile delivery (Scrum or Kanban). • Clear written and spoken English (B2+); able to explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers. AI skills • Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents (we use Claude Code) for design, coding, refactoring, tests and code review. • Good judgment on where AI output needs verification; owns every line they merge, whoever wrote it. • Prompt and context engineering: clear task specs, project instructions (CLAUDE.md), and reusable skills or agents the whole team can use. • Uses AI to speed up legacy work: understanding unfamiliar code, .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 9 migration, test coverage for old code. • Can set team guardrails for AI-generated code: review standards, security and data confidentiality, in line with Vendavo’s AI policies. What the ideal candidate looks like • Takes ownership of the quality of what the team ships. • Makes courageous decisions and acts with integrity. • Executes with urgency through thoughtful planning. • Communicates directly, respectfully and openly. • Is open to learning the pricing domain and our customers’ business. Nice to have • Experience with CPQ, pricing or other complex B2B enterprise software. • Front-end experience with React and JavaScript/TypeScript, including moving server-rendered MVC UI to React. • Integration with CRM and ERP systems (e.g. Salesforce, Dynamics 365, SAP) and GraphQL APIs. • Azure (App Service, Redis, Azure SQL elastic pools), Kafka messaging, and observability (Application Insights, Grafana). • Experience working with an external engineering partner or a team spread across time zones. • Experience building LLM-powered features or agents (e.g. Anthropic Claude via AWS Bedrock, MCP servers), including integrating .NET services with an AI platform. What we offer • A key technical role on a product used by large enterprise customers worldwide. • A team of highly skilled people and a collaborative environment where every opinion matters. • The chance to learn the pricing domain across many industries. THE BENEFITS Professional growth and Development opportunities. Working within a team of friendly, skilled people where help is always within reach Flexible working hours 4 recharge days, where the entire company goes on a brief pause in all geographies for 1 day each quarter. This day can be spent in whatever way helps you recharge, to regain energy, and dive back into the next workday High-end laptop (Windows or Mac) Competitive pay and bonus 18 vacation days in a year in addition to 15 days Sick Leave/ Casual leave per calendar year. 16 hours of paid volunteer time off per year 26 weeks of paid maternity leave and 10 days of paid paternity leave. Health Insurance of up to 7 lacs for self, spouse, 4 dependent children, and parents. 100% of the premium is paid by Vendavo and it covers the employee, spouse, children, and their parents. Group Term Insurance coverage up to three times of their Annual CTC . Dependents are not covered. Group Personal Accident coverage up to three times of Annual CTC. Dependents are not covered. Provident fund contributions THE VENDAVO STORY Vendavo partners with the world’s leading companies to accelerate growth and profitability, advance innovation, and build more prosperous communities. Our powerful, cloud-based, AI-powered pricing, selling, and prescribing solutions empower global manufacturers and distributors to manage, optimize, and digitize their end-to-end commercial processes. But we offer so much more than software. Our proven, repeatable process, and passionate, experienced people accelerate value and drive profitable, unrivaled business outcomes for our customers. We are passionate about helping our customers deliver the right products, at the right prices, at the right time, for the right people. OUR SAAS PRODUCTS Our B2B pricing and selling solutions include Vendavo’s Pricing & Strategy Management (Pricepoint, Enterprise Pricing Platform, Deal Price Optimizer, and Vendavo AI), Sales & Quoting Solutions (Intelligent CPQ and Sales Optimizer), Profit and Margin Analytics (Profit Analyzer and Margin Bridge Analyzer), and Incentive & Channel Operations (Rebate and Channel Manager). You can learn more about our products here. OUR FUNDING We are backed by two of the top high-tech private equity firms in the world, have excellent financial health, and boast the top SaaS retention in our space. OUR CULTURE & YOU We collaborate with our customers unlike any others in our industry. Anchored in our values (Integrity, Customer Centricity, Innovation, Clarity, Collaboration), we are growing, constantly innovating, and consistently driving sustainable outcomes for our clients and partners. Unlocking opportunities for our customers would not be possible without our employees. When you are part of Vendavo, you’re part of a company that’s committed to your growth and invested in your career. Diversity, inclusion, and celebration of community are at our core, and we come together to learn from each other and honor our commitments. EMEA and California residents applying for positions at Vendavo can see our privacy policy here. OUR TEAM IS GROWING. YOU WILL TOO.

You’ll own research and execution around data sourcing, curation, evaluation, and training strategies for multilingual and low-resource languages, with a strong emphasis on publishing high-quality research and translating it into production systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the frontier: balancing papers, prototypes, and real-world impact in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Design and execute research on multilingual datasets , including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and quality measurement Develop strategies for low-resource and long-tail languages (sampling, augmentation, curriculum design) Research and improve cross-lingual transfer , alignment, and robustness in large language models Build and maintain evaluation benchmarks for multilingual performance Collaborate with engineers and researchers on training pipelines and model architecture decisions Publish research at top venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and contribute to open-source when appropriate Translate research insights into practical improvements in production models What We’re Looking For Strong background in NLP / ML research , with a focus on multilingual or cross-lingual modeling Publication record at respected conferences or journals (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.) Experience working with large-scale text datasets across multiple languages Solid understanding of: Tokenization and vocabulary design for multilingual models Data quality metrics, filtering, and dataset bias Transfer learning and multilingual representation learning Comfortable prototyping in Python with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.) Ability to operate independently and ship research in a startup pace environment Nice to Have Experience with low-resource languages or non-Latin scripts Open-source contributions in NLP or data tooling Experience training or evaluating large language models Familiarity with multilingual benchmarks (e.g., XTREME, FLORES, TyDi QA) Why Join Us Real ownership over research direction and impact A team that values papers and production Access to meaningful scale: large datasets, modern infrastructure, and fast iteration Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at an early stage Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) Fortune Change the World (2024) CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) About the Role: Maven is looking for a Resolution Response Specialist who will lead the end-to-end resolution of complex, high-risk member escalations, serving as a Tier 2 senior owner within the Resolution Response Team to ensure every escalation is handled consistently, efficiently, and at the right level the first time — restoring member trust while protecting Maven, its clients, and its members. This is a non-exempt, Monday–Friday position with hours of 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. ET and occasional weekend coverage as needed. What You’ll Do: Own escalated member cases end-to-end, serving as the single accountable owner for moderate-to-high complexity issues across billing, reimbursement, benefits, coordination of benefits, network exceptions, and service breakdowns. Conduct structured investigations using the established triage framework (Category → Owner → Macro → Checklist → SLA → Escalation Path), reviewing ticket history, call recordings, prior guidance, client documentation, spend, and reimbursement records before resolution. Lead service recovery by reviewing low-rated interactions, conducting proactive outreach (call-first where possible), applying de-escalation protocols, and confirming closed-loop resolution with a written member recap. Serve as the primary cross-functional bridge across MBS, Support, Care Delivery, Client Success, Payment Operations, Network Operations, Product, Engineering, and Legal/Compliance to coordinate corrective action and accelerate resolution. Communicate with members using approved macros and empathy-led, legally protective language; provide CSMs with concise case summaries and polished client-facing messaging when needed. Identify and route risk using Critical/High/Standard severity and SEV 2/SEV 3 legal protocols for legal, compliance, discrimination, or regulatory exposure. Maintain precise documentation in Zendesk and the escalation tracker, applying granular themes, reason codes, and ownership tags to enable reliable root-cause reporting. Identify escalation trends and drive macro, playbook, and process improvements that reduce recurrence and prevent repeat escalations. What You’ll Bring: Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Communications, or related field preferred, or equivalent experience; 3+ years in escalation management, member/customer advocacy, health benefits, or healthcare operations. Experience resolving complex, multi-stakeholder escalations; strong knowledge of employer-sponsored benefits, reimbursement and claims workflows, and the fertility/family-building member journey. Familiarity with Zendesk, Jira, Guru, Google Sheets, and Looker. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong critical thinking, root-cause analysis, and structured case management skills. Excellent verbal and written communication, with strong de-escalation skills and the ability to translate complex benefits and billing issues into clear resolution plans. Sound legal and risk judgment, with the ability to identify when to involve Legal, Compliance, or leadership and collaborate effectively across teams. Empathetic, composed, and member-centric, with the ability to navigate high-emotion, high-stakes cases through resolution. The base salary range for this role is $82,000 - $96,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This role requires active work authorization in the US. Maven embraces a flexible and inclusive work environment. This role is open to candidate in: AZ, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, KS, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, VT, WI. Maven is committed to supporting remote team members with the tools and collaborative culture needed to thrive regardless of location. This policy reflects our belief that great work can happen anywhere and that flexibility enables our team to do their best work. At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams. Benefits That Work For You Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits: Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics. Whole-self care through wellness partnerships Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+) Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-resolution-response-specialist

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: MY-Malaysia-Remote At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. Our enterprise sales team is expanding, and we are seeking a seasoned, outcomes-focused Enterprise Account Executive to join our acquisition team in Malaysia. This is a unique opportunity to build net-new business in a market with strong momentum, helping enterprise organisations harness the full potential of their data and Snowflake’s platform for their cloud and AI ambitions. You will be instrumental in identifying, engaging, and closing new logos across Malaysia, creating pipeline early, and delivering high-visibility, high-impact outcomes for customers. As an Enterprise Account Executive at Snowflake, you will: Understand Snowflake’s evolving product and ecosystem, with a focus on AI capabilities, and conduct discovery calls, customised demos, and presentations for prospective customers. Build and execute a territory strategy for Malaysia, identifying, creating, and progressing net-new opportunities across enterprise organisations. Hunt for new strategic use cases by engaging both business and technology stakeholders, understanding their existing and future business and IT roadmap, and positioning Snowflake as a strategic platform for long-term data and AI transformation. Focus on developing and deepening sales opportunities in your territory by proactively creating pipeline, building executive relationships, and championing high-value use cases. Develop and execute a sales strategy to achieve quarterly and annual sales quotas, driving consistent activity, disciplined qualification, and strong pipeline development. Work closely with Snowflake partners and internal cross-functional teams, including Solutions Engineering, professional services, marketing, legal, and finance, to deliver value and accelerate deal progression. A track record in securing new logos Demonstrable experience executing enterprise complex sales strategies and tactics within one of the following spaces Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Science and/or AI/ML A familiarity with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organisation and contact management capabilities. The ability to build our product and company like it’s your own, specifically defining and executing sales plans to meet strategic & financial targets, leveraging industry, partner & Go-to-Market knowledge This ability to provide open, honest and respectful feedback creating an inclusive work environment A reputation for Making Each Other Better: Resulting in long standing relationships with internal cross functional partners and the ability to create an inclusive work environment Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships. Experience hitting multi million $ revenue targets on an annual basis. What we offer: The opportunity to join Snowflake at a pivotal stage in Malaysia’s market development. A locally employed role in Malaysia with access to Snowflake’s current local benefits framework. Eligibility for RSUs for new hires. A chance to help shape Snowflake’s growth with strategic enterprise customers in a market with strong forward momentum. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/snowflake-enterprise-account-executive-acquisition

items.title: Demand Generation Manager, Auto
items.summary: Headquarters: Atlanta; San Francisco; United States (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build produc
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Atlanta; San Francisco; United States (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. Upgrade is a fintech company focused on providing affordable and responsible credit to everyday consumers. Our Auto business is growing, and demand generation is how we reach the customers, and partners who power that growth. As a Demand Generation Manager , you will own the day-to-day strategy and execution that drive new business across Auto, spanning paid media, email, content, events, and sales-led campaigns. You will build the campaigns, nurture journeys, and reporting needed to drive measurable pipeline growth and revenue impact. This is a highly visible role for someone who is analytical, comfortable owning cross-functional work end to end, and energized by building and scaling a marketing foundation. You will work in close partnership with Sales, Partnerships, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success, and alongside Lifecycle, Product Marketing, Design, Legal & Compliance, and Data partners, so that acquisition efforts line up with onboarding, engagement, and retention. You will sit at the intersection of growth and marketing execution, working directly with the teams closest to revenue, with real ownership and the ability to shape how Upgrade shows up in the Automotive market. What You’ll Do: Own demand generation strategy for Auto across PPC, email, content, events, and web Refine the GTM, messaging, and value proposition for each business, aligned to ICP and buyer personas Optimize lead acquisition, conversion, and pipeline velocity, and manage and improve MQL quality and performance Partner with Account Executives, Partnerships, and Sales leadership to brainstorm, align on, and launch campaigns, including sales incentives, competitions, and referral programs Refine nurture journeys and build segmentation strategies in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach Lead campaigns end to end (strategy, execution, measurement), defining success metrics and setting a clear reporting cadence Work cross-functionally to move campaigns forward: Design tickets within the sprint cycle, Lifecycle requests, and early Legal, Compliance, and bank review Oversee website strategy and optimization, ensuring alignment with campaign messaging, ICP targeting, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization Build performance dashboards and attribution reporting tied to revenue outcomes, working with Data and Sales Ops partners across Heap, Google Analytics, Salesforce, and Tableau Manage the demand generation budget and track program spend against results Continuously test and optimize campaigns for efficiency and effectiveness Use AI-enabled tools when helpful to streamline content development, summarize insights, and improve workflow efficiency, so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality What We Look For: 5-7+ years of B2B or demand generation marketing experience, ideally within fintech, consumer lending, auto finance focused products. Proven experience leading demand generation and pipeline growth, including paid digital channels such as Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads. Proficiency in Salesforce and HubSpot. Demonstrated skills or projects with claude, chatgpt, co-pilot or any other AI tool. Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills, including experience with attribution, funnel reporting, and dashboards in Tableau (or a comparable BI tool). Track record of designing and analyzing test-and-learn experiments (e.g., A/B tests) to optimize campaign performance. Strong understanding of integrated marketing strategy, with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans and messaging. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Self-starter who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cross-functional workstreams in a fast-paced environment. BA/BS degree in business or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience. Curiosity and adaptability with AI-enabled tools, which are already part of how work gets done across our organization and will continue to expand over time. Nice to Have: Experience with Outreach, Heap, or Google Analytics. Experience partnering with Legal and Compliance on marketing review in a regulated environment. Experience with partner, referral, or sales-incentive programs. Familiarity with website strategy, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization. What We Offer You: Competitive salary and stock option plan 100% paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance Flexible PTO Opportunities for professional growth and development Paid parental leave Health & wellness initiatives #BI-Hybrid #LI-Hybrid For California residents: Upgrade's California Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy describes our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the personal information of job applicants. Environmental & Working Conditions Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations. Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives. The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need. J ob duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position. Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings. Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-demand-generation-manager-auto

items.title: Produktspezialist:in (German-speaking)
items.summary: You know SaaS. You like helping people get it right. And you'd rather have a real conversation than a hard sell. Do you speak German natively and want to help organisations get the most from a world-class SaaS platform? Then this might be the role you're looking for. Join a lean-by-design, globally recognised B2B SaaS company as the German-speaking specialist for our DACH+ markets. No cold calling, no quotas — just meaningful conversations that help interested people discover how our software makes their work easier, then supporting them brilliantly once they're on board. You won't be opening the market alone. Our marketing team already brings in German-speaking interest, and our experienced English-speaking sales colleagues handle these leads well. Your edge is simple and valuable: when a German-speaking prospect wants a demo auf Deutsch , or a new client wants onboarding and support in their own language, you're the person who makes that feel effortless — gründlich, verlässlich und auf den Punkt. Join our Rebel Alliance We're a diverse, remote crew that takes the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. You'll be a valued member of our global Client Success team, well supported with the tools, knowledge and people you need to do excellent work. In time you'll learn to work across teams and draw on our collective expertise — and you'll have real backing at every turn to grow into a confident product expert. What you'll do Run German-language demos for warm, interested leads — clearly and confidently Become a product expert (with our support) and answer client and prospect questions accurately Onboard and support clients in German and/or English, setting them up for success from day one Provide responsive, thoughtful support in either German or English Test scenarios carefully so your answers are technically correct, not guessed Report recurring issues to help us improve the product Build trust through honesty, empathy and reliability What you bring (essentials) Native-level German (C2) and strong business English Minimum 3 years SaaS experience in support, onboarding, implementation or technical pre-sales Real technical aptitude. Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, staging vs production, dev console and database queries are familiar — you needn't be a developer, but you should be genuinely comfortable around them and quick to learn the product's technical side A confident communicator, written and spoken, who listens well Comfortable discussing product value and guiding decisions — without the hard sell Highly organised and process-driven; at home in a remote, tool-rich setup Based in EMEA, ideally within DACH or close business-hours overlap (UTC+1/+2) Reliable internet and a dedicated, distraction-free workspace Nice to have Familiarity with awards, grants, recognition or programme-management workflows Experience supporting clients across both German and English The short version If you're technically sharp, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to be the German-speaking specialist our DACH+ clients rely on, we'd love to hear from you. Komm an Bord!

items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust. In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information. Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models Qualifications to succeed in this project: Professional fluency in English Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher) Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred) Why join the project: Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset. Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance Qualification path How to get started: Complete your contributor profile and application Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training Receive your project assignment and access credentials Service Rates The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

items.title: Customer Service Representative
items.summary: Work From Home. Pick Your Schedule. Get Paid Weekly. Welcome to ShyftOff! Tired of traditional jobs that expect you to build your life around a fixed schedule? At ShyftOff, we believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around! We're changing the way customer service works by connecting independent professionals with exciting opportunities to support established businesses, all from the comfort of home. Whether you're looking to earn extra income, take greater control of your schedule, or explore a flexible remote opportunity, ShyftOff gives you the freedom to work differently. Why Choose ShyftOff? No commute. No traditional fixed schedule. More flexibility. More control. 100% Remote: Forget the commute! Work from the comfort of your own home. Weekly Pay: Get paid every week for eligible completed work. You Make Your Schedule: Choose available shifts that fit your lifestyle. Work when opportunities align with your availability. Earn $14-$20 Per Hour: Competitive campaign pay with opportunities to increase your earnings based on program and eligibility. Important: Applications will only be considered if you apply on the ShyftOff website at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents The Role As an independent agent, you take inbound calls for ShyftOff client programs and help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and get what they need. After you join, you choose which programs to apply for based on your qualifications and availability. One of our newest programs include: Financial Services Program — $15–$20 per hour plus incentives + $300 certification bonus Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their banking cards for everyday life: activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. This is credentialed financial services work on an established account, built for people who want to meet a real bar and stick around. What you'll do: Handle inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions Help customers with payments, transfers, and disputes, accurately and securely Verify customer identity and follow strict security and compliance protocols on every call Spot and help resolve potential fraud with composure Document every interaction accurately in the account's systems Who you'll talk to: cardholders and their benefits managers, often at a stressful moment like a lost card or a charge they don't recognize. Your job is to guide them, protect their account, and get them back on solid ground. Healthcare Program — $14–$20 per hour plus incentives + $200 certification bonus Compassionate, detail-oriented agents support a healthcare campaign, where your role is vital in providing clear information and support. What you'll do: Engage with customers to understand their concerns and provide solutions Clearly explain the breach details and the services offered to them Maintain a high level of empathy and professionalism in all communications Accurately submit CRM tickets to ensure effective issue resolution What Makes You a Fit (all programs) Communication: you connect over the phone, listen well, and stay empathetic even when the caller isn't calm Security and accuracy: you take protecting sensitive information seriously Tech comfort: you can move between multiple systems and databases at once Composure: you think clearly and solve problems in a fast-paced environment Remote customer service or contact center experience is a strong plus; 3+ years of customer service experience preferred What You'll Need (all programs) Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum) A quiet, professional home workspace suitable for customer calls Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed.

items.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
items.summary: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. Duties · Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients · Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success · Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required · Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services. · Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines · Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues · Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management · Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment · Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices · Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives Our Technology Stack · Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA · Documentation – Hudu · RMM – Intune / Immybot · Networking – Meraki · Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365 · Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon · Door Access – Avigilon Qualification · 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support · Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry · Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service · Proven experience leading IT projects · A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications · Background in providing direct end-user support · High level of attention to detail · Excellent verbal and written communication skills · IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent) · Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents Our Core Values Dream Big, Then Make it Real We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard. Do, rather than talk and tell. Client Driven Results Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results. When they succeed, we succeed. Own Your Progress We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes. Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution. We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process. Basic Requirements • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English • Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States • Active use of Gmail and social media platforms • Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection • Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher) • Access to a personal computer Assessment You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

items.title: Freelance Copywriter
items.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

items.title: Paid Media Specialist
items.summary: Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 230,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers. That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first. As our new Paid Media Specialist, you'll plan, run, and optimize paid social advertising campaigns for Kinsta. You'll join our Performance Marketing team, report to the Paid Media Team Lead, and work closely with Demand Generation, Design, and RevOps to deliver a consistent volume of sign-ups and revenue that supports Kinsta's growth goals. It's a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable with data and enjoys testing new ideas. Your focus is Kinsta's paid social presence across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms. You'll reach the businesses, agencies, and enterprises that run their sites on WordPress, through campaigns that cover the full funnel from awareness to customer acquisition. You'll own campaigns from build to optimization, keep conversion tracking reliable, and turn performance data into clear recommendations. We work with teams across the globe, so you should be used to collaborating asynchronously and flexible enough to join the occasional early or late call. The ideal Kinsta Paid Media Specialist is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, proactive, and collaborative. What You Will Do: Plan, build, launch, and manage paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms, covering the full funnel from awareness and demand generation to lead generation and customer acquisition. Monitor performance and continuously optimize targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, ad creatives, and landing pages, scaling what works while keeping acquisition costs efficient. Run audience research and competitive analysis to find new opportunities for growth. Develop and run A/B tests across ad messaging, creative assets, audiences, and landing pages. Own conversion tracking: implement, maintain, and troubleshoot it through Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform-specific pixels and tags, and work with marketing and technical teams to keep conversion events and attribution accurate. Analyze campaign performance using ad platform data, web analytics, and CRM reporting, and build reports and dashboards that share results and actionable insights. Collaborate with content, design, product marketing, and sales on ad copy, creative concepts, and campaign assets that match our messaging and business priorities. Support our paid media strategy: follow advertising trends and platform updates, and recommend ways to improve campaign efficiency, lead quality, and overall marketing ROI. Use AI tools to streamline research, reporting, ad copy, and creative ideation, automate repetitive tasks, and apply critical thinking to AI-generated recommendations so decisions stay grounded in accurate data and business objectives. What You Bring To The Role: 2-4 years of hands-on experience independently building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns, including on Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit, ideally in hosting, B2B technology, or a related industry. Practical experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advertising platform pixels or conversion tags. A strong understanding of core paid media metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS, and experience analyzing campaign data and turning findings into actionable optimizations. Familiarity with audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing methodologies, and an understanding of marketing funnels, attribution, and how paid media contributes to lead generation and customer acquisition. Attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities at once. Bonus if you have: Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms. Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and attribution or reporting tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Dreamdata, or HockeyStack. Knowledge of advanced conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and server-side tracking, plus a basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, cookies, and how tracking tags work on websites. Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives. Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development. Our Benefits: Annual remote expense budget. Flexible PTO. Paid parental leave. Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta. Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter). Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary. Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA. Kinsta is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate and we will take actions to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, veteranâs status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. By applying to one of our positions, you agree to the processing of the submitted personal data in accordance with Kinsta's Privacy Policy , including the transfer of your data to the United States. #LI-Remote, #IHSRemote Please mention the word **OUTSHINE** and tag RMy40Mi4xNTcuMTk= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMy40Mi4xNTcuMTk=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

Welo Global’s five…
items.description: About Welo Global Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. ROLE OVERVIEW Welo Global is partnering with a social media client to build high-quality training data for AI systems . We are looking for Brazilian experts to help create challenging, expert-level questions and answers in their field. The content that will directly shape how AI understands Brazilian culture, law, history, and society. This is a remote, flexible freelance engagement. All work is done in Brazilian Portuguese . What you'll do For each assignment, you will craft a challenging, expert-level question on a Brazilian topic in your field (one that AI tools cannot fully answer), write the ideal response in Brazilian Portuguese and break that response down into individually cited facts with their sources and relevance. Important: AI tools may be used for research support only. All questions, answers, and fact breakdowns must be your own original work. We are looking for experts in the domain listed in the job posting. Project details Language Pair : Brazilian Portuguese Task : AI data annotation Area of expertise (domain) : Fandoms (Music, Pop, Disney & Political Memes) Tools : Consumer-grade LLM with search (e.g., Gemini Pro), for prompt difficulty calibration Estimated Volume : 60 hours over approximately 2 months, the hours are flexible, work on your own schedule Location : Remote Engagement Type : Freelance / Independent Contractor If this opportunity aligns with your experience, we would be happy to receive your application. To proceed, please provide the following: Share an updated CV A brief overview of your relevant experience, particularly in Fandoms (Music, Pop, Disney & Political Memes) and how many years you have worked in the field Your current availability and estimated monthly capacity Thank you again for your interest in working with Welo Global . I look forward to learning more about your profile and exploring a potential collaboration. Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global Job Reference: #LI-JC1 Compensation Additional Information

items.summary: How You'll Contribute As a Freelance Spanish Data Annotation Specialist at Docplanner, your main focus will be preparing and curating linguistically and medically oriented datasets in Spanish to power our machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) initiatives. You will work independently while maintaining clear communication with our NLP experts, ensuring the accuracy and relevance…
items.description: How You'll Contribute As a Freelance Spanish Data Annotation Specialist at Docplanner, your main focus will be preparing and curating linguistically and medically oriented datasets in Spanish to power our machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) initiatives. You will work independently while maintaining clear communication with our NLP experts, ensuring the accuracy and relevance of our data for the Spanish market, and contributing directly to the quality and reliability of our AI-driven products in the medical domain. This role is ideal for candidates with a strong linguistic background in Spanish who are passionate about working in the healthcare and technology space. The ideal candidate has experience in data annotation, transcription, and text analysis, combined with a basic understanding of medical terminology and concepts. Key Responsibilities: Prepare and maintain medically oriented datasets for machine learning purposes, ensuring high-quality data annotation and consistency. Follow and provide feedback on annotation and labeling conventions, as well as perform audio transcriptions in Spanish (aligning audio with text and correcting text based on audio). Implement text patterns to detect and extract named entities in Spanish, such as names, addresses, organization names, ID numbers, and medical terms. Contribute to dictionaries and taxonomies in Spanish for use in NLP systems. Evaluate the correctness and accuracy of Spanish words, sentences, and text structures, ensuring linguistic quality and consistency. Deliver high-quality work within established deadlines and communicate proactively about project progress and challenges. What We're Looking For: Languages: Native Spanish speaker and Full Professional Level of English Linguistic Expertise: A degree or strong background in Italian linguistics, computational linguistics, or a related field. Medical Knowledge: Familiarity with Spanish medical terminology or prior experience in the healthcare domain. Data Annotation: Hands-on experience with data annotation, transcription, and labeling tools. Text Analysis: Proficiency in working with text patterns and dictionaries for NLP purposes. Attention to Detail: Exceptional ability to assess and improve data quality. Self-Management: Strong ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and consistently meet deadlines. Which skills are 'bonus points'? Previous experience in AI, machine learning, or data preparation projects. Knowledge of multiple languages or dialects beyond Spanish and English. Exposure to medical coding systems (e.g., ICD, CPT) or electronic health records (EHR). Experience working as a freelancer on similar annotation or linguistic projects.

The focus is on the hands-on development and enhancement of
items.description: Mandatory SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 Expertise – Please Read Before Applying For a large SAP S/4HANA transformation program at a major European infrastructure and transportation company, we are looking for five experienced Senior SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 Developers to support the maintenance workstream. The focus is on the hands-on development and enhancement of customer-specific SAP Fiori applications supporting maintenance, asset management and planning processes. Three mandatory requirements: SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 Development: Several years of hands-on experience personally developing and enhancing SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications in customer projects. Frontend Development: Strong practical experience with SAPUI5, JavaScript, XML views, controllers and OData integration. Independent Delivery: Ability to independently analyze requirements, design, develop, test and troubleshoot SAP Fiori applications within a complex SAP project environment. Previous experience with SAP Plant Maintenance (PM), Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Customer Service (CS), Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO), SAP Multi-Resource Scheduling (MRS) or production and maintenance planning is highly valued. This is a hands-on SAP Fiori development assignment, not a purely ABAP backend development, functional SAP consulting or Fiori administration role. Individual freelancers are welcome. Developers who have successfully worked together in previous SAP projects are also encouraged to apply. Framework Conditions Start: ASAP Duration: 12 months+ Capacity: Full-time preferred, approx. 40 hours per week Location: 100% remote, Europe preferred Language: English Level: Senior Contract Type: Freelance / B2B Number of Positions: 5 Your Responsibilities You will design, develop, and maintain custom SAP Fiori applications and SAPUI5 user interfaces with a focus on Plant Maintenance modules. Your daily work involves collaborating with stakeholders to translate business requirements into efficient, user-friendly solutions within the SAP ecosystem. Tasks Independently design, develop, enhance and maintain customer-specific SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications within a large SAP S/4HANA transformation program. Develop frontend solutions supporting maintenance, asset management and planning-related business processes. Develop and enhance SAP Fiori Elements and Freestyle SAPUI5 applications. Implement and integrate frontend applications using JavaScript, XML views, controllers, data binding and OData services. Work closely with SAP backend developers, functional consultants, business process experts and the Technical Lead. Translate functional and technical requirements into reliable, maintainable and user-friendly applications. Support the integration of SAP Fiori applications with SAP S/4HANA backend functionality and relevant SAP business processes. Analyze and resolve technical issues related to frontend development, application integration and performance. Perform unit testing, debugging, defect resolution and technical documentation. items.description: About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. Qualification path What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Payment: Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour Our Payment terms are defined for each project. Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. items.description: Design Headquarters: United States Overview We are hiring Quality Control (QC) evaluators for a project that spans both Search and Linguistic tasks. You will perform quality checks on initial ratings produced by evaluators—validating user intent assessment, query annotation, text classification, and multimedia (video, image, audio) reviews for relevanc, accuracy, and guideline adherence. The ideal candidate combines strong language skills with sharp analytical judgment, excellent documentation and feedback skills, and familiarity with short-form video culture. What you will do Audit samples of initial ratings for relevance, intent alignment, taxonomy compliance, and linguistic quality. Re-rate items (double-scoring) to verify labels; resolve discrepancies and document decisions. Perform linguistic quality checks (grammar, tone, clarity, local relevance) and media comprehension reviews. Classify and track errors using an agreed error taxonomy; surface trends and edge cases. Provide clear, actionable feedback to evaluators; contribute to guideline clarifications and updates. Participate in and lead calibration sessions to drive inter-rater agreement. Track and report QC metrics (e.g., agreement rates, accuracy, error trends) and meet QC SLAs. Triage escalations, handle ambiguous cases, and ensure data integrity and compliance. Use internal tools to complete, track, and submit QC tasks accurately. Project Details Engagement Type: Freelance Rate: USD 28.61/hour Estimated Hours: 15-30 hours/week Requirement Native or near-native speaker level in English language with strong reading, writing, and listening comprehension. Excellent grammar, writing, and proofreading skills. Strong video and image comprehension; good hearing ability for audio tasks. Solid understanding of search engines, user intent, and web content. High attention to detail, consistency, and guideline adherence. Ability to deliver clear written feedback and rationale. Preferred qualifications Experience in QC/QA for text classification, query annotation, data labeling, or search quality evaluation. Familiarity with short dramas and local short-drama culture/platforms. Experience with calibrations, sampling, scorecards, and root-cause analysis. Comfortable working with productivity and quality targets; proficient with spreadsheets/QA tools. Background in linguistics, communications, media studies, information science, or related field. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/welo-data-crux-video-and-audio-qa-english-us
