Beyond that, we offer a spectrum of services including IT, business process outsourcing, advanced professional services, and crowd sourcing in both established and emerging markets. Our client is seeking experienced language professionals for an ongoing project. This is a freelance/task-based engagement, and all work will be coordinated with the project team. Please review the mandatory requirements before applying: Must have professional fluency in English and the Telugu, including strong listening comprehension, grammar, and orthography. Must be comfortable and understand this is a task-based, short-term project role. The project is expected to run for approximately 15–20 days, and candidates must be available for at least 4 hours per day, based on their preferred working hours. The final schedule and delivery timeline will be confirmed before engagement. All required NDAs and onboarding documentation must be completed before access to project data is granted. Mandatory Requirements: Must have reliable high-speed internet and a functioning device (laptop, desktop, etc.) to ensure seamless communication and productivity. ·Urgency: Due to the nature of the role, it is essential that all candidates have these resources in place from day one to avoid any delays in onboarding or task completion. About the Project We're looking for experienced language professionals to create and check highly accurate, word-for-word transcripts of real call center recordings. These transcripts will be used as a trusted reference to test how well speech recognition software performs. The work happens in two stages: one person creates and edits the transcript, and a second person independently reviews it. We'll provide the speaker labels, audio segments, and timestamps for you. The finished transcripts will be delivered in a structured file format. Openings Languages: Telugu Openings per language: 3 Editors and 3 Reviewers Total positions: 12 across two languages (6 per language) Areas of Expertise We're Seeking We are recruiting language professionals with knowledge and experience in one or more of the following areas: Audio transcription and linguistic editing. Verbatim transcription of natural conversational speech. Telugu linguistics, grammar, orthography, and language conventions. Call center and customer support conversation transcription. Regional accents, dialects, colloquial expressions, and informal speech. Multi-speaker conversations and overlapping speech. Linguistic quality assurance and transcription review. Audio annotation and speech recognition dataset development. Application of detailed transcription and annotation guidelines. Identification and correction of linguistic inaccuracies, omissions, and inconsistencies. Onboarding & Compliance Requirements All global contractors will be onboarded through our platform, Deel.com, to ensure alignment with international compliance standards. Successful completion of onboarding is required to begin work, which includes submitting the necessary documentation within the specified timeline. Candidates should be prepared to provide accurate and compliant documents according to the requirements of their region. This role is a 1099 independent contractor position. Please note that this classification may vary based on your location and local regulations. We encourage applicants outside of the US to familiarize themselves with their country's tax laws and regulations regarding independent contracting. For most candidates outside of the US, a W-8 BEN form is provided. Compensation Compensation varies by language and expertise level. $5 to $7 USD/Per Hour This is a remote freelance opportunity. Please note that available hours depend on the volume of tasks provided by the client. We look forward to receiving your application. POSITION 1: Transcription Editor Experience: 4+ years of relevant transcription, linguistic review, language interpretation, or language quality assurance experience Key Responsibilities Transcription: Listen to call center recordings and produce strictly verbatim transcripts in the original spoken language. Verbatim Accuracy: Capture filler words and preserve spoken wording without paraphrasing or correcting grammar. Speaker Handling: Work accurately with single-speaker recordings, multiple speakers, and overlapping speech. Unintelligible Speech: Mark completely indiscernible speech with the prescribed unintelligible tag instead of guessing. Tool Compliance: Complete all transcription and editing within uLabel, following project annotation guidelines. Feedback Incorporation: Incorporate reviewer feedback and resolve transcription issues before submission. Confidentiality: Maintain confidentiality and follow approved data access and handling procedures. Required Qualifications Advanced proficiency in Telugu, including strong listening comprehension, grammar, and orthography. 4+ years of relevant transcription, linguistic review, language interpretation, or language quality assurance experience. Strong attention to detail and the ability to interpret conversational speech, varied accents, and challenging audio. Ability to follow detailed annotation guidelines and apply feedback consistently. Comfort working with digital transcription or annotation tools. Ability to work remotely while complying with confidentiality and data security requirements. Preferred Qualifications Experience transcribing call center or customer support conversations. Experience preparing or reviewing datasets for speech recognition or AI evaluation. Familiarity with verbatim transcription and multi-stage quality review. POSITION 2: Transcription Reviewer Experience: 7+ years of relevant transcription, linguistic review, language interpretation, or language quality assurance experience Key Responsibilities Review: Review editor-prepared transcripts against the source audio for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to verbatim guidelines. Error Identification: Identify and correct omissions, substitutions, unsupported additions, and inconsistent treatment of filler words or unclear speech. Linguistic Resolution: Resolve difficult linguistic cases and provide clear, actionable feedback to Editors. Consistency: Maintain consistent transcription standards. Workflow Management: Complete the review stage within uLabel and support quality checks and rework before final delivery. Escalation: Escalate unresolved audio ambiguities and guideline questions to the project team. Required Qualifications Advanced proficiency in Telugu, including strong listening comprehension, grammar, and orthography. 7+ years of relevant transcription, linguistic review, language interpretation, or language quality assurance experience. Strong attention to detail and the ability to interpret conversational speech, varied accents, and challenging audio. Ability to follow detailed annotation guidelines and apply feedback consistently. Comfort working with digital transcription or annotation tools. Ability to work remotely while complying with confidentiality and data security requirements. Preferred Qualifications Experience transcribing call center or customer support conversations. Experience preparing or reviewing datasets for speech recognition or AI evaluation. Familiarity with verbatim transcription and multi-stage quality review. Workflow and Deliverables Two-stage human workflow: transcription/editing followed by independent review. uLabel provides speaker diarization, segmentation, and timestamps. Final transcripts support downstream ASR scoring, with JSON as the proposed delivery format. Availability and Engagement Terms Candidates should be available for onboarding, production, review, and rework during a short-term project. Planning currently assumes a 15–20 day window with availability of at least 4 hours per day, based on preferred working hours; the final schedule and delivery timeline will be confirmed before engagement. The project is expected to begin promptly once resources are confirmed. This is a freelance/task-based engagement; work availability depends on project volume and may vary. All required NDAs and onboarding documentation must be completed before access to project data is granted. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/volga-partners-transcriptionist-reviewer-telugu-freelance

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote US At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. About the People Team The People team helps Affirmers cultivate a high-performing, inclusive organization. We focus on three core areas: attracting talent aligned to our mission, enabling growth through people and team development, and retaining employees through thoughtful experiences and rewards. We develop Affirm’s people programs and systems to create a workplace where all employees can thrive and contribute meaningfully. By investing in our people, we create a long-term advantage for the business. About the Role The Compensation Programs & Partnerships (P&P) team designs, executes, and maintains some of the people programs and partnerships that enables Affirm to provide thoughtful experiences and rewards to Affirmers. We are seeking a detail oriented, collaborative Compensation Analyst who is passionate about delivering compensation programs and partnerships that helps drive Affirm’s success. In this role, you will report to the Senior Manager of Compensation and work closely with the Senior Manager and broader Compensation team to strategize, build, refine, maintain, and implement various programs and initiatives. You will also work closely with the team to help provide partnership and support for the Technology and Business functions as well as other cross functional partner groups. What You’ll Do Lead the end to end project management of the mid-year and annual compensation cycles in close alignment with the Compensation team and other key People team partners including: proactive and ongoing project planning, creating timelines, building training / enablement resources, facilitating project meetings, creating communications, and providing ad-hoc support during the cycles. Leverage existing tools and sources (such as Sigma Dashboards, the Radford Global Compensation Database, and Pave) to provide team ad-hoc compensation analyses and story-building support, translating data elements into sound recommendations and insightful presentations. This could include conducting robust research to prepare analyses on actual vs. market pay positioning, leveling distributions vs. market practices, offer and candidate trends, retention risk, spans / layers, or other workforce related priorities. Partner with the Compensation Programs & Partnerships team to provide ongoing partnership support for various business related initiatives across Affirm’s Technology and Business functions. Partner with the Senior Incentive Compensation Manager to provide operational support for the incentive compensation design process (which can include coordinating kickoff meetings, facilitating focus group feedback sessions with leaders, creating and / or updating incentive plan documents). Engage in ongoing processes and special projects to refine and uphold Compensation’s programmatic frameworks. Serve as subject matter expert, alongside other compensation team partners, to provide education and consultation to stakeholders on our compensation structure, guidance, and various compensation programs. Maintain our standard job architecture catalog in Workday and internal team documents. May participate in sessions with external survey companies (such as AON) to stay up to date on market trends and share insights that can help the team maintain competitive rewards structures and programs. What We Look For 5+ years of experience in compensation with the ability to demonstrate an understanding of core compensation concepts and programs. Experience with leading and managing projects from start to finish using a standard project management lifecycle approach. Strong team orientation with the ability to work effectively and collaboratively across the internal team and cross functional partners. Strong relationship management skills with the proven ability to consult, influence, and maintain positive relationships with business stakeholders. Passion for working with data elements and compiling analysis to “tell the story” and create solutions. Proficient with Google Sheets and Google Slides. Someone who can pay close attention to detail with the ability to multitask across several deliverables at the same time while maintaining a proactive approach to work assignments in a fast paced environment. Ability to be flexible and adapt to using different methods by embracing innovation and experimentation. Experience working within the technology industry is a plus. Pay Grade - I Equity Grade - 4 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000 Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/affirm-compensation-analyst-ii-programs-partnerships

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself. The Role BeyondTrust is building a new cross-product Site Reliability Engineering team that stands up and runs the AWS GovCloud environments bringing additional BeyondTrust products into our FedRAMP authorization. The team owns the reliability, change control, and continuous-compliance machinery for those environments so that product feature teams can stay focused on product delivery. This is an engineering team that owns operations, not an operations team. Its product is automation; operations is the input. Every manual procedure performed twice is a candidate for elimination, and the team’s success is measured by the operational work it has made unnecessary, not the tickets it has closed. Hands-on operational work is capped at roughly half of team capacity; the rest goes to engineering the work away. Our workloads are not purely cloud-native. The estates include appliance-model and single-tenant VM fleets at scale alongside shared services, so fleet upgrade orchestration, golden images, and staged rollouts are core work, not edge cases. Better Together Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Culver City, California, United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/kZSiaRVHB45MDzQ7znFJSV/jobs-at-crazy-maple-studio Crazy Maple Studio is a fast-growing company based in the Bay Area and Los Angeles, focusing on mobile gaming, reading, and streaming. We are proud to have a global team that drives our innovation and success across diverse markets. Our flagship platform, ReelShort, is the #1 vertical streaming app in the U.S., with over 8 million DAU, delivering bite-sized episodic content that keeps viewers hooked. Other standout products include Chapters, where users shape immersive stories across drama, fantasy, and romance, and My Fiction, a platform for consuming and creating serialized romance. We’re proud to be recognized as one of the Global Most Loved Workplaces 2025, reflecting our commitment to innovation, creativity, and an employee-first culture. Position Overview: As an AI-Assisted Story Writer, you will create short, high-hook, pay-per-chapter stories for mobile readers, working hand in hand with external AI and our in-house AI story system. Our system guides every story through a proven pipeline; your job is to steer that process with strong editorial judgment, push every story past "good enough," and turn out titles that readers pay to finish. This is an ROI-driven role. Every story you deliver goes into live testing, and its results (ad performance, reader conversion past the paywall, and return on ad spend) are the main measure of your success. The ideal candidate is a commercial storyteller first: someone who instinctively understands hooks, cliffhangers, revenge payoffs, romance tension, and why a reader taps "unlock" on the next chapter. You are comfortable using AI as a creative partner, you know when to trust it and when to override it, and you are energized rather than intimidated by data. Key Responsibilities: Use AI story system to write complete short stories of roughly 20,000 words, from title and logline through final chapter, delivered on schedule. Develop stories from a wide range of source material, including one-line ideas, trending topics, web novels, user-generated content, and existing hit stories. Approve story direction at each checkpoint: genre track, core reader expectation, paywall placement, and chapter-by-chapter emotional pacing. Edit and polish AI drafts so the final prose is vivid, emotionally specific, consistent in voice, and free of generic or repetitive AI patterns. Write high-impact titles, loglines, opening hooks, and paywall moments designed to drive ad clicks and reader conversion. Review testing results for every story you deliver, utilize retest reports to diagnose what underperformed, and revise promising stories that fall short of targets. Track your own story performance and apply what you learn to each new title. Stay current on trending tropes, hit stories, and reader tastes across short fiction, web novels, and short-form video drama, and bring new story ideas to the team. How Success Is Measured: Test pass rate: the share of your stories that meet or beat performance benchmarks in live testing. Return on ad spend (ROAS): how efficiently your stories turn marketing spend into reader revenue. Reader conversion: how well your opening and paywall turn readers into paying readers. Output and turnaround: consistently delivering finished, test-ready stories on schedule. Revision impact: how much your rewrites improve the results of underperforming stories. Minimum of 2 years of writing experience in commercial fiction, such as serialized fiction, web novels, Wattpad, Kindle Vella, romance publishing, short drama scripts, or a similar medium. A portfolio that shows strong commercial instincts: fast-paced plotting, emotional payoffs, and hooks that keep readers turning pages. Strong command of romance, revenge, family drama, and suspense, including popular tropes and what readers expect from them. Hands-on experience using AI writing tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in a real writing workflow. Excellent editing skills and the judgment to spot and fix flat, clichéd, or illogical AI output. Comfort with a results-driven environment where performance data shapes priorities and compensation. Ability to read and act on basic performance metrics (click-through rate, conversion, ROAS). Comfortable writing young adult and adult romance and drama, which may include sensitive and triggering content. Native or near-native English writing ability for English-speaking Western readers. Strong attention to detail, self-direction, and the ability to manage multiple stories at once under deadline. Flexibility to work across different time zones and communicate clearly in a remote team. Eagerness to learn and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. Nice to Have: Experience writing for pay-per-chapter apps or short-form video drama platforms. A track record of stories or titles with measurable commercial results (reads, rankings, sales, or conversion). Experience writing ad copy, hooks, or marketing content for fiction. Bachelor's degree in Creative Writing, English, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Compensation: $3,000. This is an independent contractor (1099) position with an initial one-month term. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Worldwide About Welo Global Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. ROLE OVERVIEW Welo Global is partnering with a social media client to build high-quality training data for AI systems. We are looking for Brazilian experts to help create challenging, expert-level questions and answers in their field. The content that will directly shape how AI understands Brazilian culture, law, history, and society. This is a remote, flexible freelance engagement. All work is done in Brazilian Portuguese . What you'll do For each assignment, you will craft a challenging, expert-level question on a Brazilian topic in your field (one that AI tools cannot fully answer), write the ideal response in Brazilian Portuguese and break that response down into individually cited facts with their sources and relevance. Important: AI tools may be used for research support only. All questions, answers, and fact breakdowns must be your own original work. We are looking for experts in the domain listed in the job posting. Project details Language Pair : Brazilian Portuguese Task : AI data annotation Area of expertise (domain) : Fashion & Style Tools : Consumer-grade LLM with search (e.g., Gemini Pro), for prompt difficulty calibration Estimated Volume : 60 hours over approximately 2 months, the hours are flexible, work on your own schedule Location : Remote Engagement Type : Freelance / Independent Contractor If this opportunity aligns with your experience, we would be happy to receive your application. You must have a strong C1 English level. If this isn’t you, please DO NOT apply. Our client is building an AI-powered learning platform that lets anyone turn virtually any idea into a creative learning experience. Think short, narrated, visually striking learning videos created in minutes, and a broader platform for personalized learning in many formats. The creative possibilities are enormous, and the team is only starting to explore them. They are entering their commercial growth stage, with creative agencies as the first market, followed by independent trainers, learning consultants, and other organizations. They need a creative builder who sees what this product can do and approaches their daily work with ideas that nobody else is trying. Company Culture Our client is a multicultural, purpose-driven team that believes learning should help people become who they want to be. They move fast, try unconventional things, and learn from what works. Their marketing won't look like everyone else's, and they want someone who feels the same way. If you are creative, energetic, resourceful, and not afraid to try an idea that might sound a little crazy, this is the right place for you. Benefits of working with our client include: Founding-level creative ownership, working directly with the founder and the business development lead A product with huge creative range and real room to experiment Freedom to test bold ideas and see them go live quickly Benefits Remote work PTOs Weekends off USD monthly payment Growth opportunities Job Description Our client is hiring a Head of Growth Marketing & Design: a creative builder who happens to be a marketer. Your job is to get attention for the product in ways people remember, and to turn that attention into qualified leads and real business opportunities. We want someone who ships ideas, experiments constantly, learns fast, and keeps what works. You'll create campaigns, visuals, and content yourself, and you'll work closely with the founder and the business development lead to make sure the buzz you generate becomes pipeline. Because the first target market is creative agencies, you'll have a real edge if you understand how they work, what they care about, and how this platform can help them expand what they offer their clients. Responsibilities Launch creative, attention-grabbing campaigns, including unconventional ideas, that get the product in front of creative agencies and other target audiences Set the creative direction and visual identity of the brand across campaigns, social, website, and sales materials Create the content yourself, including design, visual storytelling, and demos that show how any idea can become a learning experience Turn attention into pipeline by building demand-generation campaigns that produce qualified leads and sales opportunities Work closely with business development on targeting, outreach angles, sales assets, and lead follow-up Run lean, fast experiments across LinkedIn, email, social, and the website, then double down on what works Develop and execute the B2B marketing and go-to-market strategy. Build demand-generation campaigns that produce qualified leads and sales opportunities. Develop compelling brand positioning, messaging, and content that differentiates the company in the market. Establish marketing priorities, performance metrics, and processes that support sustainable growth Qualifications 3+ years of experience in growth, creative, or brand marketing, in a role where you made things and shipped them yourself A portfolio or track record of creative campaigns, content, or design work that got real attention Hands-on skills in design, visual storytelling, and content production, including video, motion, or graphics Proven ability to turn creative work into qualified leads and revenue, with a working understanding of demand generation and positioning Understanding of the creative agency world, ideally from working in agencies or marketing creative products to them Experience in early-stage companies where you made a big impact with a small budget Strong storytelling and writing skills Advanced use of AI tools and creative technology to produce and test ideas quickly Strong written and verbal English communication skills (C1 or above) A curious, entrepreneurial, and resourceful mindset: you learn fast, take initiative, and aren't afraid to try what nobody else is trying Additional Information About SaaS Talent SaaS Talent is more than just a recruiting company. From streamlining sales, marketing, and operations to hiring ideal talent and getting funding, if you're struggling to grow, we're an ideal choice. Reach out to us at www.saas-talent.com to learn more about how we can help you . This person will play a critical role in bringing our product portfolio to life, leading go-to-market strategy for new launches, buildi
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote (USA) About the Role Glossier is seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly collaborative Product Marketing leader to oversee product marketing across our portfolio during a maternity leave. This person will play a critical role in bringing our product portfolio to life, leading go-to-market strategy for new launches, building enduring equity around our most iconic products, and translating product truths and consumer insights into compelling, culturally relevant storytelling that builds brand desire and drives commercial results. Sitting at the intersection of Product Development, Brand, Creative, Integrated Marketing, and Commercial teams, this role will connect product innovation with consumer needs and business objectives—translating what makes our products special into clear positioning, impactful campaigns, and commercially successful launches. We're looking for someone who can balance big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution, navigate a fast-moving environment, and confidently drive projects and decisions forward. Key Responsibilities Product Positioning & Strategy Own product marketing strategy across Glossier's portfolio, including new product launches, existing icons, and key commercial moments. Develop compelling product positioning, consumer insights, key messaging, and points of differentiation that establish a clear role for each product within the Glossier portfolio and competitive landscape as needed. Identify opportunities to strengthen product equity, drive customer acquisition, and increase engagement and repurchase across existing products. Partner closely with Product Development to understand product innovation, benefits, claims, and competitive differentiation, translating technical product information into meaningful consumer-facing storytelling. Help shape future portfolio strategy by identifying market trends, consumer needs, competitive opportunities, and potential assortment gaps. Go-to-Market Leadership Lead product marketing workstreams for upcoming launches, from early positioning and strategy through launch execution. Develop comprehensive go-to-market strategies that establish target audiences, product positioning, key messaging, launch objectives, and commercial opportunities. Lead cross-functional GTM kickoffs, ensuring teams are aligned on product strategy, consumer insights, launch priorities, and key deliverables. Partner with Brand, Creative, Integrated Marketing, Retail, Wholesale, and Education to ensure product positioning is translated consistently and effectively across all consumer touchpoints. Bring strong creative judgment and strategic guidance throughout the creative development process, ensuring campaigns build brand desire, communicate meaningful product differentiation, and deliver against commercial objectives. Manage multiple launches and priorities simultaneously, keeping teams aligned and workstreams moving forward. Portfolio & Commercial Performance Analyze sales performance, consumer feedback, and competitive trends to inform marketing strategies and future product decisions. Identify opportunities to reinvigorate existing products through new storytelling, strategic marketing moments, and customer acquisition initiatives. Support portfolio planning, assortment decisions, and product lifecycle management, including product introductions, discontinuations, and reformulations. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product marketing strategies support brand and commercial objectives across DTC, Sephora, and retail channels. Cross-Functional Collaboration Build effective partnerships with Product Development, Creative, Brand, Integrated Marketing, Education, Retail, Wholesale, and Commercial teams. Represent the consumer perspective throughout the product development and launch process, advocating for clarity, relevance, and differentiation. Ensure a seamless handoff of strategic decisions, deliverables, and ongoing workstreams throughout the coverage period. What We're Looking For 7+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, or a related strategic marketing function, ideally within beauty, skincare, makeup, or consumer brands. Demonstrated experience leading product launches and developing go-to-market strategies from concept through execution. Strong understanding of the beauty landscape, consumer behavior, competitive dynamics, and emerging category trends. Exceptional strategic thinking and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex product benefits into compelling, consumer-friendly messaging. Strong commercial acumen and comfort using performance data, consumer insights, and market research to inform decisions. Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive alignment without direct authority. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting strategies and recommendations to senior leadership. Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. A genuine passion for beauty, product innovation, and the Glossier brand. What Success Looks Like Key product launches remain on track, with clear positioning, strong cross-functional alignment, and compelling go-to-market strategies. Product storytelling is consistent, differentiated, and grounded in both consumer insights and commercial objectives. Existing hero products continue to receive strategic marketing support, with opportunities for growth proactively identified. Cross-functional partners feel supported, informed, and empowered to execute against shared priorities. A seamless transition of workstreams and strategic context is maintained throughout the maternity leave coverage period. Employment Type: Temporary / Maternity Leave Coverage Duration: Approximately 4–5 months To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glossier-director-product-marketing-contractor

Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com . Bitwarden is expanding its sales footprint across the UK & Ireland and is looking for a UK based Mid-Market Account Executive to drive growth across the region. We are seeking an energetic and motivated sales professional with strong sales skills and channel experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 4-8 years of new account or business development experience with a proven track record of engaging the Partner ecosystem to drive success. In your role, you will be responsible for achieving an assigned quota number while also managing lead flow, closing deals, recruiting partners and developing geographical go to market plans. RESPONSIBILITIES Effective prospecting and lead management building a 3-5X pipeline within your territory Predominant focus on closing business in companies with 1000+ employees Managing and reporting a sales pipeline within our CRM, bringing the visibility of the revenue accurately, quarterly Territory planning and any sales support required Focus on activities and opportunities delivering short term and long-term revenue Effective and regular networking to attract and influence Partner sales and grow our Partner relationships Use your existing relationships to recruit and onboarding new partners, get them to agree to engage in proactive demand generation activities Maintain a regional partner plan mapping partner strengths (customer relationships, vertical focus, technology specialty) to accounts and target opportunities Track and manage lead flow both inbound and outbound between partners and the Bitwarden Sales team. Proactively communicate with Bitwarden sales leaders on the channel pipeline and forecast Work closely with marketing to deliver marketing events/programs/campaigns that create interest and awareness among partners’ customers. Build and execute joint partner business plans with measurable success Set financial goals for focus partners and ensure goals achievement Drive multiple key channel initiatives in parallel across technical, professional services, and sales WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN Located in the UK. 4-8 years of outside high-tech IT sales experience. IT security product experience is desirable but not mandatory Experience at a startup or pre $100M revenue company is desirable A proven track-record of driving continued partner growth and revenue Knowledge and strong relationships with SMB and SME focused resellers and MSP partners. Ability to drive influence and build effective relationships with decision makers across all levels of partner organisations Motivated and focused self-starter with strong leadership skills who can multitask, work independently or within a team Exceptional communication skills including listening, writing and public speaking. Can work in a fast paced, start-up environment An avid channel leader who knows how to teach, enable and motivate partners to find and close business Relationships and strong relationships with top VARs and Integrators Must demonstrate a consistent track record of achieving annual quota targets while providing specific details on key customer wins Possesses a competitive attitude, strong work ethic and thrives in a fast pace, high growth and matrixed organisational environment Positive history of collaborative selling Must be a proficient user of CRM tools and other Gsuite and MS Office tools WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS Screening call with our Recruiting team Interview with our Head of Sales - EMEA Interview with our Head of Sales Enablement Interview(s) with the team AE Roleplay A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations. Become an expert in a growing market. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup. We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work with motivated and supportive team members across the world. Contract type: Initial independent contractor engagement. Bitwarden is committed to equal opportunities. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and assess candidates on their skills, experience and suitability for the opportunity. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, United States Senior Manager, Sales Development Remote, United States ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES The mission of the Senior Manager of Sales Development is to build and lead a predictable, high-performing enterprise pipeline engine for Legion. This leader will own the strategy, operating model, and day-to-day performance of the Sales Development organization, ensuring SDRs create qualified conversations and opportunities within large, complex target accounts. This is a hands-on builder-and-operator role. You will lead and develop SDRs while creating the processes, coaching rhythms, reporting, and cross-functional partnerships needed to scale the function. You will partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Enablement to translate Legion’s growth goals into focused account coverage, problem-led messaging, disciplined multichannel execution, and measurable pipeline contribution. We are looking for a data-driven, people-first leader with strong enterprise sales acumen, high operating standards, and the ability to turn strategy into consistent execution. The most critical deliverables include: Achieving monthly and quarterly targets for qualified meetings, opportunities, and SDR-sourced enterprise pipeline. Recruiting, onboarding, coaching, and developing SDRs to improve ramp, performance, retention, and career progression. Establishing consistent 1:1s, call reviews, role-plays, pipeline reviews, and performance-management routines. Partnering with Marketing to coordinate inbound, campaign, event, and account-based follow-up for target accounts. Partnering with Sales leadership and Account Executives to prioritize accounts, align outreach, and improve meeting quality and handoff. Defining and improving outbound playbooks, account research, messaging, qualification, and follow-up processes. Monitoring activity, meetings, conversions, opportunities, pipeline, and capacity to forecast results. Working with Revenue Operations to improve dashboards, CRM discipline, lead routing, workflows, and sales technology adoption. PROFESSIONAL BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales development or related sales experience, including 3+ years leading SDR or BDR teams. Proven success leading an enterprise outbound or account-based motion and delivering qualified pipeline. Experience recruiting, onboarding, coaching, and performance-managing early-career sales talent. Strong enterprise sales acumen, including prospecting into organizations with 5,000+ employees and complex buying committees. Experience partnering with Marketing, Sales and Revenue Operations on account strategy, campaigns, processes, and reporting. Strong communication skills, with experience using data to improve team performance. Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6sense, ZoomInfo, Gong, or similar tools. Experience in workforce management, HR technology, retail technology, operations technology, or similar enterprise software is preferred. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES AND VALUES Hands-on leader who can evolve the strategy, coach the team directly and establish high standards for execution. People-first leader who combines empathy, direct feedback, and accountability. Data-driven problem solver with strong judgment and business acumen. Collaborative leader who builds trust across Marketing, Sales, Operations, and Enablement. Committed to continuous learning and improvement. SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE Success in this role will be measured by your ability to manage a high-performing Sales Development team that creates qualified enterprise pipeline and develops strong talent. Key indicators of success include: Consistent team achievement of qualified meeting, opportunity, and pipeline targets. Improved conversion throughout the funnel—from targeted outreach and conversations to meetings held, qualified opportunities and pipeline created. Strong enterprise account coverage and effective SDR and Account Executive collaboration. Reliable forecasting, trusted dashboards, and consistent CRM and process adoption. Strong SDR ramp, engagement, retention, performance development, and promotion readiness. Effective cross-functional execution with Marketing, Sales and Revenue Operations. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Salary Range: Base Salary Range $130,000 - $145,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and the internal equity for the same position within the company. Benefits include, but are not limited to: $0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment 401k plan Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Parental Leave Equity Monthly Wellness Reimbursement Monthly Lunch on Legion ABOUT LEGION Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones. For more information, visit https://legion.co EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay. Job Applicant Privacy Policy This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“ Policy ”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“ Legion ”, “ we ”, “ us ” and “ our ”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California. This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies. Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information. Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history. Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application. items.summary: Headquarters: Remote, Germany Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Germany Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business. Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions. The Bundeswehr is one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. With our Celonis for Defense & Security initiative, presented at the Munich Security Conference 2026, we offer a sovereign and trusted platform that integrates data across systems and optimizes military processes along the entire value chain. This means higher operational readiness through optimized logistics and faster maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) cycles, greater resilience through end-to-end supply chain transparency, and faster IT modernization by connecting existing systems with modern AI applications. Building on our data analysis solution Metropolis , we also help connect information from a wide range of sources into a comprehensive situational picture , enabling faster and better-informed decisions during the actual mission . To drive this forward, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Bundeswehr . The Role: This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows the Bundeswehr from the inside: how its structures work, how processes in logistics, maintenance or procurement really run, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships across the Bundeswehr and the defense ecosystem, and to position Celonis as a long-term partner for its digital transformation. Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of the armed forces into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market. The Work you'll do: Build and own relationships across the Bundeswehr – Army (Heer), Navy (Marine), Air Force (Luftwaffe) and Cyber and Information Domain Service (CIR) – and its ecosystem, e.g. the Federal Ministry of Defence (BMVg), the Federal Office of Bundeswehr Equipment, Information Technology and In-Service Support (BAAINBw) and BWI GmbH. Engage with decision-makers from leadership, logistics, procurement, IT and digitalization. Translate operational challenges into concrete, AI-enabled use cases with measurable impact, e.g. in logistics and supply, MRO and materiel readiness, supply chain resilience, procurement and IT modernization. Bring the voice of the Bundeswehr into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering. Own an individual revenue target and drive complex, long sales cycles to a successful close. Navigate defense procurement and tender processes (e.g. VSVgV, framework agreements) together with our partners and internal experts. Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and defense IT providers. Represent Celonis at public sector and defense events and conferences. The Qualifications you need: Several years of professional experience within the Bundeswehr , e.g. as an officer or civilian employee, ideally in a leadership role and/or in logistics, procurement, IT, digitalization, planning or organizational development. A solid network within the Bundeswehr and a deep understanding of its organization, decision-making and budget and planning processes (e.g. the procurement process CPM). First-hand understanding of the process and data challenges in areas such as logistics, materiel readiness, maintenance or procurement. A strong interest in moving into a commercial, customer-facing role. Prior experience in sales, business development or consulting is a plus, but not a must. We will support your onboarding into the sales role. Strong affinity for technology, data and AI, and the ability to explain complex topics in a simple and convincing way. Degree in Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program Grit, a hands-on mindset, and the drive to build something new. Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (native or fluent) and English. Familiarity with defense procurement processes is a strong plus. Willingness and eligibility to undergo a security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) if required by our customers. Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset. Willingness to be collaborative and inclusive, to embrace diversity, and strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins #LI-SS6 What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/celonis-account-executive-public-sector-germany-defense-bundeswehr

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote (USA) WHO WE ARE Glossier is a people-powered ecosystem, brought to life by engaging online and offline experiences. In 12 years, we have built an iconic brand that goes far beyond beauty. Our brand is built on trusted emotional connection, empathy, and consistency in how we show up for people every day. We are woven into everyday moments of people’s lives, becoming part of their routines, their self-expression, and their confidence. We are defined not just by what we make, but by how we make people feel and the relationships we build over time. Our north-star values are to be Human, Curious, Playful, and Helpful. We are driven by a shared mission to become the Most Loved Lifestyle Brand in the World. THE ROLE Glossier is seeking a senior brand consultant to help accelerate the brand's cultural & PR relevance, creator ecosystem, and breakthrough marketing initiatives during a pivotal period of growth and evolution. This is not a traditional influencer marketing or PR role. We are looking for a strategic, creatively minded marketer with exceptional cultural instincts, deep relationships across creators, talent, and emerging cultural communities, and a track record of turning ambitious brand ideas into meaningful cultural moments. Working closely with the CMO and cross-functional marketing leadership, this person will bring an outside-in perspective, fresh thinking, and an entrepreneurial approach to building brand heat, relevance, and advocacy. The immediate focus will be an upcoming launch, alongside longer-term brand-first opportunities. Key Areas of Focus New Launch: Develop and help activate an earned-first cultural amplification strategy that extends the launch beyond traditional product marketing. Identify unexpected creators, talent, cultural partners, and communities that can bring the campaign to life in distinctive ways. Originate high-impact brand moments, partnerships, and activations designed to drive conversation, organic advocacy, and cultural relevance. Lead press strategy in partnership with external agency partners Collaborate with Brand Marketing, Influencer, PR, Social, and Creative teams to integrate opportunities into the broader launch plan. Creator & Cultural Ecosystem Help build Glossier's approach to creators and influencers beyond transactional partnerships toward meaningful, sustained brand relationships. Identify emerging cultural voices and tastemakers across beauty, fashion, art, music, lifestyle, and adjacent communities. Develop opportunities for creator-led storytelling, organic advocacy, and innovative collaborations that reinforce Glossier's unique place in culture. Partner with the existing influencer team to elevate strategic thinking and unlock new opportunities. Brand-First Marketing & Narrative Partner with CMO on reinforcing Brand Narrative Collaborate with the CMO and Brand Marketing leadership to identify opportunities for Glossier to show up in culture beyond traditional product launches. Develop compelling ideas for cultural collaborations, community initiatives, and brand platforms that deepen emotional connection with consumers. Explore how Glossier's flagship stores can become meaningful cultural and community destinations through relevant partnerships and programming. Bring fresh inspiration, emerging trends, and outside perspectives to challenge conventional beauty marketing approaches. Compensation for the role will be determined based on permissible, nondiscriminatory factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and experience. Click here to view the candidate privacy policy under FAQs We are an Equal Employment Opportunity (“EEO”) Employer. It has been and will continue to be a fundamental policy of Glossier not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, partnership status, domestic violence victim status, sexual orientation, age, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, unemployment status or any other characteristic prohibited by federal, state and/or local laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, demotion, compensation, training, working conditions, transfer, job assignment, benefits, layoff, and termination. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glossier-senior-brand-consultant-pr-influencer-contractor

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Indonesia URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/3k8LqqAdNwD4WEpupmsk52/jobs-at-mash Location: Malaysia preferred Format: 12-month fixed-term contract Market: Japan Experience: 1–3 years Language: Fluent Japanese and professional English We’re looking for a driven Japanese-speaking Sales Development Representative to support the growth of a publisher acquisition programme across Japan. This role focuses on identifying and qualifying prospective partners, building relationships within the local app developer, gaming and web publisher community, and creating opportunities for the wider sales team. You’ll combine research, outreach and relationship-building with a strong understanding of the local market. You’ll be comfortable starting conversations, learning how digital businesses generate revenue, and helping prospective partners understand the value of digital advertising and monetisation solutions. This is a great opportunity for someone with 1–3 years of early-career sales or business development experience who wants to build their career within technology, apps, gaming and digital advertising. Lead Generation & Qualification Research prospective app developers, gaming studios, web publishers and digital businesses across Japan using Salesforce, Google Play Store, App Store, market intelligence platforms, industry events and networking. Qualify leads using agreed criteria and relevant business and app metrics, including downloads, active users, revenue and growth potential. Build and maintain an organised pipeline of prospects, keeping lead status and activity accurate in Salesforce. Stay close to local market developments and identify emerging businesses, trends and opportunities worth pursuing. Outreach & Relationship Building Execute targeted outreach through email, phone, social media, events and community engagement. Build relationships with prospective publishers and developers and understand their business, growth priorities and monetisation needs. Communicate relevant programme and product value propositions clearly and confidently. Support publishers in understanding digital advertising and monetisation solutions and connect them with the right internal expertise where required. Build credibility within Japan's app developer, gaming and publisher communities through thoughtful and culturally appropriate engagement. Sales & Market Support Schedule and coordinate qualified meetings between prospective partners and the wider sales team. Support preparation for prospect meetings and presentations by gathering relevant company, market and performance information. Track outreach activity, meetings, pipeline progress and conversion in Salesforce. Share recurring prospect feedback, local-market insights and emerging opportunities with regional stakeholders. Support relevant industry events, networking opportunities and partner engagement initiatives. About You Ideally 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, sales development, business development, partnerships or another client-facing commercial role. Fluent Japanese with strong written and verbal communication skills, alongside professional working English. Strong understanding of Japanese business culture and the confidence to engage professionally with local stakeholders. Curious about technology, apps, gaming, digital advertising and the wider publisher ecosystem. Strong research skills with the ability to identify promising businesses and assess commercial opportunities. Confident starting conversations with prospective clients and developing relationships over time. Comfortable working with data and using simple insights to support outreach and commercial conversations. Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple prospects, follow-ups and priorities. Proactive, self-motivated and eager to learn. Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is useful. Previous experience within technology, apps, gaming, AdTech, media or digital businesses is valuable but not essential. Please note Due to the high volume of applications, we unfortunately can’t get back to every one of you, and only successful applicants will be contacted. When you share your details with us, we consider this as consent for us to use your data during the application process. We may implement AI in various stages of the recruitment process, but human involvement will always remain as part of our hiring ethos. At the moment, MASH is not in a position to sponsor work visas, so you have to be eligible to legally work in the country where we’re hiring. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mash-sales-development-representative-japanese-speaking

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Karnataka, India URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/2NbDRiTU8do3haEgHLjLGC/jobs-at-lokal-app Role - Video Editor Work Location - Work From Home About Lokal : In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like: Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony) Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal) Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app) Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital About the role : We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. The role involves crafting short-form and mid-length video content such as social media reels, promos, and branded content. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact. Key Responsibilities: ● Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers. ● Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention. ● Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts). ● Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design. ● Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life. ● Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable. ● Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates. ● Edit videos in the required languages, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience. What You’ll Bring ● 1–2 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content. ● Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar. ● Any Bachelor’s degree. ● Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos). ● Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics. ● Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills. ● Language proficiency: Strong command over two languages minimum — English and TTMK— both written and spoken, to bring cultural nuance and flexibility in writing. ● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with tight deadlines ● Must bring their own laptop to perform day-to-day tasks. Why This Role Is Exciting : ● Create high-impact video content that drives engagement and brand growth. ● Collaborate with cross-functional creative and marketing teams. ● Shape storytelling across platforms with visible, meaningful impact. Why Join Us: ● Create impactful video content ● Competitive pay and growth opportunities ● Work with a creative, fast-moving team We’ll Get Along If You… ● Take ownership of your edits and creative output ● Enjoy storytelling and visual creativity ● Are comfortable with fast-paced timelines and feedback ● Believe in learning, experimenting, and continuous improvement We’ll Get Along If You… ● Take ownership of your edits and creative output ● Enjoy storytelling and visual creativity ● Are comfortable with fast-paced timelines and feedback ● Believe in learning, experimenting, and continuous improvement To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lokal-app-video-editor-ttmk-eaze

items.description: About Dow Janes Dow Janes is a financial education company built by women+, for women+. We help women get out of debt, save intentionally, and invest confidently. Our mission is simple: to get more money in the hands of more women — because when women have money, they have more choices and power. Through education, coaching, and community, we help women build wealth from the inside out — combining smart financial strategy with a healthy relationship to money. What You’ll Do As a Dow Janes Financial Coach (Contractor), your primary role is to provide one-on-one financial coaching via live video calls. You’ll guide members through personalized financial strategies and mindset shifts, helping them build confidence and clarity around money. Topics may include: Budgeting and saving Debt payoff Basic Investing Building credit Real estate and taxes Increasing income Money mindset Financial Decisions You’ll coach in alignment with the Dow Janes methodology of personal finance, supporting clients in creating a healthy relationship with money, living within their means, and developing strong financial habits. You’ll also review and update client session notes to ensure progress is tracked accurately and that each member’s journey is well-documented and supported over time. You’ll Thrive in This Role If You… Are passionate about financial empowerment, especially for women+ Have strong financial expertise and can confidently coach across a variety of topics Can simplify complex financial concepts in a warm, approachable way Have experience with mindset or personal development coaching Believe deeply in people’s capacity to change their financial story at any time Are organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple client conversations independently Are comfortable on video and enjoy one-on-one connection Are tech-savvy and adaptable to new platforms and tools Want the flexibility and autonomy of an independent contractor role Bonus Points If You Have… Niche experience in career, business, real estate, or mindset coaching The ability to work evenings or weekends to accommodate client schedules Conversational fluency in Spanish Compensation & Structure This is a 1099 independent contractor position Compensation is based on experience and coaching volume You’ll set your own schedule within agreed-upon client commitments You’ll work remotely and be paid $50 per completed coaching session This is a flexible, remote role where you can choose your workload — up to a maximum of 25 coaching calls per week, depending on your availability and client demand. Applicants with more availability will be prioritized 3+ years of experience providing 1:1 financial coaching Financial certification or training (Financial Coach certification, AFC®, CFP®, etc. preferred) Strong communication and facilitation skills Reliable internet connection and comfort working remotely Why This Role is Special You’ll use your expertise to directly change lives by helping women gain financial confidence and freedom You’ll have flexibility and independence to design your own schedule You’ll be part of a mission-driven company that values results, impact, and empowerment You’ll join a network of like-minded financial coaches making a real difference
