items.description: About Testlio Hi there! We’re Testlio, a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012. We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps us identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers. Learn more about us at www.testlio.com. We’re looking for people in Paraguay to help test online payments for an international payments technology company. Requirements Location: Currently living in Paraguay Access to at least one of the following payment methods: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Infonet, USDC, USDT. Comfortable following written instructions and sharing feedback in English. Frequency: Expected weekly opportunities, with occasional additional requests. Work type: Remote, freelance, and flexible. You don’t need access to every payment method. Having one is enough to apply! What You’ll Do Follow simple, step-by-step instructions from our testing team. Complete small, authorized test transactions using eligible payment methods. Check whether payments are successful or if any errors appear. Share your results and report issues, including screenshots when needed. Why do we need local testers? Payment methods work differently from country to country. A transaction that works in one country might fail in another. That’s why we need people who live locally and have access to the payment methods customers actually use. Your role is to help us check whether payments work correctly and report any issues you find. No previous software testing experience is required. Privacy & Security We take the protection of personal and financial information seriously. You’ll only be asked to complete authorized testing activities. Never share passwords, full card numbers, or sensitive account information in your reports. Interested in joining us? Apply through our official Testlio Work Opportunities page. If your profile matches the project requirements, our team will reach out with the next steps. All official email communications will come from a @testlio.com email address, so please keep an eye on your inbox! #LI-REMOTE

items.description: Company Description The Grinding & Dispersing division is one of the world’s leading suppliers of grinding and mixing technology. The comprehensive range of machines and systems is used in a wide variety of industries such as the chemical, mineral and food industries. The division’s strength lies in customized solutions for process engineering tasks. Job Description Review construction and commissioning documentation, mechanical and electrical drawings, instrument and I/O lists, control philosophies, technical specifications, equipment documentation, punch lists and project requirements. Coordinate and execute mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, automation, piping and structural activities during installation and commissioning in alignment with project schedules, engineering requirements, quality and safety standards. Verify mechanical completion and system readiness, identify deficiencies, and manage punch-list generation, tracking and closure in preparation for energization and commissioning. Perform and support equipment verification, mechanical adjustments, loop checks, I/O and instrument testing, functional and interlock testing, electrical energization, cold commissioning, start-up and operational testing through customer acceptance and final handover. Coordinate interfaces and dependencies between mechanical, electrical, automation and process disciplines, and investigate and resolve multidisciplinary technical issues during commissioning and start-up. Act as the primary on-site interface with customers, subcontractors, suppliers, project management and engineering teams, coordinating resources and priorities, reporting progress, escalating issues, and ensuring compliance with health, safety, environmental and quality requirements. Maintain commissioning records, inspection and test reports, loop-check documentation, punch lists and project close-out records; extensive travel and presence at customer facilities are required during installation, commissioning and start-up. Qualifications Technical degree, higher vocational training, associate degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering or a related technical discipline Minimum 5 years of experience in commissioning, start-up, installation or field service of industrial plants, process systems or industrial equipment Experience in mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, control and automation commissioning, including operational testing of industrial process equipment Strong technical knowledge of industrial mechanical and electrical systems, instrumentation, control architectures and PLC-controlled equipment; experience with Siemens or Allen-Bradley is an advantage Knowledge of grinding, mixing, slurry preparation and powder handling systems for battery materials, advanced materials or mineral processing; basic understanding of ATEX is desirable Experience coordinating subcontractors and multidisciplinary site activities, combined with a structured, hands-on and solution-oriented working style and effective customer communication Very good command of English, both spoken and written, is mandatory; additional languages are an advantage High willingness to travel, including internationally, and work on-site at customer facilities. Additional Information This is a remote, field-based position involving extensive travel, including internationally, and regular assignments at customer sites. A valid international driving license is required.

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Montreal, Quebec, Canada URL: https://www.sweatpantsagency.com/ Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. That is the whole job. Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business. So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face. At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero. You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end. Here is what "end to end" actually means. You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result. You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme. You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number. You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output. If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast. If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading. Requirements What the job looks like Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month. Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working. Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people. Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing. Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target. Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule. Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery. Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why. Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team. Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt. You are a fit if You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search. You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have. You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it. You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list. You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard. You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you. Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too. You are not a fit if "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed. You want to be told what to do this week. You need a ticketing system to know what matters. You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question. Benefits Why this role is exciting This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency. You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale. You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident. You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweat-pants-agency-ppc-marketing-specialist-remote

items.summary: We’re looking for a Data Engineer with a background in bioinformatics to help build and evolve the pipelines supporting Our Future Health’s genetic data releases. This is an opportunity to combine Python, genomics, and practical problem-solving, turning complex genetic data into reliable datasets that researchers can use to improve how diseases are
items.description: We’re looking for a Data Engineer with a background in bioinformatics to help build and evolve the pipelines supporting Our Future Health’s genetic data releases. This is an opportunity to combine Python, genomics, and practical problem-solving, turning complex genetic data into reliable datasets that researchers can use to improve how diseases are prevented, detected, and treated. Our Future Health is an ambitious collaboration between the public, charity and private sectors, designed to help people live healthier lives for longer through better prevention, earlier detection and improved treatment of diseases. We will speed up the discovery of new methods of early disease detection, and the evaluation of new diagnostic tools, to help identify and treat diseases early, when outcomes are usually better. With over 2.9M volunteers across the UK, we’re now the world’s biggest health research programme of its kind, and our volunteer group is also more diverse than other, similar health research programmes. Technology and data are central to our mission. Our systems power web sites, clinics across the UK, secure analytics and research systems, and pipelines that process highly sensitive health and genetic data, and we are continuing to grow our engineering capability to support this ambition. You’ll join our Genetic Data Growth squad where you’ll help improve existing pipelines, develop new workflows, and explore synthetic datasets for testing. You’ll also support internal specialists and researchers, helping make sure our data is available in the formats they need. Role Impact This role will bring in-depth knowledge of genetic data and data solutions to help solve some of the key challenges around a programme of work at an industrial scale with global significance. You’ll be contributing towards the delivery of data releases that will be used worldwide. You will work with genetic data and build pipelines and systems to process data, control quality, and create data releases for researchers. You’ll be part of a multidisciplinary team that’s creating pipelines that didn’t exist before, owning them in production and improving them over time. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Day to day work will vary depending on what your focus is at that time, but will include things like: Support the build of data pipelines from data providers to our primary data store and Trusted Research Environment. Produce logic for data transformation steps as code, which meets the requirements for our end users and builds well-curated, accessible and quality controlled data for analysis. Developing prototypes for pipelines for complex transformations drawing on existing workflows developed in industry and academia. Keep abreast of best practice in data engineering across industry, research and Government and facilitating the adoption of standards. Providing technical input into the upstream parts of the data pipeline, including the specification and transfer of data from data providers. Routine ad-hoc data curation activities requiring hands on development of bespoke ETL cleaning scripts using languages such as Python. Working with researchers to understand the data requirements and work with them to deliver the data needed for their projects. Candidate Profile You have a solid understanding and experience of bioinformatics, in particular tools and methods associated with genomic data . You can design, build, and test pipelines using a range of different technologies. You know how to create repeatable and reusable products. You know how to communicate to and between technical and non-technical stakeholders as well as facilitate discussions within a multidisciplinary team including scientists, software engineers, product managers, and other data engineers. You know how to manage different perspectives. We welcome applications from all who may not feel they match the full criteria, so if you have most of the below, we’d like to hear from you: Detailed knowledge and understanding of genomic data (experience in genotyping and imputation is advantageous). Experience using bioinformatics file standards (VCF, BGEN etc) and tools (PLINK, bcftools, QCtools etc) Experience in validating and QC’ing complex genomic datasets. Experience building and maintaining robust, scalable and efficient pipelines capable of processing very large amounts of data from one or multiple systems. You know how to create repeatable and reusable products. Highly proficient in Python. Experience working in an agile development team. Experience with version control (Git/GitHub). Follow best practices like code review, clean code and unit tests. Understanding of information governance and data security approaches appropriate for sensitive health data (ISO 270001). Experience of workflow management tools, e.g. Nextflow, WDL/Cromwell, Airflow, Prefect, Dagster Understanding of containerisation (e.g. Docker) and deployment (e.g. Kubernetes). Good understanding of cloud environments (ideally Azure), distributed computing and scaling workflows and pipelines. Why join us? You’ll build on your bioinformatics experience while developing your engineering skills alongside experienced engineers and statistical geneticists. There’s support to help you get started, with opportunities to take on more responsibility as your confidence and knowledge grow. You’ll join as we evolve our pipelines to handle new challenges in scale, data quality and researcher needs. We’re looking for curiosity, careful working practices and a willingness to learn; you don’t need experience with every tool in our stack. You may work remotely from anywhere within the UK, with occasional travel to London. Hiring process We feel hiring should be transparent and give you a real sense of what Our Future Health is like. Here’s what you can expect: Initial chat with our Talent team (30 min) to get to know each other, discuss the role, and answer any questions you have. 1st interview with our Engineering Manager, Tory Offord (30 min) – this is an opportunity to learn more about each other and align on role expectations. Competency interview (60 min) with a small cross-functional panel of your potential new colleagues. This will focus on how you collaborate, work with stakeholders, and navigate ambiguity and challenges in real-world projects. Final stage technical interview with members of our engineering team (60 min), designed to explore your engineering skills and how you would approach the real-world responsibilities of this role. We’ll share the format and any preparation details ahead of the interview. Competitive base salary from £62,000 per annum Generous Pension Scheme – We invest in your future with employer contributions of up to 12% 30 Days Holiday pro rata + Bank Holidays – Enjoy a generous holiday allowance with the flexibility to take bank holidays when it suits you Enhanced Parental Leave – Supporting you during life’s biggest moments Cycle to Work Scheme – Save 25-39% on a new bike and accessories through salary sacrifice Home & Tech Savings – Get up to 8% off on IKEA and Currys products, spreading the cost over 12 months through salary sacrifice EV Scheme – Save up to 40% on a brand new electric vehicle all-inclusive package through salary sacrifice £1,000 Employee Referral Bonus – Know someone amazing? Get rewarded for bringing them on board! Wellbeing Support – Access to Mental Health First Aiders, plus 24 ⁄ 7 online GP services and an Employee Assistance Programme for you and your family A Great Place to Work – We have a lovely Central London office in Holborn, and offer flexible and remote working arrangements We recommend you apply as soon as possible as occasionally due to high volumes of applications, we need to close our postings early. _At Our Future Health, we recognise the importance of having a diverse workforce and ensuring that all candidates, regardless of their background, have equitable access to our application process. We proactively encourage applicants who identify as having a disability, neurodiversity, or long-term health conditions to let us know if they require any reasonable adjustments as part of their application process._ If you do require any reasonable adjustments, please email us at talent@ourfuturehealth.org.uk

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: CA - San Francisco HQ; CA-Remote Employee Applicant Privacy Notice Who we are: Shape a brighter financial future with us. Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance. We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world. The role: SoFi is seeking an energetic, organized, and resourceful Direct Mail Marketing Manager for a one-year contract to manage the end-to-end direct mail creative process for the SoFi Credit Card product, from strategy and planning through creative development, stakeholder review, approval, production, and tracking. This role will also analyze campaign performance and provide recommendations to optimize future direct mail strategies and creative. At SoFi, you’ll become part of a new kind of finance company whose ambition is to help our members achieve financial independence and reach their goals. We aim to be at the center of our members’ financial lives and help every member get their money right. We created student loan refinancing, addressing the biggest financial challenge of a new generation through a modern approach to lending and personal finance. Next, we expanded our products and services across loans, investing, and cash management. SoFi has achieved significant growth, with ambitious plans ahead, but to continue this growth, we need great talent. And that starts with you. What you’ll do: This role owns four core areas of responsibility: 1. Creative Strategy & Planning Lead end-to-end creative strategy and execution for Credit Card direct mail campaigns, partnering with Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to align initiatives with business goals, priorities, and growth objectives. Lead quarterly creative planning with the creative agency, using audience insights, customer behavior, performance data, and test-and-learn principles to develop strategic recommendations for the Product Marketing Manager. Lead upfront data and audience planning with DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science and agency team defining targeting, segmentation, personalization, measurement requirements, and data inputs that inform the creative strategy, testing plan, and campaign brief. Own the creative roadmap and partner with the creative agency to develop compelling messaging, visual storytelling, offers, personalization, branding, and calls to action. 2. Campaign & Production Management Serve as the day-to-day campaign lead and primary liaison among Product Marketing Manager, the creative and data strategy agency, DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science, other internal stakeholders, and print vendors. Serve as the lead DM representative in Credit Card business unit meetings, Marketing Data Science handoff meetings, and other recurring meetings. Prepare slides as needed, capture key decisions and action items, and distribute notes to appropriate stakeholders. Translate approved strategies into actionable campaign plans, creative briefs, testing plans, and production requirements. Manage monthly direct mail tests and creative variations, ensuring audience definitions, segmentation, data requirements, personalization, and creative variants are aligned and executable. Own campaign timelines and the shared production calendar, including data due dates, creative milestones, review rounds, release dates, print dates, and drop dates. Manage assets, versioning, production samples, dependencies, risks, and bottlenecks to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time. Maintain the monthly campaign matrix, including audience targeting, creative variations, testing plans, data requirements, and other campaign details. Partner with Marketing Data Science to update campaign matrices and verify that targeting and personalization information is accurate before each drop. Lead weekly status meetings with Product Marketing Managers, including agenda development, stakeholder alignment, and action-item follow-up. 3. Compliance, Quality & Operations Lead the Compliance and Legal review process for direct mail materials, partnering with Product Marketing and the creative agency to ensure executions meet regulatory, disclosure, brand, and business requirements. Manage creative review and quality control across messaging, data, personalization, offers, URLs, disclosures, and final production files. Serve as the central point of accountability for ensuring every campaign is accurate, compliant, data-aligned, approved, and production-ready. Manage campaign production and postage costs, partnering with the DM billing team to keep campaigns within budget. 4. Performance, Insights & Competitive Intelligence Partner with Marketing Data Science, analytics, and the creative agency to evaluate campaign and creative test results against product and business goals. Translate audience, performance, and campaign data into actionable insights that inform creative recommendations, messaging, offers, personalization, segmentation, and future test strategies. Lead weekly Product Marketing Manager performance updates and monthly reporting, presenting results and optimization recommendations to Product Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders. Apply campaign learnings to improve future direct mail initiatives and inform the creative roadmap. Build and maintain a competitive direct mail library, monitoring competitor activity, creative trends, offers, formats, personalization, and audience strategies. Share monthly competitive and performance insights with the broader Marketing organization to inform future campaign and product marketing strategy. What you’ll need: Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of project management experience, preferably supporting direct mail or other marketing campaigns within financial services or another highly regulated industry. Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to execute complex, multi-channel campaigns and operational initiatives. Experience managing high-volume direct mail, CRM, lifecycle, or integrated marketing creative execution, ideally within financial services, credit cards, banking, or another highly regulated industry. Strong project and production management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, creative versions, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously. Highly proficient in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Gmail, and Calendar, Tableau, Snowflake; comfortable building and maintaining detailed trackers and production workflows. Strong understanding of creative development, production, version control, review/approval processes, and vendor management. Experience working directly with Legal, Compliance, Creative, Marketing, Analytics, Data, and external production vendors. Strong attention to detail and a high level of ownership, particularly when managing personalized credit card communications where small errors can have significant downstream impact. Comfortable working in a test-and-learn environment, using campaign performance data to inform future creative decisions. Excellent communication and organizational skills with the ability to keep senior stakeholders informed while driving day-to-day execution. Financial services or credit card marketing experience strongly preferred, particularly familiarity with regulated marketing, compliance reviews, disclosures, and credit-related communications. Compensation and Benefits The base pay range for this role is listed below. items.title: Market Curation Editor — Politics
items.summary: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch.
items.description: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled. What You'll Do Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates. Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date. Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays. Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections. Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call. Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin. Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event. Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation. Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture. Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators. What We're Looking For 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise. Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races. Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts). Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts. Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls. Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination. Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known. Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics. Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights. Nice to Have Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket. Background in polling and election modeling — for example, FiveThirtyEight during its ABC/ESPN era, Decision Desk HQ, VoteHub, or similar outlets; data-journalism experience of this kind, including at spinoffs such as Fifty Plus One, is also relevant. Prior work on a political trading desk, or standing as a super-user of political prediction apps. Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards. Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards, particularly around politically sensitive content. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Germany Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business. Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions. The police are one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. Police officers spend a large proportion of their time on data work and comparatively little on the actual investigation. We want to turn that around. With our new police solution, Metropolis, we help police authorities connect and make sense of their data, so that officers can focus on what matters most: solving cases and keeping people safe . To address this, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Police . The Role: This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows police work from the inside: how investigations really run, where time is lost in data work, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships with police authorities at federal and state level and position Celonis as a long-term partner for their digital transformation. Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of police work into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market. The Work you'll do: Build and own relationships with police authorities at federal and state level, e.g. Bundespolizei, Bundeskriminalamt (BKA), Landeskriminalämter (LKA), Landespolizeien and the responsible Interior Ministries . Engage with decision-makers from police leadership, investigation units, IT and digitalization departments, and procurement Translate investigators' daily challenges into concrete, AI-enabled use cases for Celonis and Metropolis, with measurable impact (e.g. time saved per case, faster case processing). Bring the voice of the police into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering. Own an individual revenue target and drive complex, long sales cycles to a successful close. Navigate public procurement and tender processes (e.g. VgV, VSVgV, UVgO, framework agreements) together with our partners and internal experts. Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and public IT service providers. Represent Celonis at public sector events, conferences and police-specific forums. The qualifications you need: Several years of professional experience within the German police (federal or state level), ideally in a leadership role and/or in an area close to investigations, criminal analysis, IT, digitalization or organizational development. A solid network within the police landscape and a deep understanding of how police authorities and Interior Ministries are organized, how decisions are made and how budgets are planned. First-hand understanding of the data challenges in police work, e.g. case management, evidence and data analysis, and cross-agency information sharing. A strong interest in moving into a commercial, customer-facing role. Prior experience in sales, business development or consulting is a plus, but not a must. We will support your onboarding into the sales role. Strong affinity for technology, data and AI, and the ability to explain complex topics in a simple and convincing way. Degree in Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program Grit, a hands-on mindset, and the drive to build something new. Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (native or fluent) and very good English. Familiarity with public procurement processes is a strong plus. Willingness and eligibility to undergo a security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) if required by our customers. Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset. Willingness to be collaborative and inclusive, to embrace diversity, and strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins #LI-SS6 What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/celonis-account-executive-public-sector-germany-police-polizei

items.title: SEO - Manager
items.summary: Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building. Job Role: SEO / AEO Manager Job Type: Contract - USA Job Description About This Role Bounteous is leading the charge in dynamic digital experiences and is looking for forward-thinking search experts to help drive measurable impact for some of the world's most recognizable and ambitious brands. In today's AI-driven, zero-click search landscape, our approach helps brands envision, harness, and enable their digital presence across traditional search engines, AI-powered discovery platforms, and emerging search experiences. We are seeking a SEO / AEO Manager to lead holistic search strategy across our client portfolio, spanning traditional SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and AI search visibility across platforms including Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot. This individual will drive performance across traditional SEO, AEO, and AI-powered search experiences. The ideal candidate understands how search has evolved beyond rankings- into entities, AI Overviews, generative search, and full-SERP ownership, and can translate that evolution into business growth. The ideal candidate has already built or scaled an AI-search-visibility practice, not just a traditional SEO program with AI terminology added on top. This contractor will work cross-functionally with internal teams and client stakeholders to develop and execute advanced search strategies that drive visibility, authority, and measurable ROI, defined jointly with each client at engagement kickoff (see Success Metrics below). Role & Responsibilities As the SEO & AEO Manager, you will lead strategic search initiatives across enterprise client accounts, driving business growth and client success as a key member of our search practice. You will own strategy development, execution oversight, and performance measurement across traditional SEO and AI-driven search ecosystems. Â Key Responsibilities Search & AEO Strategy Leadership Lead holistic search strategy development, including traditional SEO, AEO, and AI search optimization, to drive full-funnel growth. Develop strategies to capture and optimize for AI Overviews, Featured Snippets, People Also Ask, zero-click search experiences, and conversational queries. Drive entity-based optimization strategies to strengthen brand authority and knowledge graph presence. Partner with content and digital teams to align SEO strategy with E-E-A-T best practices. AI & Emerging Search Optimization Optimize content and technical implementations for AI-driven search environments, including generative search engines and LLM discovery platforms, specifically ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, Gemini, and Copilot. Develop structured data and schema strategies to enhance visibility in rich results, AI summaries, and enhanced SERP features. Stand up and manage AI-visibility monitoring using a dedicated citation-tracking platform â track share of AI citations, sentiment, and source attribution across client brands and named competitors. Monitor evolving search engine algorithms and AI search trends, proactively adjusting strategy to maintain competitive advantage. Establish processes for measuring AI search visibility and zero-click performance impact. Technical & Content SEO Execution Perform and present comprehensive technical, content, competitive, local, and app SEO audits. Develop SEO functional specifications for technical enhancements, partnering with developers to implement, QA, and UAT updates. Conduct advanced keyword, topic cluster, and entity research to inform scalable content strategies. Identify opportunities for content optimization, consolidation, pruning, and authority building. Cross-Functional & Client Collaboration Collaborate closely with paid search, analytics, UX, product, and development teams to drive integrated search performance. Present insights and recommendations to internal and client stakeholders, translating complex SEO and AI-search concepts into business-focused outcomes. Align search strategies with broader omnichannel marketing and digital transformation initiatives. Data, Measurement & Automation Take a data-driven approach to measuring SEO and AEO ROI against the metrics defined in Success Metrics below. Develop reporting frameworks that account for traditional traffic, zero-click engagement, SERP feature ownership, and AI search visibility. Leverage automation tools, APIs, AI workflows, and scripting (e.g., Python, Google Apps Script, or SQL) to improve efficiency and scalability. ~~advanced Excel or scripting capabilities~~ Use reporting and visualization platforms (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau) to communicate performance insights and strategic opportunities. Project Management & Delivery Manage project timelines and deliverables within project management systems (e.g., JIRA), ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met. Operate effectively in a contractor capacity, managing priorities across multiple accounts while maintaining strategic clarity and execution rigor. Qualifications Required 6-8years of experience driving SEO performance for enterprise or large-scale brands, including client-facing or agency experience Demonstrated ownership of both traditional SEO and AEO/GEO initiatives, including having built an AI-search-visibility measurement practice from scratch â not just applied AEO terminology to an existing SEO program. AI Overviews and generative search experiences Structured data and schema implementation Entity-based optimization and knowledge graph strategy E-E-A-T frameworks and authority-building strategies Hands-on experience with leading SEO platforms: SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Lumar (DeepCrawl), Yext, Lighthouse, and Google Business Profile. Hands-on experience with at least one dedicated AI-visibility/citation-tracking platform (e.g., Profound, Peec AI, Scrunch AI, AthenaHQ, or the AI-visibility modules within Semrush/Ahrefs). Experience managing project timelines and deliverables within a PM system (e.g., JIRA). Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and business recommendations. Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to senior stakeholders and client leadership teams. Â Preferred Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Familiarity with AI-powered workflows, automation tools, APIs, and scripting (Python, SQL, or Google Apps Script) for reporting automation. Prior experience managing search strategy across multiple concurrent client accounts in an agency or consultancy setting. Information Security Responsibilities Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information We invite you to stay connected with us by subscribing to our monthly job openings alert here . Bounteous does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.Â Bounteous is willing to sponsor eligible candidates for employment visas.Â Â #BI-Remote #LI-Remote Please mention the word **UNABASHED** and tag RMy40Mi4xNTcuMTk= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMy40Mi4xNTcuMTk=). items.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
items.summary: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: Remote, Germany, EMEA From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re seeking a Principal Software Engineer to contribute to the technical architecture, design and development of Fivetran’s Managed Data Lake product offering. As part of a senior engineering team, you’ll partner with product and engineering teams to build scalable, high-performance systems, advance open-source technologies, and set technical standards that raise the bar across the organization. This is a full-time remote position based out of Germany. Technologies You’ll Use Java, C++, Postgres, Temporal, gRPC AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Grafana Iceberg, Polaris, Delta Lake, Parquet, DuckDB What You’ll Do Partner closely with product teams to understand requirements and design cutting-edge new capabilities that go directly into customer’s hands. Design, develop, implement, and operate highly reliable large-scale data lake systems in cooperation with a dedicated data lake engineering team. Contribute to open-source projects such as DuckDB and Polaris. Embrace Fivetran innovations with open-source standards and toolsets. Analyze fault-tolerance and high availability issues, performance and scale challenges, and solve them. Ensure operational excellence of the services and meet the commitments to our customers regarding security, reliability, availability, and performance. Set technical directions and influence cross-functional teams. Skills We’re Looking For 6+ years of hands-on or research experience with high-performance relational data management systems. Deep understanding of infrastructure & software optimizations and performance engineering to drive significant performance, latency, and availability improvements. Proven track record of leading and delivering large and complicated projects. Strong development skills in Java and C++. Solid experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP). Demonstrated knowledge of columnar storage formats. Growth mindset and excitement about breaking the status quo by seeking innovative solutions. Excellent team player who is consistent in making everyone around you better. Bonus Skills Strongly prefer an MS or PhD in Computer Science, ideally focusing on database management and/or storage engines. #LI-IM1 #LI-REMOTE The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process. Pay Range €138.400 — €173.000 EUR Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in Forbes . Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form . We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fivetran-principal-software-engineer-data-lakes

items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: EMEA Remote About Customer.io Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. About the role Hi, I’m Matt Lane, Sr. Manager of Account Management at Customer.io , and I’m hiring a Sr. Account Manager to join our EMEA team. This is a sales role. You’ll own a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise customers and be accountable for generating expansion pipeline, closing new revenue, and securing renewals. You’ll build on existing customer relationships and prospect beyond them. That means cold calling people who haven’t worked with us, identifying new buying teams, and winning business with additional brands within the same parent company. You’ll lead discovery, build relationships with multiple stakeholders, and own each deal from the first conversation through negotiation and close. We’re looking for someone with a track record in B2B sales who can walk us through an expansion deal they sourced and closed. You should be comfortable generating your own pipeline, multi-threading across complex accounts, and using a sales methodology such as MEDDICC to qualify opportunities and move deals forward. This role is open to candidates based in the UK or Ireland only. What we value Commercial ownership — you treat your book of business like it's yours, because it is Forecasting discipline and data-driven decision-making, not gut feel Multi-threaded relationships — you build trust across the org, not just with one champion Expansion through value, not feature gates or mechanical levers Close partnership with Customer Success — you see CS as a collaborator, not a handoff What you'll do Own the full commercial strategy for a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts — renewals, expansion, and churn mitigation Drive growth by helping customers adopt Customer.io more strategically, identifying new use cases and articulating ROI clearly Forecast renewal and expansion pipeline accurately with a clear, repeatable methodology Build multi-threaded relationships from day-to-day operators to Directors and VPs, becoming a trusted commercial advisor Partner closely with Customer Success on account health and with Sales on expansion deals Engage Legal and Finance on complex renewals and collaborate cross-functionally to move deals forward What we're looking for 3+ years in Sr. Account Management, Sales, or a related SaaS commercial role with direct ownership of a revenue number (5+ years preferred) Experience managing $5m ARR, predominantly in the MM space Proven ability to grow customer spend outside of overages or true-ups — genuine expansion through adoption and value articulation A forecasting methodology you can walk through clearly — it doesn't need to be a named framework, just logic you own Comfortable pulling usage data, tracking health scores, and building your own dashboards Strong communicator — clear and persuasive with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Based in the UK or Ireland Compensation & Benefits We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $142,900 - $171,000 OTE USD (or equivalent in your local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. This role is a 70/30 OTE split. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build. We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more. See full benefits here → Our Process No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision. 30-minute video call with a Recruiter 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager Take-Home Assignment 1-hour Assignment Review Call with the team All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process. Join us! Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read — apply now. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-sr-account-manager-emea

items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: Americas Remote About Customer.io Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. About the role Hi, I’m TJ Jackson, Manager of Account Management at Customer.io , and I’m hiring a Sr. Account Manager to join our North America's team. This is a sales role. You’ll own a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise customers and be accountable for generating expansion pipeline, closing new revenue, and securing renewals. You’ll build on existing customer relationships and prospect beyond them. That means cold calling people who haven’t worked with us, identifying new buying teams, and winning business with additional brands within the same parent company. You’ll lead discovery, build relationships with multiple stakeholders, and own each deal from the first conversation through negotiation and close. We’re looking for someone with a track record in B2B sales who can walk us through an expansion deal they sourced and closed. You should be comfortable generating your own pipeline, multi-threading across complex accounts, and using a sales methodology such as MEDDICC to qualify opportunities and move deals forward. This role is open to candidates based in US and Canada only. What we value Commercial ownership — you treat your book of business like it's yours, because it is Forecasting discipline and data-driven decision-making, not gut feel Multi-threaded relationships — you build trust across the org, not just with one champion Expansion through value, not feature gates or mechanical levers Close partnership with Customer Success — you see CS as a collaborator, not a handoff What you'll do Own the full commercial strategy for a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts — renewals, expansion, and churn mitigation Drive growth by helping customers adopt Customer.io more strategically, identifying new use cases and articulating ROI clearly Forecast renewal and expansion pipeline accurately with a clear, repeatable methodology Build multi-threaded relationships from day-to-day operators to Directors and VPs, becoming a trusted commercial advisor Partner closely with Customer Success on account health and with Sales on expansion deals Engage Legal and Finance on complex renewals and collaborate cross-functionally to move deals forward What we're looking for 3+ years in Sr. Account Management, Sales, or a related SaaS commercial role with direct ownership of a revenue number (5+ years preferred) Experience managing $5m ARR, predominantly in the MM space Proven ability to grow customer spend outside of overages or true-ups — genuine expansion through adoption and value articulation A forecasting methodology you can walk through clearly — it doesn't need to be a named framework, just logic you own Comfortable pulling usage data, tracking health scores, and building your own dashboards Strong communicator — clear and persuasive with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Based in the UK or Ireland Compensation & Benefits We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $142,900 - $171,000 OTE USD (or equivalent in your local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. This role is a 70/30 OTE split. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build. We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more. See full benefits here → Our Process No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision. 30-minute video call with a Recruiter 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager Take-Home Assignment 1-hour Assignment Review Call with the team All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process. Join us! Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read — apply now. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-sr-account-manager-amer-remote

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://www.catonetworks.com Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. Cato Networks is seeking a NOC Engineer to join the team. In this critical role, you will be monitoring, supporting, and providing advanced troubleshooting of a large complex data network infrastructure by using network monitoring and management tools. You will work closely with teams from our business areas, network engineering, and management as a team representative on major incident bridges. This is a remote position based in the Philippines. Key Responsibilities Own and manage the uptime, stability, and overall functionality of the company’s production systems. This includes troubleshooting and resolving system and network issues end-to-end. Monitor and respond to NetOps alerts during working hours, and review/follow up on alerts triggered outside business hours as required. Continuously track and analyze system performance to identify risks, bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and opportunities for optimization. Proactively mitigate outages and system malfunctions to prevent customer impact. When necessary, prepare clear and prioritized escalations to the relevant Development teams. Coordinate with third-party service providers (e.g., carriers, SMS providers, IX providers, and other vendors) to resolve network and system-related issues. Provide advanced (higher-tier) technical support to internal Customer Support teams (T1–T3). Design, implement, and maintain dashboards and alerting mechanisms to ensure system visibility and operational awareness. Serve as a technical focal point for Customer Support and Field Engineering teams by understanding business use cases and translating them into operational requirements. Contribute to building, improving, and expanding NetOps ownership, processes, documentation, and operational best practices. Role Scope The role is primarily driven by automated system alerts requiring investigation, troubleshooting, and escalation when necessary. The role also involves handling customer-impacting issues escalated by the Customer Support organization. In addition to reactive tasks, the position includes ongoing projects and operational initiatives to be managed during working hours. Required Skills & Experience Strong experience in network architecture, cloud architecture, and security architecture. Deep knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, firewalls, proxy servers, and related technologies. Strong ability to analyze system and application logs to identify root causes of issues. Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex network and system incidents. Experience working in a Cloud or SaaS technology environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document findings and communicate with cross-functional teams. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple concurrent projects and incidents simultaneously. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cato-networks-noc-engineer
