items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote USA Sumo Logic is seeking a highly organized, analytical, and process-driven Partner Marketing Program Manager to support the growth and operational effectiveness of our global partner marketing organization. This role will be responsible for managing the systems, processes, and governance that power our partner marketing programs, with a primary focus on our Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platform, Market Development Funds (MDF), partner program operations, and performance reporting. The ideal candidate brings experience in B2B technology channel marketing, understands the complexities of working with MSSPs, VARs, and distributors, and thrives on building scalable processes that improve efficiency, accountability, and business impact. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex programs, improving operational workflows, and enabling regional teams and partners to execute successfully. What Success Looks Like In this role, success means: Establishing a reliable, well-managed PRM platform that supports global partner marketing needs. Improving partner and internal team adoption of Impartner. Implementing consistent MDF governance, approval processes, and financial tracking. Providing accurate, timely visibility into MDF spending, utilization, and program performance. Reducing manual processes and administrative delays across partner marketing operations. Improving partner accountability and reporting of marketing-generated opportunities and pipeline. Enabling regional marketing teams to execute programs efficiently through standardized tools and processes. Building scalable operational foundations that support Sumo Logic’s growing global partner ecosystem. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing, partner marketing, channel operations, or marketing program management. Hands-on experience working with Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms, preferably Impartner. Demonstrated experience managing MDF programs, including funding requests, approvals, budget tracking, governance, and reporting. Understanding of MSSP, VAR, and distributor (DISTI) partner ecosystems. Experience managing program budgets, financial tracking, and reconciliation processes. Strong understanding of channel marketing operations and partner program workflows. Experience with Salesforce and familiarity with marketing automation platforms. Strong analytical skills and experience developing dashboards, reports, and performance metrics. Excellent organizational, project management, and process improvement skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate stakeholders across global teams. Strong attention to detail, financial accuracy, and operational accountability. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently and proactively identify opportunities for improvement. Preferred Qualifications Direct experience administering Impartner, including MDF workflows and partner portal management. Experience developing or implementing MDF governance frameworks and standardized approval processes. Experience supporting global partner marketing programs across North America, EMEA, and APJ. Familiarity with two-tier distribution models and partner marketing programs involving MSPs, MSSPs, VARs, and distributors. Experience with Salesforce reporting, partner attribution, and pipeline tracking. Experience supporting PRM integrations, workflow automation, and data quality initiatives. Background in cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, observability, or enterprise technology. Experience developing partner enablement materials and training programs. About Us Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com. Sumo Logic Privacy Policy . Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection. The expected annual base salary range for this position is $130,000. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but aren’t limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible to participate in our bonus or commission plans and equity awards. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and paid time off. This position will remain open until filled; there is no application deadline. To be considered, please submit your application. Must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and for the duration of employment. At this time, we are not able to offer new non-immigrant visa sponsorship or OPT hiring for this position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sumo-logic-partner-marketing-program-manager

Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, UK Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com . We are looking for a Leader to lead the EMEA small to medium and Mid market team and is based remotely in the UK. The Role This role leads the EMEA Small to medium and MidMarket business team and is accountable for new logo acquisition and expansion revenue across the region. The expectations are high: a team that generates its own pipeline across multiple countries, deals that are qualified with discipline, forecasts that hold, and Account Executives who improve every quarter. This is not an oversight role. The leader in this seat works deals alongside their team, sets the standard for outbound execution in each market, and uses data to drive performance. It is a first-line leader role who has already delivered results in EMEA and wants to operate at the pace and scale of a fast-growing company. Responsibilities Deal leadership Engage directly in the team's most important opportunities: discovery, executive alignment, mutual close plans, commercial structure, procurement, legal, DPA, and security review. Set the standard for value-based selling: quantifying the customer's business pain, building the business case, and tying Bitwarden to risk reduction and compliance outcomes that drive European buying decisions (GDPR, NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001). Diagnose and unblock stalled deals, and use them to raise the skill level of the entire team. Coach disciplined excellence and field skills to find, transition and close deals efficiently. Work tirelessly in the detail of each customer requirement, enabled by experience and strategic effort, placing Bitwarden in the best position possible to win deals and transfer this knowledge to the team. Drive accountability through metrics, motivation, method and effective communication techniques. Be accountable, methodical, pragmatic and foster by example lead from the front. Outbound pipeline generation Build and mature a repeatable cold outbound motion with AEs and partnered SDRs, localized by market: territory and account prioritization, ICP and persona targeting, multi-threaded sequencing, and messaging adapted for country and language. Set activity and pipeline-generation standards, inspect them weekly, and hold every AE accountable for self-sourced pipeline. Align and drive our message with Marketing, Sales Development, and Channel on programs, including partner-sourced plays, that produce qualified pipeline at a predictable rate. MEDDPICC and value-based execution Run MEDDPICC as the team's operating system across qualification, deal reviews, forecast calls, and win/loss analysis, with value-based selling defining how the team earns and proves each element. Inspect every material opportunity for quantified Metrics, a validated Economic Buyer, a tested Champion, clear Decision Criteria and Process, a mapped Paper Process (including works council, procurement, and data-protection steps), and an honest read on Competition. Deliver an accurate weekly forecast built on deal evidence and maintain CRM data the business can rely on. Data-driven coaching Own the team's KPIs (pipeline generation, coverage, stage conversion, win rate, cycle length, average deal size, and activity-to-outcome ratios) by rep and by market, and act on what they show. Identify where each AE is losing ground and build targeted coaching plans to close the gap. Run a disciplined operating cadence across time zones: weekly 1:1s, pipeline and deal reviews, forecast calls, and call reviews. Team building Recruit, hire, onboard, and ramp high-caliber Account Executives across EMEA markets, and develop them toward promotion. Build a culture of accountability, competitiveness, and continuous improvement across countries and cultures. Work across Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Channel, and Marketing, to deliver revenue as one team. Requirements 3–5 years of first-line sales leadership in EMEA, ideally leading AEs selling security SaaS (identity, access, credential, endpoint, or adjacent categories). A proven, documented track record of quota attainment as a leader, and as an individual contributor before that. Deep working fluency in MEDDPICC and value-based selling, applied together to qualify, inspect, forecast, and coach. A track record of building and maturing a cold outbound pipeline across more than one EMEA market, with the ability to explain exactly how it was done and what it produced. Strong analytical skills, including fluency with Hubspot & industry tooling for reporting, dashboards, and spreadsheets, and a record of using KPIs to direct coaching and improve AE performance. A hands-on approach to leadership, with direct, regular involvement in live deals. Player-coach, building own pipeline coaching the team through example, including closing and processing, customer excellence. Strong intellect, a fast learning curve, and the drive to perform in a high-growth environment with demanding targets. Strong command of EMEA buying dynamics, procurement processes, regulatory drivers, and channel/partner models. Fluent business English. (Additional languages are beneficial considering the role supports all of EMEA e.g., German, French, Dutch, etc.) A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world’s largest organisations. Become an expert in a growing market. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup. We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-mid-market-sales-leader-emea

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Canada URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/4dyzGH7uUuNnNDur5PLBgE/jobs-at-wealth-without-wallstreet Now Hiring: A Sales Manager Who Wants To Think Like A Founder (And Get Paid Like One). If you need a "supportive culture" and a 90-day onboarding plan before you can pick up the phone, get on a live call to sell and lead from the front, then close this tab. You're not our people. Still here? Keep reading. We're Wealth Without Wall Street. We teach business owners, professionals and families how to build real wealth without handing their future to some stranger in a Manhattan high-rise. Our mission is to help over 1 million people create financial freedom. The equation for us is simple: the day your passive income exceeds your monthly expenses, that is the day you're financially free and that is what we help people achieve. The movement is growing faster than we can handle. That's why we are writing this. We are looking for ONE Sales Manager. But not the kind you're picturing. No dashboard-hiders. No "Q3 alignment" types. We want a player-coach. A killer with a headset who can master our system in weeks, close deals from the front lines, and set a pace that makes the rest of the team stand up straighter. Then you get the keys. You hire your team. You train them in your image. You build something that didn't exist before you got here. That's not a department. That's a legacy. This is not a coast job. Not a "circle back Tuesday" job. Not a place where mediocrity gets another quarter to figure itself out. If your pulse picked up while reading this, prove it. Don't send us a resume that reads like a LinkedIn obituary. Tell us what you've closed. Tell us what you've built. Tell us why you're the one. What You’ll Do: Phase 1 – Master the Machine Learn our scripts, CRM, and booking process Sharpen your sales skills and start closing deals Audit our current system and identify areas for improvement Work with our existing team to increase their output Phase 2 – Scale the Team Continue to recruit insurance agents and closers for our coaching offer Continue to recruit and add to your SDR Team Lead 1:1 coaching, daily huddles, live sales reviews, and performance tracking Build sales culture and help the team hit their stride fast Work with leadership on onboarding, training systems, and KPIs Phase 3 – Own the Department Drive the department’s revenue, recruiting, and team performance Collaborate with execs to scale campaigns and comp plans Develop internal leaders and create strong bench strength under you You're the kind of person who doesn’t wait for direction — you take it and run. You’ll crush this role if you: Have 3–5+ years in sales, including 1–2 years leading high-performing teams Have managed a sales team of 20+ people You are tech savvy You understand and are proficient with pipeline management Have built, hired, or scaled a sales team before Are a strong closer with deep understanding of sales psychology Know how to motivate, coach, and hold others accountable to results Want ownership, not micromanagement Have a track record of driving numbers into the green and scaling sales systems Are obsessed with growth — both personally and professionally Want to build something long-term with real legacy potential KPI Ownership: 400+ Appointments Set / Month 250+ Appointments Held / Month 100+ Applications / Month $1M+ in Funded Policies / Month Reps onboarded and fully ramped within 30 days We believe in building something bigger than ourselves — and taking care of the people who help us do it. What You’ll Get: Compensation: Compensation: Base of $5,000 - $10,000+ Per Month to Start Based on Experience, Past Results & Tenure Up to $12,000/month in bonus potential for Funded Policies 3% revenue share on Lab division which is our coaching business Leadership Opportunity: Real decision-making power — not just managing, but building Direct collaboration with founders and execs A voice in compensation, culture, and long-term strategy Team & Culture: Join a mission-driven team that cares deeply about freedom A high-performance culture built on accountability and growth Systems and support to help you win Long-Term Potential: Opportunity to build your own division within the company Create systems, culture, and success that outlast you Mentorship from 7- and 8-figure business builders To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wealth-without-wallstreet-sales-manager

items.description: About this opportunity: Freenome is seeking an Associate Director of Marketing Operations to build and lead the systems, processes, and measurement capabilities that enable effective, scalable marketing execution. This role will own marketing operations strategy and day-to-day execution across marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, campaign workflows, analytics, digital operations, and medical, legal, and regulatory (MLR) review operations. You will connect marketing strategy with operational execution, helping teams deliver campaigns efficiently, maintain reliable data, and make informed investment decisions. Working closely with Marketing, Commercial Operations, Sales, Medical Affairs, Legal, Regulatory, and IT, you will establish clear workflows and strong governance from initial project intake through content approval, deployment, and performance measurement. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set priorities, build sustainable processes, and work directly in the platforms that support them. This role reports to the Director of Product Marketing. What you’ll do: Marketing operations strategy Own the marketing operations roadmap, aligning technology investments, process improvements, and resources with commercial priorities. Lead optimization of the marketing technology ecosystem, including HubSpot, Salesforce integrations, Asana, Allego, WordPress, and related analytics and automation tools. Partner with Commercial Operations and IT to define system ownership, integration requirements, access controls, data standards, and change management practices. Manage relevant vendors and agency partners, monitor platform utilization and costs, and recommend improvements. Develop standard operating procedures, training, and documentation that support consistent execution and platform adoption. Support marketing budget planning and tracking by monitoring spend, reconciling actuals, and flagging variances. Lead lifecycle and campaign operations Establish and execute the end-to-end lead management process in Salesforce with input from Sales and Commercial Operations, including lifecycle definitions, scoring, routing, nurture, ownership, and sales handoff. Lead campaign operations standards, including intake, build requirements, quality assurance, tracking conventions, and launch readiness. Establish Asana workflows, project templates, prioritization practices, and portfolio reporting that improve visibility into workload, dependencies, and delivery timelines. Medical, legal, and regulatory review operations Own the medical, legal, and regulatory review process from submission through approval and release, coordinating reviewers, timelines, feedback, and escalations. Lead business process ownership for content reviews, including Asana and Veeva PromoMats, partnering with system administrators to maintain workflows, records, version control, and reporting. Oversee content lifecycle and process improvement, including training, renewals, expiration, and tracking review cycle times, backlogs, and submission quality. Digital operations and sales enablement Design web marketing workflows and manage website forms and data capture from intake through MLR review and launch, ensuring forms, landing pages, gated content, and chatbot experiences support attribution and lead routing. Partner with web development and content teams on site performance, technical and on-page SEO, reusable templates, and ongoing site maintenance. Partner with Sales Training to establish content organization, tagging, publishing permissions, and refresh practices in Allego so sales teams can readily access current, approved materials. Analytics, automation, and governance Build trusted dashboards for funnel performance, conversion rates, lead velocity, channel effectiveness, pipeline contribution, and marketing ROI. Establish attribution approaches appropriate to available data and translate results into actionable recommendations and quarterly business reviews. Identify and implement AI-assisted workflows and automation that reduce manual work, with appropriate human review and data safeguards. Partner with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and IT to implement applicable requirements for consent, preference management, data handling, and digital tracking. Measure operational effectiveness and prioritize improvements based on business impact, adoption, and execution quality. Must haves: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years of relevant experience in marketing operations, commercial operations, or marketing technology, including experience leading cross-functional programs. Experience in diagnostics, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, or another regulated healthcare environment. Hands-on expertise with marketing automation and CRM platforms, preferably HubSpot and Salesforce, including integrations, lifecycle workflows, and data governance. Demonstrated experience managing MLR or promotional review operations, including submission standards, review coordination, approval documentation, and content lifecycle controls. Experience with Veeva PromoMats or a comparable promotional content review platform. Strong analytical skills and experience building funnel reporting, attribution frameworks, and executive performance summaries. Proven ability to translate complex requirements into practical workflows, establish accountability, and influence stakeholders across functions. Strong project management, communication, and change management skills, with the ability to balance strategic planning and hands-on execution. Nice to haves: Experience supporting commercial launches or scaling marketing operations within a growing healthcare organization. Familiarity with Asana, Allego, WordPress, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Gong. Experience with website operations, SEO, sales enablement content governance, and responsible use of AI in marketing workflows. items.description: WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. We work with the world’s most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise. Our people are the key to our success. We’re committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. For more information, visit WPP.com. Why we’re hiring: WPP is undertaking one of the most significant transformations of its Learning & Development function as part of our Elevate28 strategy. We are creating a new global Learning & Development operating model designed to simplify how learning is designed, delivered, and experienced across the organisation. To help bring this vision to life, we’re looking for an experienced Transformation Project Manager to lead the implementation of the new L&D Centre of Excellence (CoE) model. This 12-month fixed-term opportunity will play a critical role in turning strategy into operational reality, ensuring the successful transition to a globally integrated structure that supports capability building at scale across WPP. You will help establish new ways of working, coordinate multiple transformation workstreams, and ensure the organisation is ready to adopt new processes, technologies, and governance structures. What you’ll be doing: Lead the end-to-end delivery of the L&D transformation programme, ensuring milestones, timelines, resources and deliverables remain on track. Translate the L&D Centre of Excellence blueprint into practical implementation plans, governance structures and operational processes. Drive the transition to the future-state operating model, including organisational design changes, near-shore Design Lab implementation and service migration to Global Business Services (GBS). Coordinate multiple stakeholders, workstreams and delivery partners to ensure successful execution across global, regional and local teams. Establish governance forums, reporting frameworks, dashboards, KPIs and decision-making processes to support programme success. Manage programme risks, dependencies and readiness activities, ensuring impacts are identified early and mitigated effectively. Lead change management, stakeholder engagement and communications activities to drive adoption of new ways of working. Support the implementation and adoption of Workday Learning and other learning technologies, helping learning become more accessible within the flow of work. Build sustainable governance, documentation and operating processes to ensure a seamless handover at the conclusion of the programme. Who you’ll be working with: You’ll report to the Chief Learning & Development Officer and work in close partnership with the People Transformation Team . You’ll collaborate with senior leaders across Learning & Development, HR Business Partners, Technology, Data, Finance and Global Business Services (GBS), ensuring alignment across programme workstreams and organisational priorities. You’ll also engage with regional stakeholders, delivery partners and the near-shore Design Lab to ensure the successful implementation of the new operating model. What you’ll need: Experience delivering project, programme or transformation initiatives within complex, global organisations. Experience leading operating model, organisational design or business transformation programmes, ideally within Learning & Development, HR or broader People functions. Strong programme governance, planning, execution and reporting capabilities with a track record of delivering high-quality outcomes. Proven stakeholder management skills with the ability to build credibility and influence senior leaders across multiple functions. Experience managing service transitions, shared services, GBS, near-shore or offshore delivery models. Strong change management and communication skills, with experience supporting teams through transformation and organisational change. Ability to manage multiple workstreams, competing priorities and complex dependencies in fast-paced environments. Experience using data, reporting and insights to monitor progress, readiness and programme performance. Familiarity with enterprise learning platforms such as Workday Learning, LMS or LXP technologies is highly desirable. Professional certifications such as PRINCE2, PMP, Agile or Prosci are advantageous. Experience working in consulting, professional services, matrixed or global environments would be beneficial. Who you are: You’re open : We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working. You’re optimistic : We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected. You’re extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day. What we’ll give you: Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work. Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry. Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge? #LI-Hybrid We believe the best work happens when we’re together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That’s why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

items.summary: Headquarters: Poland - Remote Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. Wrike is our people,
items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Poland - Remote Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. About the Role: You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Backend Reliability (BRE) team is the backbone of our backend infrastructure and the guardian of our uptime. Our mission is to achieve and sustain 99.99% availability while building the tools, components, and safety nets that the entire engineering organization relies on. As a Senior / Staff Backend Engineer on this team, you won’t just close tickets - you’ll architect core reliability solutions that shape how Wrike scales, performs, and recovers from failure. Your Impact: Design, build, and maintain critical reliability components such as HTTP rate limiters, internal DB schema migration tools, circuit breakers, and distributed Redis-based caching. Troubleshoot complex production issues, optimize PostgreSQL usage, and ensure our distributed systems remain performant and stable under high load. Lead preliminary investigations during severe production incidents: identify likely root causes, assess impact, and propose mitigation options. The long-term fixes are then implemented by the owning team, based on your findings. Create scalable, reusable tools and frameworks that help other engineering teams build more resilient services. Leverage AI-powered tools and coding agents to accelerate development, analyze architectures, and automate repetitive or error-prone tasks. Influence reliability best practices across engineering by sharing knowledge, reviewing designs, and setting high technical standards. Your Qualifications: Strong expertise with Java/JVM, building scalable, high-performance backend systems; open to leveraging other languages when appropriate. Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts, including high availability, CAP theorem, and fault tolerance. Deep experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and key–value / non-relational storages (Redis). Practical experience with containerization and cloud-native environments, including Docker and Kubernetes. Hands-on experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ or Kafka. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, using critical thinking to question assumptions and validate your own decisions. Strong written and spoken English skills suitable for collaborating in an international engineering environment. Standout Qualities: Background in infrastructure engineering or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), including infrastructure-as-code practices. Experience leading technical initiatives, driving cross-team projects, and mentoring other engineers while remaining an individual contributor. Familiarity with observability and monitoring stacks (e.g., Graylog, Zabbix, Grafana) and/or data analytics tools such as BigQuery. A strong interest in how complex systems fail and a track record of designing them to recover gracefully. Team Dynamics: You will join the Backend Reliability (BRE) team, a small, highly specialized, senior group focused solely on Wrike’s reliability. The team operates as an internal “reliability task force,” partnering closely with product and platform engineering teams across the company. You’ll collaborate with other senior engineers who value autonomy, deep technical discussions, and rigorous engineering practices. The culture is ownership-driven: you are trusted to manage your time, make architectural decisions, and drive initiatives to completion. Our Work Style: The BRE team works on core backend and infrastructure services that support millions of users. We operate in a collaborative environment that values clear communication, thoughtful design, and fast feedback loops. Tech focus areas include: Java/JVM-based services, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ/Kafka, and observability/monitoring tools. We encourage the use of modern AI-based tooling and coding agents as part of daily development and troubleshooting workflows. Work is organized with an emphasis on impact and reliability goals rather than ticket volume, giving you room for deep work and long-term improvements. Hybrid work mode (Prague, Czech Republic / Nicosia, Cyprus), with flexibility to balance focused individual work and collaborative sessions. What’s next? Interview with a Recruiter Technical interview System Design Interview Cultural interview Your recruitment buddy will be Aleksandar Chernev , Senior Technical Recruiter. #LI-AC1 Who Is Wrike and Our Culture We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow. Hybrid work mode Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations. While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection. Our persona Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched. Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too! Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. Our culture and Values Customer-Focused We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind. Collaborative We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement. Creative We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. Committed We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth. Check out our LinkedIn Life Page , Company culture page , Instagram , Wrike Engineering Team , Medium , Meetup.com , Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-staff-software-engineer-1

items.title: Customer Support Specialist | German and English
items.summary: EverHelp is a team of professionals, that’s developing outsourcing support services for plenty of products all over the world at a dynamic tempo.
items.description: EverHelp is a team of professionals, that’s developing outsourcing support services for plenty of products all over the world at a dynamic tempo. The project launched in 2021, and last year we experienced a yearly growth rate of +82%. Since February 2022, we've managed to preserve all our workplaces and, most importantly, we continue to strengthen our team while maintaining an employee satisfaction rate of over 90%. In 2026, EverHelp received 9 international workplace and employer awards. The company ranked #1 in the Top 30 Inspiring Workplaces in Europe, was named the #1 employer among European companies with 500–4,999 employees, and earned Best-in-Class recognition across 6 categories: Culture & Purpose, Leadership, Inclusion & Belonging, Wellbeing, Employee Voice, and Employee Experience. EverHelp was also named one of the 28 Best Places to Work by Business Intelligence Group — a global award recognizing companies with strong workplace cultures and outstanding employee experience. Our statement: We’re against war and unjustified aggression, We evacuated all the teammates and their families from the frontline, helped them find a new place to live and provided financial support, We provided the team with charging stations, We continue to work together for the future of Ukraine. As EverHelp continues expanding its portfolio of international customer support projects, we are looking for a Customer Support Representative (Hospitality) to join our team. In this role, you will support guests of a fast-growing hospitality project, ensuring every interaction reflects genuine care, professionalism, and a guest-first mindset. You'll help resolve booking-related inquiries, reservation issues, and other service requests while creating an outstanding customer experience across multiple communication channels. Your future responsibilities include: Providing support to guests via phone calls, email, live chat, WhatsApp, and online booking platform messages; Assisting guests with booking inquiries, reservation updates, property access, and other accommodation-related requests; Delivering exceptional customer service with a genuine hospitality mindset and a "guest-first" approach; Resolving customer inquiries efficiently while maintaining a warm, professional, and empathetic communication style; Escalating critical cases, including refund requests, legal matters, or sensitive guest complaints, to the appropriate internal teams; Accurately documenting customer interactions and case details in internal systems; Collaborating closely with teammates to ensure a seamless guest experience across all communication channels; Following internal quality standards while balancing efficiency with exceptional service. Needed experience & skills: 1–3 years of experience in Customer Support, Hospitality, or another customer-facing role; German language proficiency (B2+) and English language proficiency (B2+); Experience communicating with customers across multiple channels, including calls and written communication; Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound decisions independently; Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first mindset; Ability to remain calm, professional, and solution-oriented in challenging situations; High adaptability and willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-changing environment; Strong multitasking skills while maintaining high service quality; Positive attitude, resilience, and genuine enthusiasm for teamwork. Work with EverHelp is about: 20+ vacation days and 10 paid sick leaves; Ability to work fully remotely; A professional team of specialists, ready to share their expertise, along with internal communities and team activities, fosters continuous learning and development both within the team and on an individual level; Opportunity for a career growth. 32% of our teammates obtained a new role during their first year of work in our company. 86% of our Team Leads have been our Customer Support Agents in the past. Submit your resume and join our team! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Software Engineer, Verticals (AI Native)
items.summary: Headquarters: Canada URL: http://www.life360.com About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver rep
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada URL: http://www.life360.com About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com . Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. About The Team This role sits on the Verticals team within Life360 — the group building the next frontier of meaningful connection beyond the core family circle. This role's initial focus is Aging in Place: helping aging parents stay safely independent while giving the families around them real peace of mind. Over time, this role may flex to support other emerging verticals — Things (Tile, connected trackers) or Pets — as priorities shift, so we're looking for someone who wants to help define the pattern for new member segments, not just ship one feature set. We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. That means AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We've redesigned our team workflows around AI, treating it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale. About the Job Life360 is hiring an AI Native Senior Software Engineer — a senior engineer who doesn't just use AI tools, but thinks natively in them. You'll be central to how the Verticals team builds products. You'll design and build features that serve one of our most important and fastest-growing member segments: aging parents who want to stay safely connected with, and independent from, the families who care about them. As priorities change, you may also apply these same patterns to Things (connected trackers) or Pets. You will take full ownership of what you build from the first line of code through production, on-call, and the member impact it has. You obsess over the humans on the other end of the product, not just the ticket. Full-stack experience is required for this role — you should be comfortable moving between backend services and the mobile surfaces that expose them. Our stack spans Spring Boot microservices, Java, Kafka, and Kafka Streams on the backend, a modern cloud-native platform on AWS, and native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps on the client side. In your first year, success looks like having shipped end-to-end features serving the Aging in Place member segment and establishing at least one AI-native workflow the broader team adopts. For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $103,500 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 149,500 to 177,500 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. What You’ll Do Ship end-to-end across the stack — from backend services and APIs through to the iOS and Android surfaces members use, serving tens of millions of users — moving between layers as the feature demands. Work with AI (Claude Code) as a first-class collaborator — orchestrate agents to create specs, generate code, and perform reviews, moving faster without sacrificing quality. Define and codify AI-Native engineering practices for the Verticals team, establishing playbooks the broader org can adopt. Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to turn complex user problems into scalable engineering solutions. Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement. Participate in on-call rotation and incident response. Mentor team members and contribute to team processes and technical standards. Support performance, reliability, and accessibility across the features you own. Adapt patterns and services built for Aging in Place to future verticals (Things, Pets) as team scope expands. What We’re Looking For 4+ years of experience building and operating high-quality, consumer-scale services. 1+ years of hands-on experience prompting, evaluating, and building with LLMs. Full-stack proficiency spanning backend services (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka) and mobile client development (Swift for iOS and/or Kotlin for Android), with the versatility to work across the whole stack as needed. Hands-on experience with agentic workflows, prompt engineering, context window management, and MCP/function calling. A track record of using AI tooling to multiply your own output — not just as autocomplete, but as a development partner. A strong sense of ownership — you don't wait to be told what to fix, and you follow through past "it works on my machine" to "it works for the member, in production, at scale." Strong communication and collaboration skills — you work well with product, design, and platform engineers. Excitement for defining what it means to be AI-Native — you're not waiting for the playbook, you want to write it. Empathy for the humans behind the product — an aging parent trying to stay independent, or a family member trying to help from afar. Bachelor's Degree in a Technical field, or equivalent experience. Nice-to-Have Experience with IoT, telematics, or embedded/hardware-adjacent systems. Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or other high-throughput streaming platforms. Background with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, DataDog). AI-Native Expectations We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice: Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete but as a development partner. Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship. Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team. Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed. Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work. Our Benefits Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees. 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees. Paid parental leave. Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being. items.title: Content Creator - YouTube
items.summary: Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered. Job Overview Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media. About us Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them. We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone. We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world. What you'll do Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way. Write video scripts and outlines. Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos. Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor. What we're looking for Native-level written and spoken English Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work Ability to take feedback and continuously improve Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada Nice to have Previous experience creating educational video content Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos Working at Metics Media At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work. At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos. Compensation Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada) Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed. Benefits 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays 10 paid sick days per year Medical, dental, and vision coverage A 401(k) with employer contributions (US) How to apply Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

items.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
items.summary: Job Title: Patient Care Advocate Job Location: Remote About Us: We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. Role Overview: As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. What You’ll Do: Patient Enrollment & Eligibility : Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. Prescription Coverage : Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. Cost-Sharing & Payment : Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. Prescription Fulfillment : Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. Refills & Continued Use : Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. Program Renewal & Updates : Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. What We’re Looking For: High school diploma or GED required Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus) Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment Success Factors for Working from Home Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. Ergonomics : A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. Reliable Internet Connection : Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace : A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. Tech-Savvy : Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. Self-motivation & Independence : Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. Communication Skills : Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. Adaptability : Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. Compensation & Perks Hourly Pay : $16.50 per hour Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. Comprehensive Benefits : Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. Cell Phone Benefits : $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). Generous Referral Program : Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. Comprehensive Training : Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. Career Growth : Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. Work-from-Home Convenience : Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. Inclusive Culture : We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. What Success Looks Like: Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance Why Join Us? Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors Competitive compensation and benefits package A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture Ready to Make an Impact? Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

items.title: FirstPrinciples Research Fellow
items.summary: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe.
items.description: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe. We're developing an intelligent system that can explore theoretical frameworks, reason across disciplines, and generate novel insights to tackle the deepest unsolved problems in physics. By combining AI, symbolic reasoning, and autonomous research capabilities, we're developing a platform that goes beyond analyzing existing knowledge to actively contribute to physics research. Our goal is to accelerate progress on the questions that have captivated humanity for centuries. We operate as a global nonprofit organization , with a Canadian foundation, a US-based 501(c)(3). As part of this effort, we are launching a Research Fellowship Program for advanced AI and physics researchers. Fellows will work directly with the FirstPrinciples Research and Engineering teams to design, test, and implement state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods and applications that will be integrated into the core AI Physicist system. This is not a paper-only fellowship and your work will go straight into production, helping shape how scientific research is performed. What You will DoAs a Research Fellow, you will own a well-scoped research direction that contributes directly to the AI Physicist's ability to reason about physics. Core Objectives: Improve Theo’s ability to produce scientifically sound, high-quality outputs in 2026; Introduce new ideas, methods, and approaches that meaningfully shift system performance; Bring deep domain expertise (PhD+ level) in one or more targeted research areas. Research Areas & Responsibilities Fundamental Model Research : Research, design, and test novel model architectures that combine academic literature, NLP, symbolic reasoning, and structured scientific workflows. Prototype and build embedding representations for physical concepts, mathematical objects, and logical structures, enabling models to reason over equations, abstractions, and scientific constraints rather than surface text alone. Investigate alternatives to transformer-based architectures and deliver concrete recommendations. Design and run targeted experiments to evaluate new architectural ideas, using empirical results to guide the development of next-generation model architectures. Develop reinforcement learning loops that enable models to run internal and independent thought experiment. Multimodal Data & Benchmarking : Design and automate scalable data ingestion pipelines that aggregate scientific literature, metadata, equations, and experimental data. Create custom benchmarks to measure physical understanding, mathematical reasoning, and failure modes in scientific reasoning and abstraction. Refine and release curated datasets and baselines once internal validation is complete. Training, Testing & Safety : Run and track model training jobs while managing compute usage and budget constraints. Design sandbox environments for controlled autonomous exploration. Build evaluation frameworks using visual and statistical tools to identify strengths and blind spots. Implement tests and guardrails that flag low-quality or unsafe outputs. Maintain internal issue tracking with clear failure modes and fixes. Collaboration & Technical Guidance : Work closely with engineers to ensure research is feasible and production-ready. Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Present regular research updates tied to defined milestones. Who This Fellowship Is ForWe are looking for researchers who: Can operate independently and own a problem end-to-end. Are motivated by ambitious, long-horizon goals. Have strong builder instincts, not just theory. Value rigor, clarity, and intellectual honesty. Are comfortable engaging with exploratory, incomplete results. Typical profiles include: PhD or postdoctoral researchers in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Theoretical Physics, or a closely related field. Track record of research in either: model architectures, representation learning, or reasoning systems (CS/ML path); or mathematical, physical, or formal reasoning applied to fundamental problems (physics path). Demonstrated ability to translate abstract theory into testable computational systems. Comfortable working across disciplinary boundaries. Program Structure 6-12 month engagement with full-time or equivalent commitment Fully remote Fellows participate in projects and are expected to produce outputs (code, models, and other deliverables) Fixed stipend for the full term How to Express Interest:If this resonates, we welcome an expression of interest, including: Resume; Description of your research background; Primary areas of expertise; and Relevant recent work. Join us at FirstPrinciples and be a part of a transformative journey where science drives progress and unlocks the potential of humanity. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: About Axipro Axipro gets fast-growing B2B companies ready for their security and compliance audits: SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, HIPAA, GDPR and more, plus penetration testing.
items.description: About Axipro Axipro gets fast-growing B2B companies ready for their security and compliance audits: SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, HIPAA, GDPR and more, plus penetration testing. We’ve helped 300+ companies get compliant, with a team of 35+ people and entities in Bahrain, the UK and the US. We’re a Drata Elite Partner, partner with Vanta, and are CREST certified. Our pitch is simple: readiness in about six weeks, real humans doing the work, and fixed fees starting at $4,000. About the role You’ll run ’s organic search and AI visibility day to day, so our Head of Growth can focus on other opportunities. He sets the strategy and signs off the work; you do the research, write the briefs and drafts, refresh what’s already ranking, and report on what’s moving. You’ll work alongside a small growth team: a web editor who publishes and builds pages in Elementor, an outreach specialist who handles link building and media placements, and a partnerships assistant. You’ll report to the Head of Growth and Partnerships. We use AI heavily, with our own Claude-based workflows for outlines, drafts and refresh briefs. We’re not hiring someone to paste in AI output. We want someone with judgement: someone who can tell when a draft is wrong, thin or off-brand, fix it, and add something a reader hasn’t seen before. What you'll do Most of your time goes on improving pages we already have and building the new ones we need. AreaShare of time Content refreshes30%New articles and pages30%Research, AI visibility and competitors15%Technical SEO and reporting15%Content syndication10% Content refreshes Find the pages worth updating in Google Search Console: ranking drops, pages stuck in positions 5 to 20, high impressions with low click-through. Write clear refresh briefs, including the new copy ready to paste in, and hand them to the web editor. Track before-and-after results for every page you touch. Flag weak, low-traffic pages for pruning or redirecting. New articles and pages Do keyword and topic research, and check for cannibalisation before proposing anything new. Produce articles through our AI-assisted workflow, then edit, fact-check and sharpen them so they’re genuinely useful to a compliance buyer. Build new service, framework and location pages as part of our localised SEO strategy for the US, UK and GCC. Send technical pieces to our GRC team for an expert review before they go live. Research, AI visibility and competitors Run our monthly AI visibility check (who ChatGPT and other AI tools cite for our key prompts) and write a short summary of what changed and why. Track what competing consultancies and audit firms publish and rank for. Get Axipro listed in the directories and review sites that AI answers cite. Technical SEO and reporting Monitor Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools for indexing, crawl and redirect issues. Fix the simple ones and flag the rest. Keep internal linking and schema in good shape. Send a one-page monthly report covering rankings, organic leads, refresh results and AI citations. Content syndication Turn our best articles into LinkedIn articles and posts, and republish them where the rules allow. What this role doesn't cover Other people on the team own these, so you won’t need to: Publishing and building pages in WordPress and Elementor Link-building outreach and media placements Partnership outreach Paid ads Conversion work such as CTAs and forms What we're looking for Must-haves 1 to 3 years of hands-on SEO, with pages you can show that you researched, wrote or refreshed, and that improved Confident with Google Search Console and at least one keyword tool (DataForSEO, Ahrefs, Semrush or similar) Excellent written English, and the ability to make a technical topic clear without padding it Comfortable using AI tools, and critical of what they produce: you check facts, cut fluff and add real insight Organised and self-directed: you can work through a weekly list without being chased, and you flag problems early Nice-to-haves Experience in B2B, SaaS or cybersecurity content Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar frameworks Some understanding of AI search visibility (GEO), schema and technical SEO WordPress basics How we'll measure success We’ll look at results, not hours: Pages refreshed each month, and the change in their rankings and clicks New articles and pages published Priority keywords ranking in the top 10 Leads coming from organic search Axipro’s share of citations in AI answers for our tracked prompts Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML , used on more than 1.5 million websites worldwide, we're looking for a creative, experienced Content Marketing Lead who knows how to turn great content into real business results. AI has changed how we create content, and we embrace it. But great content still needs someone who understands customers, spots opportunities, tells compelling stories, and knows what actually works. We're looking for someone who combines excellent writing skills, creativity, business understanding, and hands-on execution to make smart decisions, turn ideas into compelling content, attract customers, and help our business grow. What You'll Do You'll have the freedom to shape our content marketing, experiment with new ideas, and see the impact of your work. Create content that makes a difference : write engaging website pages, articles, emails, and campaigns that attract and connect with customers. Own the content direction : identify opportunities, set priorities, and bring ideas from concept to publication. Make the most of AI : use AI tools to research, create, improve, and scale content while keeping quality high. Grow our visibility : improve SEO and AI-search presence (GEO/AEO) to help more people discover our products. Build connections : collaborate with partners, customers, and product experts to create content that stands out. Turn insights into results : track performance, experiment, learn what works, and continuously improve. You'll work closely with our CEO, product teams, and marketing colleagues, with plenty of room to bring your own ideas to life. What We're Looking For You're an excellent writer and experienced content marketer who can make even complex technical products interesting and easy to understand. You've owned successful content marketing projects and can show the results of your work. You are hands-on with SEO, email marketing, and content distribution , and know how they contribute to business growth. You're AI-native, using AI tools confidently to create better content and work more effectively. You understand customers, products, and competition , and can turn these insights into compelling content. You're creative, proactive, and independent . You enjoy making decisions, trying new things, and taking responsibility for results. You have experience with SaaS, software, WordPress, or other technical products . Why Join Us? We're a profitable, self-funded software company with a global customer base and a fully remote team. You'll have the chance to own content marketing for an established product, work directly with decision-makers, experiment with the latest AI tools, and make a visible impact on our business. We value great ideas, initiative, and people who enjoy turning opportunities into results. What We Offer 100% remote work with an international team. Paid time off and national holidays to recharge. Body and Mind Movement (BAMM) program to support your hobbies and well-being. Computer budget for a comfortable workspace. Kindle and access to our company Amazon account. Smart, supportive, and self-driven colleagues from around the world. Freedom to experiment, grow, and make a real impact. Love creating content, exploring what AI can do, and seeing your ideas turn into real results? We'd love to meet you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-content-marketing-lead

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.

items.title: Creative Director / Associate Creative Director
items.summary: Superside is seeking visionary Creative Directors/Associate Creative Directors to guide a globally distributed team across branding, ad and social creative, presentations, print, and landing pages. In this high-impact role, you’ll shape the future of AI-enhanced creativity by integrating generative tools into our design workflows, elevating both quality and efficiency. You’ll lead by example as both a maker and a mentor, balancing hands-on creative work with strategic guidance. Collaborating with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, you’ll inspire cross-functional teams, develop human-centered creative strategies, and help build a scalable design practice rooted in experimentation, feedback, and continuous improvement.

items.title: Lead Creative
items.summary: Superside is looking for a Lead Creative with a passion for AI to shape creative excellence across branding, landing pages, ads, social, print, and presentations. You’ll guide a global team of top-tier creatives, combining strategic leadership with hands-on craft to deliver human-centered, high-impact work for leading brands worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of creativity and innovation, elevating creative quality while helping evolve our capabilities through the thoughtful use of AI tools. You’ll act as both a mentor and a maker, fostering collaboration, empathy, and clarity across every project. You bring curiosity, composure, and humility to your leadership, helping others grow while delivering consistently outstanding creative work.
